episodes.title: Kamen Rider Saber Special Chapter: A World Where Bandits Come and Go
episodes.overview: A special episode of Kamen Rider Saber. It is the first part of the Movie Release Commemorative Combo SpecialIcon-crosswiki.png, featuring a special appearance by Zox Goldtsuiker/Twokaizer.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Spider Man
episodes.overview: Takeshi Hongo, a young scientist boasting of an IQ of 600 and a racing prodigy, is abducted and his body surgically remodeled by Shocker, an evil secret society plotting for global domination.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Bat Man
episodes.overview: Hongo wins the championship, but the model who brings him his bouquet suddenly bares her fangs and attacks! With growing suspicion, Hongo investigates the woman's home, and finds it has been transformed into a lab.

episodes.title: Monster, Scorpion Man
episodes.overview: Shocker tests their mysterious Scorpion Man by releasing their slave workers and telling them that they can have their freedom if they can escape within 10 minutes, but one by one they die at the Scorpian Man's hands.

episodes.title: Cannibalism, Sarracenian
episodes.overview: At an amusement park's botanical gardens, people begin to go missing. The young boy Kenji's older sister Yukie gets snatched away, and he tries to tell someone that his sister was attacked by a giant King Sarracenian!!

episodes.title: Monster, Mantis Man
episodes.overview: While a series of strange earthquakes are going on, Hongo is contacted by his childhood friend and seismologist, Amemiya Chikako, who tells him, “Something is planning to cause a major earthquake.”

episodes.title: Grim Reaper, Chameleon
episodes.overview: Former navy lieutenant-commander Sunada is attacked by the Chameleon Man. His aim is a submarine model in Sunada's possession that has secrets relating to a Nazi treasure concealed inside.

episodes.title: Duel With Grim Reaper Chameleon! World Fair Impression
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider, having fallen into a pit trap, loses his power in the secret room where no wind can reach and reverts back to his form as Hongo.

episodes.title: Strangeness! Bee Woman
episodes.overview: Hongo begins an investigation into the series of incidents where people who had glasses made at Kagemura's Optometry store have gone missing. But even Ruriko gets some lure glasses, and she disappears as well.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Cobra Man
episodes.overview: Cobra Man makes an attack on the gold vault, but when the pet dog of security guard Kondo barks at him, he drops his fangs! Seeking his fangs, he attacks Kondo.

episodes.title: The Revived Cobra Man
episodes.overview: Ritsuko Ayakoji of the Ayakoji Biology Research Institute, Shocker's collaborator, puts up advertisements for “Purchasing Animals” to gather animal blood and capture the people who bring in their pets.

episodes.title: Bloodsucking Monster, Gebacondor
episodes.overview: Shocker has produced a new monster, Gebacondor, by assembling into one all the strong points of their previous monsters. But Gebacondor needs the lifeblood of young women.

episodes.title: Murder, Yamogelas
episodes.overview: Doctor Shirakawa has invented a death ray but tries to seal his invention away, while his aid Shibata conspires with Shocker and is remodeled into the monster Geckogeras, making secret plans to take the death ray.

episodes.title: Tokageron and the Big Monster Army
episodes.overview: To break through the Toyo Atomic Energy Research Laboratory's barrier, Shocker remodels pro soccer athlete Nomoto and produces the monster Tokageron with powerful kicking might.

episodes.title: Raid of the Demon Sabotegron
episodes.overview:
Hongo saved Tokyo from a horrible fate at the hands of Shocker.But Hongo can not rest while Shocker's plans to conquer the world grows stronger every day. For justice, and for everlasting peace, Kamen Rider will continue his fight until the very end.

Debuting this episode, a new Kamen Rider appears! With three new leading ladies, and more excitement, Thrills, and Action!

episodes.title: Counterattack, Sabotegron
episodes.overview: At the end of fierce fighting, Kamen Rider drives Sabotegron away. Sabotegron then uses Flowers of Mexico to attack Hayato and the Tachibana Racing Club.

episodes.title: Wrestler of the Devil, Pirasaurus
episodes.overview: Shocker gets their hands on the Pirazaurus whose poison can kill a giant dinosaur in mere seconds and begin to create a cyborg by combining it with a human.

episodes.title: Death Match in the Ring: Defeat! Pirasaurus
episodes.overview: Pirazaurus experiments with the powerful deadly gas, “Mist of Death,” at a gogo house. He launches his scheme to obliterate Japanese leaders with the Mist of Death as they spectate a pro wrestling match.

episodes.title: Fossil Man: Hitodanger
episodes.overview: Shocker creates a missile base in the mountains and appoints the monster Hitodanger to defend it. After saving a boy from a Shocker attack, he fights Hitodanger to save Taki who went searching for the base.

episodes.title: Monster Kanibubbler Appears in Hokkaido
episodes.overview: For Shocker's plan to cause a tsunami in Hokkaido through submarine earthquakes, they send in the monster Kanibubbler to destroy all seismomitors.

episodes.title: Fire-Breathing Caterpillar Monster: Dokugander
episodes.overview: Ichimonji, who has started an inquiry into a village thrown into panic by a gigantic catapillar creature, meets with Yoshioka who is looking for a missing professor, and together they begin a search for the professor.

episodes.title: Dokugander, Confrontation at Osaka Castle
episodes.overview: In order for Shocker to make use of a growth drug developed by Yoshioka, Dokugander's adult form transforms into the deceased professor to trick the assistant professor Yoshioka.

episodes.title: Suspicious Merman Amazonia
episodes.overview: An olympic swimmer disappears suddenly right before the eyes of his teammates, and a young man swimming in the ocean gets kidnapped by a monster who appears.

episodes.title: Sky-Flying Monster Musasabedol
episodes.overview: Shocker creates the monster Musasabidol to go after a new liquid fuel developed by Doctor Ookuma. Taki, who is visiting Hokkaido, discovers this plan, and after following Taki, Ichimonji confronts Musasabidol.

episodes.title: Deadly Poison Monster Kinokomolg's Sortie!
episodes.overview: After a prisoner is immersed in the extract of poisonous mushrooms for one week, the monster Kinokomorgue is born.

episodes.title: Defeat Kinokomolg!
episodes.overview: Kinokomorgue declares, “Make him taste the fear of death!” and injects the captured Ichimonji with the antidote, returning him to his senses.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Antlion
episodes.overview: While the monster Hell Thunder enacts his plan to make an artificial antlion pit that tears main roads into pieces, the supreme commander Colonel Zol is dispatched from Shocker's branch in the Middle East.

episodes.title: Mukadelas Monster Classroom
episodes.overview: Children are abducted by a suspicious man who calls himself a close friend of Kamen Rider. The man is the Shocker beast Mukaderas and he controls children with hypnotic radio waves for their scheme to turn them into members of Junior Shocker.

episodes.title: Underground Monster Mogurang
episodes.overview: Shocker schemes to turn Tokyo Bay into a sea of flames by pouring in petroleum from industrial areas, equipping the monster Mogurang with an Electro Eye that he uses to capture humans.

episodes.title: Electric Monster Kuragedall
episodes.overview: Shocker seeks humans capable of withstanding 5000 volts of electricity to make a resource of Electric Humans they can use to assassinate important figures, so Kuragedal who can release high-voltage currents is sent to capture people.

episodes.title: Revived Fossil, Bloodsucking Trilobite
episodes.overview: Doctor Shimura's research that can revive ancient lifeforms catches the eye of Shocker, who steal the ancient trilobite ressurected from a fossil and infuse it with the blood of a blood-sucking cyborg, creating the monster Zanbronzo.

episodes.title: Deathmatch! Anteater Demon Arigabari
episodes.overview: Mount Tengu is the test site for the bacteria, “Amazon's Curse,” of Shocker's monster Arigabari, and they attack the young man Izaki who visits the mountain.

episodes.title: Cannibalism Flower, Dokudalian
episodes.overview: The monster Dokudahlian is made from a man-eating flower that's lived for 200 years in the deep forests of New Guinea and he transforms into a florist who emits hypnosis sound waves.

episodes.title: Steel Monster, Armadillong
episodes.overview: Dispatched from Brazil, the monster Armadillong is given the order from the Chief, “Defeat my longtime enemy Rider,” before enacting his plan to destroy gas tanks.

episodes.title: Japan in Danger! Gamagiller's Invasion
episodes.overview: Doctor Origuchi of the Criminal Research Institute looks into Shocker's evil doing, and discovers their plan to split the Japanese islands with a special nuclear weapon.

episodes.title: Murderous Ant Queen, Archimedes
episodes.overview: Shocker's scientists succeed in producing a queen ant cyborg from an ant's egg. The created monster Archimedes attacks a bank with her powerful formic acid.

episodes.title: Resurrected Mummy Monster, Egyptus
episodes.overview: Shocker discovers a monster from the time of ancient Egypt in the pyramids, the mummy Egyptus.

episodes.title: Poisonous Gas Monster Trickabuto's G-Plan
episodes.overview: Shocker's newly developed killer plants are placed in theaters and concert halls as they scheme up the G Strategy to annihilate everyone.

episodes.title: Lightning Monster Eiking's World Darkness Plan
episodes.overview: Captured two years ago, the marine biologist Doctor Seki created the monster Rayking but flees Shocker and is rescued by Ichimonji and the others.

episodes.title: Monster Wolf Man's Huge Murder Party
episodes.overview: Colonel Zol executes his Wolf Strategy to make werewolves with the Wolf Virus. In the midst of this, the young girl Kumiko from the Wakakusa Garden orphanage witnesses one of these experimental wolfmen.

episodes.title: Deathmatch! Monster Snowman vs. Two Riders
episodes.overview: Doctor Reaper of Shocker's Swiss branch takes up a new post in the Japanese division. He makes plans to detonate Kirishima's volcanic belt by digging an underground tunnel between Kirishima and Sakurajima.

episodes.title: Magma Monster Ghoster, Decisive Battle at Sakurajima
episodes.overview: For the construction of a tunnel that connects Sakurajima and Ebi Heights, Doctor Reaper sends in the monster Ghoster.

episodes.title: The Devil's Messenger, Mysterious Fly Man
episodes.overview: Doctor Reaper captures a cold-hearted young man, who doesn't even care about committing a hit-and-run to a young boy, and remodels him into the Fly Man.

episodes.title: Mysterious Birdman Pranodon's Attack
episodes.overview: Emi of the Tachibana Racing Club is taken by Shocker, fitted with a transmitter and controlled by the monster Pranodon's hypnotism radio waves.

episodes.title: Graveyard Monster, Kabibinga
episodes.overview: The monster Moldbinga schemes to cultivate a killer mold that grows from the nourishment of humans and he attacks people in the graveyard near the hideout so he can conduct tests with his killer mold.

episodes.title: Monster Namewhale's Gas Explosion Plan
episodes.overview: Doctor Yajima develops an artificial brain that has the power to amplify the abilities of animals exponentially and keeps it to himself.

episodes.title: Showdown!! Snow Mountain Monster Bearconger
episodes.overview: Shocker plots their “Snow Strategy” to melt all of the snow of Kusatsu Heights and cause a great flood, and makes the physicist Doctor Mikawa manufacture an energy bomb that releases intense heat.

episodes.title: The Death-Calling Ice Devil Todogiller
episodes.overview: The monster Todogiller, who can fire a Freezing Shot that is 300 degrees below zero, freezes humans and Shocker turns them into cyborgs to execute their “Ice Strategy.”

episodes.title: Bloodsucking Marshes of Hiruguerilla
episodes.overview: With the blood-sucking leeches he controls the monster Leechguerilla absorbs the lifeblood of humans, and by injecting a green medicine into them he can change the humans he takes blood from into slaves.

episodes.title: Cannibalistic Monster, Isoginchack
episodes.overview: The old man Nakayama finds a vein of diamonds in the continent of Africa and sends the whereabouts of the vein to his grandchild written on a medal, but Shocker targets the vein as well.

episodes.title: Monster Kamestone's Murderous Aurora Program
episodes.overview: An aurora suddenly appears in the Tokyo skies. The many people who see this look towards it, and one by one they get brought in to hospitals.

episodes.title: Stone Monster Unicornos vs. Double Rider Kick
episodes.overview: Shocker infuses a unicorn brought back from a fossil with the blood of a fiendish man, creating the monster Unicornus. Unicornus turns Goro and others into fossils.

episodes.title: My Name is Mysterious Birdman Gilgalass
episodes.overview: Gilgalass transforms himself into a crow that can speak like a human, and attacks humans with the Dead Man Gas that turns them into homicidal maniacs.

episodes.title: Monster Jaguarman's Ready-to-Die Motorbike War
episodes.overview: Takeshi Hongo has to contend with both a new Shocker commander, Hell's Ambassador, and a plot to create chaos with a new cyborg who can control wild animals.

episodes.title: Sea Serpent Man of the Phantom Village
episodes.overview: Shocker sets up a training camp in a village in the mountains. The monster Sea Snake Man who was trained at the camp uses the sight-warping Prism Eye to execute victims.

episodes.title: Cockroach Man!! The Terrifying Bacterial Ad-Balloon
episodes.overview: Shocker develops a bacteria that ages biological cells. By putting the bacteria into the balls of a bowling alley, they conduct an experiment to rapidly age young people.

episodes.title: Amazon's Poison Butterfly Gireera
episodes.overview: The Shocker monster Gireera schemes to throw capsules packed with a deadly poison powder into Japan's national reservoirs for their “Poison Water Strategy”.

episodes.title: Tsuchigumo Man Poisonmondo
episodes.overview: Hongo's friend Sawada completes a liquid gunpowder that can melt any metal. The Shocker monster Poisonmondo targets this gunpowder.

episodes.title: Monster Poison Lizard, Duel in Fear Valley!!
episodes.overview: Doctor Ootaguro succeeds in developing the “Alpha Liquid,” a life revitalizing drug that can revive a dead organism.

episodes.title: The Bottomless Swamp Monster, Earthworm Man!
episodes.overview: From the only surviving earthworm of the Bikini Islands atomic bomb experiments Shocker creates Earthworm Man.

episodes.title: Mysterious Owl Man's Murderous X-Rays
episodes.overview: The Owl Man begins experimenting with the Murder X-Rays equipped in both of his eyes that can turn living things into bone.

episodes.title: Monster Catfishgiller's Electric Hell
episodes.overview: Doctor Reaper returns to Shocker's Japan branch of Katsugawa Island along with Catfishgiller who he remodeled from an electric catfish.

episodes.title: Monster Hedgehoras' Murder Skull Plan
episodes.overview: With the poison needles all over his body containing a killer virus that can melt humans, the monster Hedgehoras obliterates humans one after another.

episodes.title: Monster Rhinogang's Autorace of Death
episodes.overview: While Hongo and the others are training intensely with their sights set on winning the All Japan Motorcycle Championship, Rhinogang is dispatched from Shocker's Africa division.

episodes.title: Monster Cicadaminga's Song to Kill Everyone
episodes.overview: While catching cicadas, Naoki witnesses a murder by the Shocker monster Cicadaminga. Hongo protects Naoki and Shocker come to attack him, but he chases them back and has a confrontation with Cicadaminga.

episodes.title: Monster Dr. Insect and the Shocker School
episodes.overview: Deceiving them with the slogan, “Come catch Masked Rider and beetles!” Shocker kidnaps children to Mount Takao where Shocker's insect expert Beetlelong organizes a Shocker school and turns them into his pupils.

episodes.title: Shocker Graveyard, Revived Monsters
episodes.overview: The cyborg Longhornkid revives the monsters defeated by Rider to begin the “Devil Festival.” Through sacrifices, energy is given to Zanjio, Jaguarman, Poison Lizard Man, Hedgehoras and Rhinogang to achieve their resurrection.

episodes.title: The Shocker Leader Appears! Riders in Danger
episodes.overview: Hongou discovers an upcoming meeting between important Shocker branch chiefs, but that is not all the Leader has planned.

episodes.title: Doctor Shinigami, the True Meaning of Terror?
episodes.overview: Appearing in Japan once again, Doctor Reaper has a plan to destroy Japan by controlling a meteorite.

episodes.title: Monster Gillercricket's Claws of Impending Death
episodes.overview: The monster Gillercricket has the ability to transform humans he stabs with his poisonous red claws into murderous fiends with their own death claws.

episodes.title: Monster Electric-Guitarbotal's Fireball Attack
episodes.overview: Born from high voltage, the monster Electrifirefly receives orders from Ambassador Hell to steal all of the electricity inside Tokyo.

episodes.title: Monster Horseflygomes' Rokkoudai Mountain Pursuit
episodes.overview: Hongo and Taki receive communication from the FBI saying, “There are clues to Shocker in Kobe,” and so they secretly fly to Kobe in search of Shocker movement.

episodes.title: Vampiric Mosquilas vs. Two Riders
episodes.overview: The new monster Mosquilas comes from South America and plots to create a Shocker base in the Kii Peninsula.

episodes.title: Double Riders' Defeat! Shiomaneking
episodes.overview: Shocker's plans to establish a base on the southern tip of the Kii Peninsula obstructed, they use Crabking to abduct the oceanographer Doctor Sakai who dreams of an undersea farm.

episodes.title: Deadly Bloodsucking Fiends!! Good Luck, Rider Boys' Squad
episodes.overview: Tobei Tachibana becomes president and Taki acts as commanding officer of the Boys' Kamen Rider Squad that is formed. Around that time, there is an outbreak of multiple attacks at blood banks.

episodes.title: Poison Flower Monster Roseranga - The Secret of the House of Terror
episodes.overview: Taki arrives at the place where he received word of a Shocker sighting from the Boys' Rider Squad but is captured by the monster Roseranga.

episodes.title: Three Head of Generator Monster Seadragons!!
episodes.overview: Shocker packages the Seadragon monsters in “Strange Beast Monster Cans” and sends them into the homes of the Boys' Rider Squad members. The fully grown Seadragons begin attacking people with their high-voltage currents

episodes.title: Monster Newtgeth, Duel at the Farm of Hell!!
episodes.overview: Using his power to liquify his entire body, Shocker monster Newtgeth abducts many adult men to advance the construction of an underground airfield.

episodes.title: The Dreadful Urchindogma + The Phantom Monster
episodes.overview: The monster Urchindogma takes over the village near Tobei's hometown in order to raise a massive amount of Urchindogma eggs. When Tobei returns to his hometown to visit a grave, he protects a young boy who is attacked by Urchindogma for being a witness.

episodes.title: Hell Ambassador!! The True Meaning of Fear?
episodes.overview: Someone reports the Shocker monster Garagaranda's strategy to poison the water supply to Masked Rider. The Shocker Chief detects Ambassador Hell is the traitor and decides to execute him.

episodes.title: Gel-Shocker Appears! Kamen Rider's Last Day!
episodes.overview: With Ambassador Hell's defeat, Shocker's Japan division is abandoned. However the Shocker Chief adds the power of Africa's secret organization Geldam and forms the new organization Gel-Shocker.

episodes.title: Kamen Rider Dies Twice!
episodes.overview: Gel-Shocker's Scorpiolizard uses the Shocker scientists as the guinea pigs for an oxygen deprivation gas and eliminates them. However one scientist, Takashi, does escape. Scorpiolizard pursues Takashi and attacks his wife's hospital.

episodes.title: Monster Jellyfish Wolf, Dreadful Rush Hour
episodes.overview: Using Jellyfishwolf who can release 10 million volts of electric current, Gel-Shocker schemes to massacre people by bringing lightning down on Shinjuku station during rush hour.

episodes.title: Monster Inokabuton, Defeat the Rider With Crazy Gas
episodes.overview: Gel-Shocker remodels a death row inmate into the monster Boarbeetle. Boarbeetle possesses a madness gas and in order to succeed in their strategy to devastate Tokyo with a deadly poison gas.

episodes.title: Watch Out, Rider! Isoginjaguar's Hell Trap
episodes.overview: Isoginjaguar, reconstructed for the purpose of destroying Rider, abducts the girl Maki who is searching for her father. During the Boys Rider Squad's search for her they find Isoginjaguar's automobile, but it's a Gel-Shocker trap.

episodes.title: Sludge Monster, Dreadful Murder Smog
episodes.overview: Combining a viscious criminal with a moray eel and sea turtle that grew up in the sludge of Tago Inlet, Gel-Shocker produces Utsubogamesu.

episodes.title: Monster Eaglemantis' Human Hunt
episodes.overview: The Boys Rider Squad come to hike Mount Oomuro. Meanwhile, Gel-Shocker's Eaglemantis executes the human hunting strategy and attacks a bus headed for Mount Oomuro, abducting the passengers.

episodes.title: Gel-Shocker's Delivery Man of Death
episodes.overview: Gel-Shocker draws up a list of Japan's important figures to execute. The monster Kumolion delivers letters of advance notice for their deaths to these figures and then assassinates them one by one.

episodes.title: Bizarre! The Picture of the Black Cat That Calls for Blood
episodes.overview: Hongo consults with the young boy Satoru who is concerned about his older brother since he's become obsessed with painting a black cat, but at that moment, Nekoyamori appears out of the black cat paintings decorating the room.

episodes.title: Fear's Pet Strategy, Drop Rider into Hell!
episodes.overview: Gel-Shocker's Canarycobra transforms into a tiny canary and approaches people, then kills them with the deadly poison of his Cobra Hand.

episodes.title: Fear's Pet Strategy, Rider SOS
episodes.overview: After defeating Canarycobra, Nezucondor appears before Kamen Rider. Nezucondor carries the plague inside his body and impliments the pet strategy to spread it throughout Tokyo.

episodes.title: Gel-Shocker, Enroll in Terror School
episodes.overview: Hongo learns from the Boys Rider Squad members of strange occurances in the Tanzawa district and heads to the scene, but he is attacked there by Boys Gel-Shocker Squad.

episodes.title: Atrocity! Fake Kamen Rider!!
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider and Mukadetiger simultaneously vanish. At that time, the Gel-Shocker Chief determines the real identity of the Anti-Shocker Alliance that has continuously disrupted Gel-Shocker activity.

episodes.title: 8 Kamen Riders
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider #1 is driven back by the Shocker Rider and the monster Haetoribachi's coordination and sinks under the sea with Haetoribachi.

episodes.title: The True Identity of the Gel-Shocker Leader
episodes.overview: Wih the Anti-Shocker Alliance's back up, the double Riders are able to escape danger and take Raydokuga prisoner. Moreover, to defeat Shocker Rider, they begin special training under Tobei's tutelage.

episodes.title: Monster Garaox's Sky-Flying Car
episodes.overview: Gel-Shocker's Garaox uses his demon fog that can make objects float to attack vehicles. Hongo saves a man who is dropped from midair and questions how despite using a highway he wound up falling from the sky.

episodes.title: Takeshi Hongo, Cactus Monster Exposed!?
episodes.overview: The cactus research expert Doctor Matsuda is remodeled into Cactusbat. Cactusbat attacks the World Peace Committee's members and using the thorns on his arms he turns the people into cacti.

episodes.title: Takeshi Hongo, Transformation Impossible
episodes.overview: The Gel-Shocker monster Leechameleon uses the blood absorbed from humans to resurrect Ganikomol who once defeated Rider. Learning of this, Hongo embarks for the enemy's lair, but the revived Ganikomol is there waiting for him.

episodes.title: Gel-Shocker Annihilated! The End of the Leader!!
episodes.overview: With the arrival of Masked Rider #2 Hongo is rescued and the Double Riders showdown against Leechameleon.

episodes.title: Rider No. 3: His Name is V3!
episodes.overview: The hard-won peace obtained with the defeat of Gel-Shocker by Kamen Riders #1 and #2, is now shattered by a more powerful secret society known as Destron. Disposing of all those who witness their sinister movements, they target Shiro Kazami, a young motorcross racer. After Scissors Jaguar murders his family, Shiro vows vengeance and becomes Kamen Rider V3.

episodes.title: Last Testament of the Double Riders
episodes.overview: Destron's Scissors-Jaguar separates V3 from the Double Riders to allow Turtle Bazooka to vaporize Tokyo with the H-Bomb contained inside his body. Scissors Jaguar decoys Shiro and keeps him away from Turtle Bazooka. Can V3 warn Rider One and Two in time? Will V3 and the Double Riders stop the mutants before Tokyo is wiped off of the map?

episodes.title: The Execution of V3
episodes.overview: TV-Fly takes over a suburban hospital in order to create a new mutant specifically designed to defeat Kamen Rider V3. The new creature, Squid-Fire, manages to disrupt V3's power source and scores a victory for Destron. The mutant seals Kazami Shiro in a coffin, which is placed in a furnace! Can Shiro discover the extent of his powers in time to escape his own execution?

episodes.title: V3's 26 Secrets!?
episodes.overview: Hypnotizing Tachibana Tobei, TV-Fly orders him to kill Kazami Shiro, while Tama Junko also falls into his trap. Can Shiro stop Destron's evil plan? Will V3 unlock the secret of his 26 hidden techniques, in order to rescue his comrades and defeat Destron's mutants?

episodes.title: Snake-Man with a Machine Gun!
episodes.overview: An eminent biologist, Dr. Murayama, discovers a new clean energy source, and Destron's Machinegun-Snake is sent to seize the data. Failing to grab the doctor, he kidnaps assistant Nishizaki Michiko. When she refuses to talk, Machinegun-Snake targets Tsutomu, her son. Kazami Shiro is injured by the mutant! Can V3 protect Tsutomu, his friend Mamoru, and rescue his mother?

episodes.title: Enter, Hammer-Jellyfish! V3 Unleash Your Killing Technique!!
episodes.overview: Mamoru clings to life in a hospital, while his sister blames Kazami Shiro and betrays him to Destron. Hammer-Jellyfish continues the interrogation of Nishizaki and resorts to forcing the information out of her by dangling Tsutomu off of a high-rise. Will Nishizaki give in to Hammer-Jellyfish for her son's life? Can V3 defeat the powerful mutant and save them?

episodes.title: The Fury of Rider V3's Special Training
episodes.overview: Destron blows up the research facility of Professor Kawai, in order to secure his artificial heart technology in order to strengthen their mutants. Kawai's subject comes back to life, and as Knife-Armadillo, stalks the professor for revenge. The resilient mutant even repels V3 in battle! To improve his strength, will V3 survive the harsh rigors of his own brutal training session?

episodes.title: Watch Out, V3! Beware the Terrifying Buzzsaw
episodes.overview: While Kazami Shiro recovers in a hospital, the Rider Scouts search for Destron's outpost, while Buzzsaw-Lizard tries to persuade Kawai to resuscitate Knife-Armadillo, under pain of death. Refusing, he now must witness the execution of his family. Captured by Destron, Shiro hangs over a pool of acid! Can he escape their trap and transform into V3?

episodes.title: What is the Destron Hell Squad!?
episodes.overview: Kazami Shiro's rival, Yoshioka Masaru, and other top racers in the All Japan Motorcross Championship, are captured by Destron's Lens-Ant. He transforms them into the Destron Hell Squad in order to rob a convoy carrying a nuclear-powered satellite. The mutant also captures Junko and Shigeru! Will Shiro save his friends? Can V3 defeat not one, but two mutants, single-handedly?

episodes.title: Secret of the Double Typhoon
episodes.overview: Destron's Razor-Starfish teams up with Lens-Ant to attack V3, and they send the Hell Squad to steal a shipment of nuclear satellite fuel. Meanwhile, Tachibana Tobei and the Rider Scouts are captured while searching for Junko and Shigeru. Can Kazami Shiro find the antidote for the Hell Squad, rescue his friends from certain death, and take on both mutant cyborgs?

episodes.title: The Claws of Evil Reach Out for V3!!
episodes.overview: Destron forces Marine biologist Dr. Nakatani to create a powerful aquatic mutant, Pickaxe-Shark. The doctor escapes, but his creation is sent to kill him. Meanwhile, a chinpira exposes Kazami Shiro's secret identity to Junko, but is captured and transformed into Drill-Mole. As V3 battles Pickaxe-Shark in the open sea, Drill-Mole abducts Junko to force her into an unholy union!

episodes.title: Junko Becomes a Monster's Bride?!
episodes.overview: Destron's Pickaxe-Shark proves a formidable foe to V3, who suffers defeat at the claws of the mutant. Meanwhile, Junko is prepared for an unholy union with Drill-Mole... Can Kazami Shiro recover in time to defeat Pickaxe-Shark and rescue Junko from a fate worse than death � while guarding his secret identity?

episodes.title: Terrifying Commandant: Doktor G!
episodes.overview: A couple hikes into the mountains to research the secret of the legendary Boar-Man, but only the woman returns. Suspecting Destron, Kazami Shiro goes to the hospital, only to have the missing man reappear � a disguise for Magnet-Boar, who aims to destroy Japan's national railway system. After an intense fight, Shiro discovers that he cannot transform into V3! But, this was simply a ruse to allow the sinister Doktor G safe passage into Japan...

episodes.title: Secret Memento of the Double Riders
episodes.overview: Toad-Boiler attacks Interpol agent George Kamamoto, who is trying to pass on a coded document from Riders One and Two to Kazami Shiro. V3 saves Kamamoto, and then heads for Chichibu, as directed by the document. Toad-Boiler implores him to transform into V3, and then sprays him with a white fluid � a substance that drains V3's energy! Can V3 survive and obtain the secret left behind by the Double Riders?

episodes.title: Rider V3's Deadly Weakness!!
episodes.overview: The daughter of Dr. Okajima, an atomic physicist who escaped the clutches of Destron with the help of the Double Riders, saves the badly injured Kazami Shiro from the basin of a waterfall. She is then stalked by Burner-Bat, who is looking for V3. With the help of Dr. Okajima, Shiro is able to find the memento from the Double Riders, which holds the secret to V3's four weaknesses. What are they?

episodes.title: Gecko Monster With a Missile On His Back!
episodes.overview: Rider Scout Saburo and his father save a hapless fisherman, whom witnessed mutant Missile-Gecko in action. V3 fights off Missile-Gecko, but meanwhile, Destron snatches Saburo and his father. When Saburo discovers Destron's plot to destroy the petroleum complex, will he be able to contact Rider Scout HQ? Can V3 save Japan from plunging into total chaos?

episodes.title: The Devil Spray is the Reaper's Weapon
episodes.overview: The fearsome Spray-Rat takes on the likeness of a priest and finds a young couple to use as guinea pigs for his Devilspray virus. He offers to marry them, but only allows one witness � Tama Junko. Kazami Shiro arrives in the nick of time, but cannot prevent the groom from being infected. While rescuing the bride, V3 is trapped in a church with a ticking time bomb! Can V3 escape deadly doom?

episodes.title: V3, Beware the Fiendish Traitor!
episodes.overview: Kusarigama-Beetle captures Kazami Shiro and takes him to Destron's outpost. While Doktor G is torturing Shiro he breaks free and seizes the files for the Devilspray antidote � only to discover that it is a fake! V3 is ambushed by the Destron mutants, and in the heat of battle Spray-Rat attacks Kusarigama-Beetle. The injured mutant decides to betray Destron and help Shiro retrieve the antidote for the Devilspray. But, is V3 being lead into a trap?

episodes.title: Blowfish Apache's Operation: Torpedo!!
episodes.overview: Kazami Shiro rushes to Tatsunoko Point where Destron has been sinking passing ships, in a bid to seize control of the seas. After encountering Blowfish-Apache's torpedoes, Shiro discovers slaves working in a secret weapons factory. With the help of Tachibana Tobei, Shiro is able to penetrate the Destron outpost, but they are led into a deadly trap, and sunk to the bottom of the sea! Can V3 save Tachibana and stop Destron?

episodes.title: Operation: Destron Shikoku Conquest
episodes.overview: Destron uses the SS Device flown in from their South American base, in an attempt to conquer the island of Shikoku. Fukazawa, a scientist forced to work for Destron, manages to escape with the schematic. When Kazami Shiro receives word, he heads immediately for Shikoku via ship, but is attacked by Guillotine-Saurus. Can V3 break through and save Shikoku from Destron's grip?

episodes.title: The Double Riders Live
episodes.overview: V3 is saved by the voices of the Double Riders coming from a special medallion. In Shikoku, Kazami Shiro disguises himself as a Destron sympathizer to repair the SS Device. Meanwhile, Fukazawa, Tachibana Tobei and Tama Junko fall under the control of Syringe-Spider! Can V3 stop Doktor G's conquest plans and find the antidote to save his friends from the clutches of Destron?

episodes.title: Camp of Terror! Mystery of the Underground Canal
episodes.overview: The Rider Scouts are at training camp on Hatsushima Island, where mutant Speargun-Sea Lion has established an undersea outpost to manufacture poison gas. Destron plans to transport the chemical weapon via an underground canal to Mt. Fuji, where the winds will spread the gas over hundreds of miles. Kazami Shiro orders the scouts to evacuate, but they refuse when they realize one of them is missing. Can V3 stop Destron in time?

episodes.title: Terror! The Vampire From the Graveyard
episodes.overview: Propeller-Beetle begins kidnapping young people � the males are reconstructed into Destron Soldiers, while the blood of the females satisfies his energy source. When the monster hears the voice of the sister of Kazami Shiro's friend Kuroda Kyosuke, he retreats. When she discovers that her brother is really Propeller-Beetle, Doktor G orders the mutant to drink her blood. Kazami enters the Destron outpost when Junko is captured. Can V3 save them?

episodes.title: Mysterious! Cockroach Manor!!
episodes.overview: In order to wage germ warfare on Japan, Destron takes over the Osato Biological Institute and tortures the head scientist, to pillage his research. Meanwhile Rider Scout Yoshio notices that young women go into the institute but don't come out. So he snoops around to check things out, but is captured by Cockroach-Spike. Junko goes in to rescue him posing as a housekeeper, but is also caught spying. Can V3 thwart Destron's plot?

episodes.title: Mysterious!! The Destron Ranger Corps
episodes.overview: Rumors circulate of savage ape-men in the Omi Mountains, but this is a cover for training Destron's Ranger Squad units. In order to keep this secret Mantis-Merang kills anyone who approaches the area. V3 saves Rider Scout Kenji and his older brother from certain death, but the Destron Rangers soon surround them. Meanwhile, the 2nd Unit of the Destron Rangers starts tainting Tokyo's water supply with the deadly Mummification Virus�

episodes.title: Monster Heater-Cicada's Operation: Mummy
episodes.overview: With the Mummification Virus in Tokyo's water supply, Destron plans to turn 10 million people into mummies, using Heater-Cicada's chirp to drive victims to drink the tainted water. Kazami Shiro discovers that Professor Taguchi is the only person who can create an antidote and saves his daughter while trying to rescue Junko. But is the professor's daughter really who she says she is? Has Shiro fallen into a trap?

episodes.title: Zol, Death, Hell and Black Rise From the Grave
episodes.overview: Rider Scout Shotaro has discovered Shocker mutants entombed in a lakeside cave. When he arrives, the mutants are gone, but Kazami Shiro is ambushed by Destron's powerful Quoit-Beetle. Destron plots to destroy the whole of Japan by resurrecting former Shocker Commandants Colonel Zol, Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell and General Black, using a newly developed toxic gas called Girard Gamma. Suddenly, V3 is attacked by the revived Shocker mutants, led by Quit-Beetle!

episodes.title: The Five Commandant's All-Out Attack!
episodes.overview: Trapped by the five commandants Kazami Shiro falls into an unbreakable cell. Tachibana Tobei, in a bid to rescue Shiro, poses as a scientist who has developed an antidote to the nerve gas, and is abducted. Meanwhile, Shiro turns the table on Ambassador Hell and takes him hostage in order to escape. But, he must infiltrate the outpost once more in to rescue Tachibana and Junko. Can V3 save Japan, as well as his friends, from certain death?

episodes.title: Doktor G's Final Challenge!
episodes.overview: Held responsible for the death of the Shocker Commandants, Doktor G creates Camera-Mosquito, who steals people's faces in a last-ditch effort to take control of Japan. Meanwhile, Destron Hunter Sakuma Ken steals microfilm containing Destron secrets and becomes the target of Camera-Mosquito. Kazami Shiro saves Sakuma and takes the microfilm to Professor Tadokoro for decoding, but Camera-Mosquito has already stolen his face� Can V3 prevail?

episodes.title: Doktor G! The True Form of Evil is...?
episodes.overview: The Destron Hunters discover that the microfilm gives the location of a manufacturing plant where Destron creates their mutants. While they succeed in sabotaging the plant, Doktor G arrives to exterminate them, except for Sakuma Ken, who is saved by V3. Doktor G implores the Great Leader to allow him to destroy V3 personally, and transforms into Crab-Laser. Will this be the end of Destron� or Kamen Rider V3?

episodes.title: Enter, Baron Fang: Commandant of Curses!!
episodes.overview: The Great Leader summons Baron Fang, the great Doovoo shaman of the Tusk Tribe from the upper reaches of the Congo River, to become commandant of Destron Japan. His mutant Skull-Warthog uses his tusks to dissolve human flesh from their bones. In order to lure Kazami Shiro to his doom, Skull-Warthog possesses the body of Rider Scout Toshiko's father and kidnaps her mother. Shiro and Sakuma Ken come to her aide, but are soon surrounded by the villagers who fall under the sway of the Devil's Drums�

episodes.title: Spectre of Onibi Swamp: Rider Scouts Annihilated!?
episodes.overview: Given the task of destroying the Rider Scouts, Fireball-Walrus possesses Tachibana Tobei's old friend Ito, the manager of the mountain villa where the scouts go on retreat. When Junko discovers his true identity, she is also marked for death. When they are attacked, V3 comes to the rescue, but not only must he fight Fireball-Walrus, but he also comes face to face with Baron Fang. Who will triumph?

episodes.title: V3 in Danger! Riders One and Two Return!!
episodes.overview: Dr. Samukawa and his daughter Yumiko are put under pain of death by Snow-Wolf to assist Destron to pervert his scientific discovery. Baron Fang places a lycanthropic curse on Yumiko, which transforms her into a werewolf if they do not obey his will. She drugs Junko, Shigeru and Tachibana who are taken prisoner, while Snow-Wolf defeats Kazami Shiro. Frozen in an ice chamber Shiro is unable to transform into V3� who will save them?

episodes.title: Critical Moment! Baron Fang vs. Three Riders!!
episodes.overview: Baron Fang resurrects Smilodon the sorceress and ancient mother of the Tusk Tribe in order to destroy the Kamen Riders. Taking on the name Ayanokoji she delivers a voodoo doll that poisons Hongo Takeshi who is taken to a hospital. When Kazami Shiro rushes to the scene she attacks him as Primordial-Tiger, who manages to subdue V3 and locks him up with Hongo. She then targets Ichimonji Hayato� can Hayato free his comrades and best Smilodon?

episodes.title: Baron Fang's Final Transformation
episodes.overview: A Destron fugitive calls Rider Scouts HQ to reveal a sinister plot, but the line goes dead. Discovering a locker key at the scene, Kazami Shiro is ambushed by Bloodthirsty-Mammoth, but escapes. Shiro retrieves photographs of three members of parliament whom Baron Fang plans to brainwash in order to conquer Japan. So he disguises himself as one of the men and is taken to Destron's outpost. Can V3 stop Baron Fang's diabolical plot?

episodes.title: The Winged Corps: Demons of the Sky
episodes.overview: Destron summons Archbishop Wing and his clan from Tibet to take over where Baron Fang failed. Soon afterwards a strange Buddhist monk claims that evil spirits reside in the homes of the president of an industrial factory and the director of an atomic research facility � the evil spirits turn out to be mutant Flame-Condor. When V3 is injured in battle, Tachibana Tobei helps him to train against the airborne menace. Can V3 overcome the odds?

episodes.title: Mysterious Temple: Curse of the Musasabi Clan
episodes.overview: Archbishop Wing's Dryad-Flying Squirrel is able to turn a red fluid that he secretes from his claws, into a deadly gas that transforms humans into flying squirrel carcasses. His plan is to spread the gas far and wide in a violent eruption of Mt. Daisetsu. The mutant plans to use V3 to set off the explosives by kidnapping Shigeru, his cousin, and his grandfather. Will V3 trip the explosives or will he outwit Destron?

episodes.title: Lone V3 and Cub: Deadly Skydiving
episodes.overview: Mutant Poison-Mothla kills two power company workers who discover electricity being re-routed. Meanwhile, Destron captures the father of a young boy, Tsuyoshi, who stumbled upon their outpost. Kazami Shiro arrives to investigate the siphoned power, and finds the boy all alone. Trapped in the valley by Destron, V3 fights Poison-Mothla, but cannot defeat him. Can V3 find the creature's weakness and reunite father and son?

episodes.title: Terror of the Carnivorous Fauna Plantaingan!!
episodes.overview: Archbishop Wing plans to use the poison of the inhuman Plantaingan, combined with 30,000 volts of electricity, to create miniaturized people preserved for use in creating cyborgs. The mutant kidnaps a young boy's sister and Kazami Shiro must fight in order to save her. Plantaingan attacks Rider Scouts HQ to liquidate a captured Destron Soldier and threatens Tachibana Tobei and Company. Can V3 liberate them from the tendrils of death?

episodes.title: Sudden Death! V3 Mach Kick!!
episodes.overview: Destron mutant Deadman-Bat, employing a virus called the Himalayan Devil, turns the residents of apartment complexes in all the major cities into vampire slaves. When Rider Scout Kiyoshi discovers his older brother is one of the victims, he and Shigeru are attacked by the mutant. V3 challenges Deadman-Bat, but is tossed from the air and Kiyoshi is injured. Can V3 develop a new technique in order to defeat the true form of Archbishop Wing?

episodes.title: Oh! People Are Melting! Enter, Marshal Armor
episodes.overview: Summoned from Mongolia, Marshal Armor becomes the new commandant of Destron Japan and employs Nazi transplant technology to create the invulnerable Pumadillon. Marshal Armor releases a slave named Yamashita to contact Kazami Shiro to lure him into a trap. Kazami's old friend Takagi Yusuke work together to protect Yamashita and his family, but something is very wrong � Takagi begins to praise working for Destron�

episodes.title: The Snail Man's Human Experiments!
episodes.overview: Marshal Armor's Snailbura implants its sinister eggs into the residents of an apartment complex. These incubate in the victims' bloodstream developing into larvae to enslave them. Snailbura's first experiment is ordered to kill Kazami Shiro, but dies before she can complete her mission. Her sister Misako accuses Shiro of murder and Snailbura promises to give her the power to avenge her sibling's death�

episodes.title: Friend or Foe? The Mysterious Riderman
episodes.overview: Ambitious Destron scientist Yuki Joji is condemned to death by Marshal Armor, who sees him as a threat to his position in the organization. Slowly Yuki is lowered into a pool of sulfuric acid, losing his right arm before being rescued by his fellow scientists, who make a daring escape. Hidden away, Katagiri contacts his sister, who is a nurse, to assist in Yuki's cybernetic operation. But Destron is watching and sends Sickleneck-Tortoise to kill them�

episodes.title: V3 vs. Riderman
episodes.overview: V3 saves Riderman from Sickleneck-Tortoise's nerve gas in the nick of time. Regardless Riderman doesn't want to listen to V3's words against Destron � he only seeks revenge against Marshal Armor. Meanwhile, Marshal Armor begins his plan to spread the nerve gas and begins killing innocents throughout Tokyo, and while Kazami Shiro investigates with Yuki Joji right on his tail, Sickleneck-Tortoise stalks them both�

episodes.title: Destron's Christmas Present
episodes.overview: Marshal Armor sends mutant Rhino-Tank, disguised as Santa Claus, to lure children into the House of Good Fortune, in order to train them as future Destron commandants. Yuki Joji finds this disturbing and "Black Santa" offers to release the children if Joji will defeat V3. In order to save the children, he decides to fight V3 with Rhino-Tank. After the Mach Kick and the Hurricane Dash fail to faze the mutant, an industrial bulldozer slowly crushes V3�

episodes.title: Riderman, Where Will You Go?
episodes.overview: Pinned against a cliff by a bulldozer V3 uses his Reverse Double Typhoon to save himself and infiltrates the Destron outpost. He saves Yuki Joji who was trapped in an execution chamber, but Destron mercilessly pummels V3, who was injured in his battle with Rhino-Tank. Yuki finally sees Destron's cruelty, but will he rescue V3 or the kidnapped children? Which way will Riderman go�?

episodes.title: Ambush! The Destron Leader!!
episodes.overview: A New Year's card from Marshal Armor arrives for Yuki Joji, so he and Kazami Shiro investigate the return address. When they split up and enter the manor, Coelacanth-Kid attacks V3 and Riderman falls into Marshal Armor's hands. The mutant takes on Joji's form, becoming "Destron Riderman" in order to wipe out Shiro and the Rider Scouts. Shiro is tricked by the fake Joji and is thrown off of a cliff! Then the evil imposter makes his way to Rider Scouts HQ�

episodes.title: Look! The Face of the Destron Leader!!
episodes.overview: The Great Leader, overlord of Destron, arrives in Japan. When V3 and Riderman go after him, they fall into a trap. Meanwhile, Destron mutant Thorned-Starfish puts into action his plan to annihilate Tokyo. In the grip of suffocation, V3 and Riderman are saved when Tachibana Tobei comes to their aid. V3 and Riderman fight Thorned-Starfish, but when V3 turns to take on the Destron Leader, Riderman suddenly takes a stand to defend him�

episodes.title: A Gunshot Rings Out! Kazami Shiro Falls!!
episodes.overview: Destron mutant Chameleon shoots Yuki Joji, but Kazami Shiro takes the bullet. Soon Shiro becomes unable to control his strength and becomes a menace. Meanwhile, Chameleon's human form uses a naive country girl to ensnare the vulnerable Shiro. In order to remove the Vatal Bullet from Shiro's skull, they must infiltrate Destron's Tokyo outpost. But, Marshal Armor and Chameleon are waiting to welcome them�

episodes.title: A Little Friendship
episodes.overview: Mutant Chameleon is resurrected as Vampire-Chameleon and Marshal Armor sends him on a mission to collect the blood of innocent children. Kazami Shiro befriends young Kenichi, who is despondent because he believes that he has seen a mutant. When Vampire-Chameleon attacks Kenichi's grammar school, Shiro and Joji find themselves in a dilemma, when they face a horde of vampire children they cannot kill�

episodes.title: You Are Rider Number 4!!
episodes.overview: Marshal Armor has developed a powerful Pluton Rocket that is more powerful than the H-Bomb and the Great Leader orders that it be aimed at Tokyo. Shiro and Joji become suspicious when a group of mountaineers are killed mysteriously in a remote valley. While investigating, they are attacked by mutant Crawganna who protects the Destron missile base. But, V3 and Riderman fail to stop Marshal Armor from starting the cataclysmic countdown�

episodes.title: The Last Day of Destron
episodes.overview: The Great Leader initiates "Operation: D", a final, all-out offensive to seize control of Japan. Destron revives Deadman-Bat, Fireball-Walrus and Plantaingan who attack Rider Scouts HQ and kidnap Junko and the Scouts. Meanwhile, Kazami Shiro has discovered Destron's headquarters where dwells the Great Leader, but the mutants bury him in a mound of dampening powder made from special alloys. Even if V3 escapes their trap, Crawganna awaits�

episodes.title: X-X-X-Rider is Born!!
episodes.overview: G.O.D. a secret organization is planning to conquer the world but a new hero Kamen Rider X stands in their way.

episodes.title: Run, Cruiser! X Rider!!
episodes.overview: As Keisuke Jin is troubled by no longer being human, a mysterious sound causes everyone who hears it to become violently homicidal. Why is one child not affected? And what links him and the newly-born X-Rider?

episodes.title: The One-Eyed Monster's Human Review Operation!
The Japanese Island Fragmentation Plan!
episodes.overview: A mysterious bus falling accident. Sachiko, a girl who lost her parents due to the accident. Pittying Sachiko who was full of sadness, Keisuke Jin investigates the cause. Hovewever Sachiko was kidnapped by someone.

episodes.title: Mystery!? Little Earth - Middle Earth - Big Earth
The Invulnerable Water Snake Monster Hydra!
Apollo Geist - The Madness of Insect Hell
GOD's Secret Base! X Rider Sneaks In!!
Counterattacking Apollo Geist! X Rider in Danger!!
Scary! Humans are Being Made into Books!!
Scary! It's GOD's Cat Disguise Operation!!
The Corpses at the Ghost Mansion Call!!
A Monster!? The Mysterious Snake Man Appears!!
The Terrible Great Giant! King Dark Appears!!
Revenge Demon Geronimo! The Silent Attack!!
The Mysterious Thief, Rhinocerous Beetle Lupin!!
Special Edition, Full Force of Five Riders!!
Deathmatch!! X Rider vs. X Rider!!
I Want Blood! The Monster of the Corpse Swamp!!
Showdown! King Dark vs. X Rider
The Weapon of Terror Aims at Three Riders!!
Man or Beast? The Cool Guy Who Came From the Jungle!
episodes.overview: Daisuke Yamamoto, a young Japanese man raised in the wild Amazon jungle, is forced to become Kamen Rider Amazon to fight the Gedom, who are now eying Japan for conquest.

episodes.title: Ten-Faced Demon! God or Devil?
episodes.overview: Amazon faces the brunt of hatred after a battle with a Gedom monster hurts a girl caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: The Strong, Naked, Fast Guy!
episodes.overview: Amazon continues to face problems in society and be scorned for Gedom's actions just as he encounters a motorcyclist who wishes to help him.

episodes.title: Race! Jungler of Rage!!
episodes.overview: Amazon tracks down a colleague of Professor Okamura in hopes to find out more information about Gedom.

episodes.title: The Weirdo Who Came From Underground!!
episodes.overview: Amazon continues to bemoan his problems while being pursued by a strange beastman mole sent by Gedom.

episodes.title: The Inca Rope-Pattern Writing Mystery!!
episodes.overview: Amazon and Mole Beastman become further connected when protecting a mysterious Incan rope-message with the secret of Gedom.

episodes.title: Melt! Melt! The Terrifying Snake Beastman
episodes.overview: As Amazon battles Snake Beastman who was sent by Geddon to after Amazon through Hiromi and her biologist father, Professor Seichiro Arima.

episodes.title: The Crocodile Beastman Who Attacked the School
Go, Amazon! The Crab Beastman's Island!
Black Cat Beastman Aiming at the Nursery School!
The Golden Snail's the Reaper's Envoy!?
The Ten-Faced Demon Dies! And a New Enemy?
He Came Forth! The Terrible Great Emperor Zero
Garanda's Tokyo Sea of Flames Operation!!
Mt. Fuji's Big Explosion? Tokyo's Frying Pan Operation!
Zero's Terror! The Massive Earthquake Operation!!
Going into Action, The Garanda Juvenile Squad!!
Cannibal Beastman to Eat the Frozen Rider
Inca Doll's Day to Annihilate Greater Tokyo
You Did It, Amazon!! The End of Great Emperor Zero!!
I am the Electric Human Stronger!!
episodes.overview: The first episode of Kamen Rider Stronger. Unlike previous Kamen Rider Series premieres, and indeed the majority of those that would follow, it introduces the protagonist as already a Kamen Rider fighting evil, instead of showing him being thrown into the conflict and becoming a Rider. Stronger and Tackle's origin would be shown in the second episode.

episodes.title: The Secret of Stronger and Tackle!
episodes.overview: Shigeru Jo remembers how he started fighting Black Satan and became Stronger.

episodes.title: The Thriller House Calls for Children!!
The Demonic Motorbike Reckless Driving Operation!
The Jellyfish Machine Monster Who Took the Form of a Teacher!
Don't Melt, Rider! The Final Blow, Electro-Kick!!
The Band of Demons Has Come!!
The Frightful Gummer Bug! It Targets Humans!!
The One-Eyed Titan! The Final Counter Attack!!
The Appearance of Enigmatic Chief Executive Shadow!
Ghost Story: The Cursed Old Castle!
The Great Scary Desert! Two Toubeis!
Sharkshark Island, Decisive Battle in the Sea!
The Devil of the Underground Kingdom!!
Don't Die!! Shigeru Jou in the Electric Chair
Seen!! The Great Leader's True Identity!!
Remodelled Majin! The Delzer Army Appears!!
The Curse of Majin Kate's Blood!
Stronger Dies in the Full Moon!
The Man Who Returned! His Name is V3!!
Three Riders Vs. The Powerful Delzer Army!
A Cyborg Flies in the Sky
episodes.overview: Neo-Shocker attacks and a young man Hiroshi Tsukuba becomes Skyrider and protects the world from them.

episodes.title: Bizarre! Spidern Man
episodes.overview: Tsukuba fights to save a boy's older brother when Neo Shocker takes him to become another of their cyborg warriors.

episodes.title: It's Courage! The Fear of the Bat Flute
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must teach courage to a cowardly boy while trying to stop a Neo Shocker bat monster from abducting children for their plans.

episodes.title: Two Altered Humans, the Angry Rider Break
episodes.overview: Hiroshi discovers the horrible extent of Neo Shocker's monsters when he encounters a girl whose sister was abducted and transformed into a scorpion cyborg.

episodes.title: Fly, Ride on a Girl's Dreams
episodes.overview: When Neo Shocker downs a plane filled with passengers, Hiroshi must gain the guidance of the daughter of one of its passengers in order to find them.

episodes.title: Mushroom Man! The Devil's Hands are Cold
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must stop a Neo Shocker monster who has taken the disguise of a nurse trying to kill a little girl she is taking care of.

episodes.title: Mantis Man! The Dreadful Ceremony
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must stop a Neo Shocker monster from abducting two children needed to complete the hatching of an army of evil man-eating mantises that will consume Japan.

episodes.title: Centipeden Man's Trap! The Mysterious Operating Room
Cobran Man's Murder Army
episodes.overview: Tsukuba protects his karate teacher from a cobra kaijin who is building an army of brainwashed assassins for Neo Shocker.

episodes.title: Seen! Crabnger Man's Secret
episodes.overview: When an untrustworthy boy sees a Neo Shocker kaijin preparing to destroy a combine, he must convince those who don't believe him to save it.

episodes.title: Salaman Man! Escape from Hell Valley
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must save athletic children abducted by a kaijin to use them in a plot to murder government officials at a sports meet.

episodes.title: Dark Santa Claus; Ah, Transformation Impossible
Antlion Man, Tokyo Explodes Before 3:00
episodes.overview: Hiroshi races against time to prevent a powerful nuclear bomb from going off in Tokyo and killing millions.

episodes.title: Venus Flytrap Man, Masked Rider Close Call
episodes.overview: Hiroshi investigates an amusement park being used by a flytrap Kaijin to set up balloon bombs to poison Tokyo.

episodes.title: Dreadful Blue Mold Man's Big Tokyo Earthquake
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must stop a killer mold Kaijin from causing a massive earthquake while killing victims with its vegetative onslaught.

episodes.title: What is the Immortal Cockroach Man's G-Monster's True Identity
You Did It! The End of G-Monster
episodes.overview: General Monster abducts Hiroshi's friends and allies in a final attempt to humiliate and defeat Skyrider.

episodes.title: Admiral Majin's Great Electric Hell Operation
episodes.overview: Admiral Majin sends out a ray Kaijin to gain access to plans to destroy a power plant and cut off Tokyo's electricity.

episodes.title: Cover Your Ears Too! Wolf Man's Murderous Cry
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must stop a werewolf kaijin who steals a device to make his howls easy to assassinate enemies.

episodes.title: Two Kamen Riders, Who is Another
episodes.overview: Two powerful Neo Shocker kaijin come to Japan with competing plans and power to deal with Hiroshi, all while being watched by a familiar eye.

episodes.title: Enter Stronger; Two Riders Vs. Two Formidable Monsters
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider Stronger assists Skyrider in learning a new, more powerful move to defeat the powerful duo of Kurageron and Sai Dump.

episodes.title: Kogoensky Froze Tokyo 5 Seconds Ago
episodes.overview: Hiroshi faces against a yeti monster abducting kids to assist in a plot to freeze Tokyo with a missile.

episodes.title: Monster Flying Squirrel Brothers and Two Riders
episodes.overview: Hiroshi heads to Yokohama to foil a Neo Shocker plot, only to be joined by a fellow Rider when the plan turns into double the trouble.

episodes.title: Mosquito Man, Fear of Poison Gas
episodes.overview: A doctor develops a new gas which kills and reduces people down to the bone, forcing his sister to take drastic measures to stop his new weapon from being used by Neo Shocker.

episodes.title: Heavy! Heavy!! The 50-ton Baby
episodes.overview: Hiroshi becomes stuck with a bizarre Kaijin newborn used as part of a Neo Shocker plot to crush him with its immense weight.

episodes.title: Tank and Monster Generation II Corps, Full Force of Eight Riders

episodes.title: Eight Riders' Great Training of Friendship
episodes.overview: In order to defeat Gurand Bazarmy and prevent his magma bomb from destroying Japan, Hiroshi undertakes training with the Seven Legendary Riders to obtain a greater power.

episodes.title: First Appearance! Skyrider's Strengthened Finishing Move
episodes.overview: When Shigeru catches on to a mummy Kaijin's plot to turn children into monsters, Hiroshi must protect him and defeat the Neo Shocker agent from Egypt.

episodes.title: He Eats Dreams The Strange Boy Who Came From the Amazon
episodes.overview: A strange boy from Brazil arrives in Japan just as kids become attacked by a tapir kaijin that eats their dreams and makes them run wild.

episodes.title: Run, X Rider! Hiroshi Tsukuba! Don't Die!!
episodes.overview: Hiroshi is lured to rescue several children wandering near a worksite set up by Admiral Majin, while being assisted by Keisuke Jin and assaulted by two Neo Shocker kaijin!

episodes.title: Thank You, Keisuke Jin! Leave the Final Blow to Me!!
episodes.overview: The unified Skyrider and X-Rider fight to save those captured by Admiral Majin's temple operation before they become sacrifices to his evil god.

episodes.title: Hello! Riderman, be Careful of Nezura Man
episodes.overview: Hiroshi is joined by Joji Yuki in fighting to stop a rat Kaijin from using his deadly poisons from killing the populace.

episodes.title: Danger, Skyrider! He's Come! Kazami Shirou!!
episodes.overview: When a scientist and his daughter are abducted for Admiral Majin's plot to create new kaijin, Hiroshi pursues with the assistance of Shiro Kazami.

episodes.title: Kazami-sensei! I'll Get the Octopus Gang!!
episodes.overview: Hiroshi and Shiro rush to the rescue of the captured hostages to save them from Admiral Majin and the combined force of Madkong and Takogang.

episodes.title: Hurry, Ichimonji Hayato! Save the People Caught in Trees!!
episodes.overview: Hiroshi teams up with Hayato Ichimonji to save a town where Neo Shocker is transforming humans into trees.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Nakiri Village! Is Hiroshi also Caught in a Tree
episodes.overview: Skyrider and Rider #2 infiltrate Hyakki Village in order to defeat Kiginger and Dragon King and save all those mutated into humanoid trees.

episodes.overview: Hiroshi goes undercover to save a man who has unknowingly joined a Neo Shocker scheme to create new Ari Commandoes, only to need the assistance of Shigeru Jo to get out himself.

episodes.title: Help! Two Riders!! Mother Becomes a Demon
episodes.overview: While at a resort, Hiroshi and Hayato work to save a dancer and a powerful gem used by an oni kaijin to change women into demons like himself.

episodes.title: Chase, Hayato! The Kappa's Bowl Flies Through the Sky
episodes.overview: As girls are transformed into an army of Uni Demon's minions, Hiroshi and Hayato fight to save them and defeat both the oni and Okappa Priest's control.

episodes.title: Ghost Story Series - The Secret of the Phantom Building
episodes.overview: Hiroshi pursues Aki and Naoko after they vanish within an abandoned hospital that is stated to be haunted.

episodes.title: Ghost Story Series - Zombie! The Monster is Revived
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must come to the rescue of one of Shigeru's friends when he becomes captured by a weird doctor who can make the dead come back to life as zombies.

episodes.title: Ghost Story Series - Earless Yoshikazu's 999 Ears
episodes.overview: Hiroshi must save a boy abducted by a Neo Shocker kaijin disguised as an infamous demon priest who steals ears from victims.

episodes.title: Ghost Story Series - The Werecat Wants Children's Blood!
Ghost Story Series - The Snake Woman Curses Tsukuba Hiroshi!
episodes.overview: A mysterious woman puts a curse on Hiroshi, forcing him to find out why she has a grudge on him and her connection with an enemy he once faced.

episodes.title: Ghost Story Series - The Breakable Human! Fear of the Mirror's Center
episodes.overview: When Aki and other humans are replaced with evil glass duplicates from a world within mirrors, Hiroshi must track down the one behind their disappearances.

episodes.title: Skyrider's Greatest Weakness! Attack the 0.5 Second Blind Spot
episodes.overview: After careful study, Abunger puts into play a plot to wear down Hiroshi in order to exploit the weakness of the Sky Kick and thus defeat Skyrider.

episodes.title: Four Skyriders, Who is the Real One
episodes.overview: A Neo Shocker kaijin disguises himself as Skyrider in order to discredit Hiroshi, forcing him to defeat the fake and regain kids' trust.

episodes.title: Rocket Launch! Hiroshi Tsukuba Goes to the Space Graveyard
episodes.overview: When Aki is turned into a fossilized statue, Hiroshi investigates a temple being used as a base to ultimately launch Skyrider to his death in space.

episodes.title: You, Also Enlist in the Command Boys' Squad!
episodes.overview: A boy decides to try and join a Neo Shocker recruitment drive for a squadron of child Ari Commandos, forcing Hiroshi to try and stop the new method before it corrupts its young victims.

episodes.title: Neoshocker Red & White, Great Decisive Battle of Death
episodes.overview: A Neo Shocker monster uses special headbands to create brainwashed slaves to do its bidding, including to defeat Hiroshi.

episodes.title: Hiroshi's Father Had Lived! As Altered Human FX777
episodes.overview: Hiroshi storms through Neo Shocker's bases when he discovers that his family may be still alive and his father modified after being supposedly killed by the evil organization.

episodes.title: The End of Admiral Majin! And the Great Leader's True Identity
episodes.overview: Hiroshi fights Admiral Majin as he tries to find out the truth regarding what happened to his parents, even as the Great Leader prepares to finally take matters into its own hands!

episodes.title: Farewell, Tsukuba Hiroshi! Eight Heroes Forever....
episodes.overview: Hiroshi joins the Seven Legendary Riders in a final battle to defeat the Great Leader of Neo Shocker, forcing to overcome his tragedies in order to bring an end to the organization's reign of terror!
