episodes.overview: Kotaro Minami, a youth on the run from the mysterious organization known as Golgom, begins to awaken into a horrifying new form granted to them due to their greater plans for him; making him choose to use it instead to fight them as Kamen Rider Black.

episodes.title: The Monster Party
episodes.overview: Kotaro looks for his step-brother Nobuhiko Akizuki and plans to track down Golgom's headquarters.

episodes.title: Mysterious Cyborg Mystery
episodes.overview: Kotaro investigates a bizarre string of abductions in conjunction with a scheme by Bishium to bring him down.

episodes.title: The Devil's Laboratory
episodes.overview: A cycling friend of Kotaro becomes the subject of Golgom's mad doctor experimenting to find a weakness to their escaped subject.

episodes.title: Kotaro in a Maze!
episodes.overview: Kotaro investigates a town being brainwashed by a Goat kaijin, hoping to control it for Golgom to ruin an international peace conference.

episodes.title: The Secret Sight Enigma
episodes.overview: Kotaro must rescue two artists abducted by Golgom to become psychic spies in order to ruin the development of technology for civilization's collapse.

episodes.title: The Living Machine Restored
episodes.overview: A man who hates rampaging gangs is seduced by Golgom to gain the power to eliminate them, forcing Kotaro to rescue him for the sake of his sister.

episodes.title: The Devil's Trill Sonata
episodes.overview: Kotaro must save a musician girl whose feelings of failure lead to her becoming a member of Golgom's plot to control the world through music.

episodes.title: The Crimson Lips of Bishum
episodes.overview: When a girl makes a deal with Bishium to distribute strange pendants in order to help Golgom conquer the city, Kotaro tries to put a stop to this deception.

episodes.title: Where is Nobuhiko?
episodes.overview: Kotaro investigates suspicious auto accidents leading to the victims being used for Golgom's army for causing chaos throughout the world.

episodes.title: The Hungry Monsters
episodes.overview: The Gorgom's plan to grow fruit for their mutants causes plants to sprout on people all over the city.

episodes.title: A Super-Bike Legend Is Born!
episodes.overview: Kotaro discovers the whereabouts of a missing biker, who is raising his son to ride and protect the ultimate bike devised by his father.

episodes.title: Mama Raises Monster Babies!
episodes.overview: Gorgom kidnaps mothers to nurture its army of mutants, and BLACK finds himself facing an implacable enemy.

episodes.title: The Day All Tuna Vanished
episodes.overview: Kotaro fights to stop the abduction of tuna by Professor Kuromatsu in order to gain an extract to improve the power of the Golgom mutants.

episodes.title: Assault on a Haunted School
episodes.overview: Keisuke tries to stop a Golgom scheme of using schools to mold children into model students to assist in their control of Earth.

episodes.title: Friend From Across the Sea!
episodes.overview: Kotaro attempts to find the source of powerful earthquakes after meeting a mysterious man.

episodes.title: Kyoko's Mysterious Dream!
episodes.overview: Golgom manipulate the dreams of Nobuhiko's sister Kyoko in order to use her life energy to save an ailing Shadow Moon.

episodes.title: Sword Saint Birugenia!!
episodes.overview: Golgom's Creation King forces the release of a powerful yet rebellious swordsman, who decides to try and take down Kotaro on his own terms.

episodes.title: The Suffocating Trap of Hell
episodes.overview: Bilgenia takes the guise of the doomed Professor Kuromatsu in order to lead Kotaro into a trap for his defeat.

episodes.title: Clash! Super Machines
episodes.overview: Bishium uses a Mutant to infect Battle Hopper with insects that make it run wild and ignore Kotaro's commands.

episodes.title: The Shadow That Stalks Dad
episodes.overview: A boy with psychic powers becomes forewarned into thinking that Kotaro is going to harm his father even as Golgom is secretly using him.

episodes.title: Marmo's Magical Powers
episodes.overview: When a head of a two-headed ammonite Mutant becomes detached by Kamen Rider Black, it ends up with a kid where it becomes his new pet.

episodes.title: The Female College Student's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Kotaro must save Katsumi and other college girls from a professor turned Golgom Mutant hoping to add more females to the mutant army.

episodes.title: Rescue the ESPer Girl
episodes.overview: A Golgom Mutant takes advantage of a girl's obsession to become strong to give her super-strength but ultimately takes control of her forcing Kotaro to save her.

episodes.title: The Fire Breathing Danger Road
episodes.overview: Kotaro must avoid the dangers of the Golgom priests and an electricity controlling Mutant in order to restore power for a kid who needs vital surgery.

episodes.title: The Scarab Beetle's Invitation to Hell
episodes.overview: Bilgenia uses a scarab beetle Mutant to create a craze for its minions, forcing Kotaro into a corner in trying to stem this greedy obsession.

episodes.title: The Targeted Death Mask
episodes.overview: Kotaro must rescue four Japanese astronauts when they're abducted and replaced with doll-like clones controlled by a Golgom Mutant.

episodes.title: Aloha to the Assassin!
episodes.overview: When a special female assassin is created by Golgom in Hawaii and sent to Japan to go after Kotaro, Kazuya Taki returns to help deal with protecting them.

episodes.title: Burn! Boy Warriors
episodes.overview: The Golgom Boy Warriors reunite with Kotaro to help save children being abducted by Golgom to create a new, stronger generation of child warriors.

episodes.title: Father, Son, and the River of Love
episodes.overview: Kotaro must help a boy realize he can walk again even while trying to stop a Golgom plot of manipulating a river to cause chaos.

episodes.title: Revival? The Prince of Hell
episodes.overview: When the Golgom Priests abduct Kyoko to speed up the revival of Shadow Moon, Bilgenia decides to take the weapon of the Century King to prove superiority and to defeat Kamen Rider Black before his rival can be born.

episodes.title: Fight! The Two Princes
episodes.overview: With Kotaro barely escaping from Bilgenia, the Golgom swordsman rampages to force Black into a final showdown, hoping to stop him even as Shadow Moon finally awakens.

episodes.title: The War Declaration of Love and Death
episodes.overview: As Kotaro and Kyoko cope with Nobuhiko's transformation into Shadow Moon, the new Golgom leader transforms his commanders to declare the start of Golgom's conquest of Earth.

episodes.title: Memories in the Yubari Sky
episodes.overview: A Mutant attack on a friend's wedding in Hokkaido leads to Katsumi becoming Golgom's tool, forcing Kotaro to pursue them in order to save her from their grasp.

episodes.title: Mystery? EP-Party Boy Squad
episodes.overview: When Golgom creates a new political party claiming they'll bring about peace, Kotaro investigates and discovers a nefarious plot using this guise.

episodes.title: The Idol's Evil Power
episodes.overview: Bishium uses the identity of a girl to turn a mutant into an idol hypnotizing her fans into Golgom's mentality while tricking Kotaro into believing she is still innocent.

episodes.title: The Karate Master's Secret
episodes.overview: In pursuit of a destructive Salamander Mutant, Kotaro encounters a peculiar karate master in the woods training a boy to be a fighter.

episodes.title: The Dangerous Time Thief
episodes.overview: A boy brooding over his father's murder by Golgom becomes abducted by two samurai thrown out of time by a Mutant's magic time-controlling box.

episodes.title: Tokyo Mutant Gathering
episodes.overview: Kotaro meets two brothers, Makoto and Yuki who has psychic powers which Yuki gets kidnap by Fly Mutant to bring the Phantom Mutants to life and begins a invasion of Tokyo. Kotaro tries to fight back and only to find the Phantom Monsters tuern themselves incorporeal to avoid his attacks! Will Kotaro find a way of how to end this madness, once and for all?

episodes.title: The Mutant Farm Battle
episodes.overview: Kotaro investigates the claim of a child that something strange is happening at his apartment, leading to a discovery of its inhabitants being used to create new mutants for Golgom!

episodes.title: An Ocean Inside the Closet
episodes.overview: A boy accidentally intercepts a signal associated with Baraom's warp device, forcing Kotaro to protect him and stop Golgom's plan to use it to sink Japan.

episodes.title: Death of Flower Mutant Bishium
episodes.overview: Bishium uses a plot to turn women against their nurturing nature to lure Kotaro into a trap where he must face her in a final showdown where allegiances are tested.

episodes.title: Fierce Death of Baraom
episodes.overview: With the death of Biishum, Baraom decides to battle Kotaro one last time in vengeance, while the beginning of an unnatural phenomenon forces Shadow Moon to make his move towards Black's King Stone!

episodes.title: Rider Dies!
episodes.overview: With a limited time before the end of the Creation King, Kotaro and Shadow Moon are forced to finally have their ultimate showdown, where only one will be victorious...

episodes.title: A Bouquet of Reminiscence to the Sea
episodes.overview: With Kotaro dead and Golgom standing victorious over a burning Japan, Kyoko and Katsumi try to survive until they escape their home, even as a miraculous event is occurring within the ocean...

episodes.title: Fierce Battle! Death of Darom
episodes.overview: Reviving from his defeat against Shadow Moon, Kotaro discovers the current state of Japan since Golgom's victory as Darom targets his elimination to complete Shadow Moon's final ascension.

episodes.title: What is the Creation King's True Form?
episodes.overview: Finally reaching Golgom's headquarters, Kotaro confronts Shadow Moon a final time as the Creation King forces the former brothers to complete their final showdown.

episodes.title: Gorgom's Last Day
episodes.overview: The final battle between Black Sun and Shadow Moon comes to a bittersweet end as the final fate of Kotaro, Nobuhiko, and the Creation King is finally determined.

episodes.title: Child of the Sun! RX
episodes.overview: Some time after the defeat of Gorgom, Kohtaro Minami attempts to create a new life for himself in peace. But when the Crisis Empire arrives to conquer Earth, they come prepared to deal with the hero; forcing him to awaken a new power to face this new threat.

episodes.title: Bathed in Light! RX
episodes.overview: Kohtaro begins to realize the new power he has gained by becoming Kamen Rider Black RX, even as a robotic member of the Crisis Empire has him targeted for battle.

episodes.title: RX vs. the Knight of the Wind
episodes.overview: In order to save the son of the Sahara Family from a wind-controlling knight, Kohtaro must travel to the Demon World where he discovers the truth about the realm of the Crisis Emperor.

episodes.title: The Cave Exploration's Falling Hole
episodes.overview: Shigeru and Reiko become caught by Bosgun's moth monster, where Kohtaro has an hour to save them before they mutate into his minions.

episodes.title: The Kaima Extraterrestrials' Great Riot!
episodes.overview: Shigeru befriends a strange extraterrestrial sent by Gedorian to impregnate and ultimately overrun Earth in their numbers.

episodes.title: SOS! The Circle of Friendship
episodes.overview: When a friend discovers plans for a massive Crisis poison gas weapon, Kohtaro must come to his aid and protect him while preventing the plans from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: Dad's And Mom's Secret
episodes.overview: A girl who suddenly becomes a genius becomes the target for the Crisis Empire due to a secret kept from her by her parents regarding who she really is.

episodes.title: Maribaron's Witchcraft
episodes.overview: Maribaron decides to use one of Gedorian's weaker monsters to assist in a plot to brainwash humanity by manipulating the purity of a cactus-loving girl.

episodes.title: Surprised With Replicas
episodes.overview: A monster replaces Shigeru with a perfect clone in a plot by Maribaron to replace all of Kohtaro's friends and allies in order to estrange him.

episodes.title: The Scraps' Revolt
episodes.overview: Gatezone employs an extremely powerful yet extremely rebellious member of his machine army to use his machine-controlling powers to defeat Kohtaro for the Crisis Empire.

episodes.title: The Assassin in Dreams
episodes.overview: A Crisis monster is brought in to manipulate Reiko's dreams to use her to draw suspicion against Kohtaro and thus use her against RX.

episodes.title: The Targeted Kaima Girl
episodes.overview: Shigeru finds a strange green stone needed by the Crisis Empire to activate their new dimension-switching device as the daughter of the scientist behind it pursues him to get it back.

episodes.title: The Kidnapped Hitomi-chan
episodes.overview: When Maribaron accidentally kills the Crisis Emperor's cloned daughter, she decides to fix her mistake by abducting the Sahara daughter Hitomi as her replacement.

episodes.title: Robo Rider Is Born
episodes.overview: Pursuing Maribaron and Hitomi in the Demon World, Kohtaro is forced to fight against the assumed traitor Deathgaron, leading to a sorrowful encounter that awakens a new power in RX.

episodes.title: The Miraculous Valley's Princess
episodes.overview: While still pursuing Hitomi, Kohtaro encounters a strange cyborg who wishes to work on his side, but is under the control of a harsh, mind-controlling warrior of the Crisis Empire.

episodes.title: Bio Rider!
episodes.overview: With Hitomi fully transformed into Princess Garonia, Kohtaro has to figure out a way to finally resurrect her memories and save her before he, Shigeru and Joe the Haze are executed by Maribaron's pawn.

episodes.title: The Mystery! Swimming in the Air of Dreams
episodes.overview: Kohtaro takes on Gedorian's Crisis monster mutating kids while giving them the delusion that they're flying squirrels.

episodes.title: The Artificial Sun of Terror!
episodes.overview: Crisis creates a second sun over Tokyo, forcing the city to burn unless a scientist can develop a special magnetic gun that can eliminate the threat while under Kohtaro's protection.

episodes.title: Omen
episodes.overview: At the scene of a massacre on a water bus caused by Unidentified Lifeforms, a suspicious person with a neck tattoo is arrested.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.overview: Yusuke survives the grip of death and defeats Unidentified Lifeform #26, mushroom-type monster Me-Ginoga-De, and to have his body looked over, together he and Ichijo visit Tsubaki.

episodes.title: Game
episodes.overview: The fight between Kuuga and Unidentified Lifeform #3, bat-type monster Zu-Gooma-Gu, is interrupted by a mysterious rider.

episodes.title: Uneasiness
episodes.overview: Recently Yusuke has noticed a shocking sensation like an electric current rippling inside his body while he fights Unidentified Lifeforms, and to solve this mystery he asks Sakurako to decipher more inscriptions

episodes.title: Strengthening
episodes.overview: In the face off with Unidentified Lifeform #36, praying mantis-type monster Me-Garima-Ba, Kuuga fights with the TryGoram but its knockout attack doesn't work on Me-Garima-Ba.

episodes.title: Wandering
episodes.overview: It's been one month since Purple Kuuga changed into a stronger form.

episodes.title: Myself
episodes.overview: Yusuke as Kuuga becomes Rising Pegasus and fires an air arrow but is unable to deal the finishing blow to Unidentified Lifeform #37, owl-type monster Go-Buuro-Gu, and his transformation is undone from losing all his energy.

episodes.title: Ripple
episodes.overview: It's a day during the summer. Yusuke and Sakurako tend the shop while the owner, Nana, Minori and Minori's coworker Ayako go out to a pool.

episodes.title: Clarification
episodes.overview: It's a day during the summer. Yusuke and Sakurako tend the shop while the owner, Nana, Minori and Minori's coworker Ayako go out to a pool.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.overview: During a discussion between Yusuke, Ichijo and Tsubaki, they confirm that Kuuga's golden power is produced by the magical artifact inside Yusuke's body, the Amadam, in response to his intent to want to become stronger.

episodes.title: Fate
episodes.overview: Kuuga falls before the powerful enemy shark-type monster Go-Gamego-Re and Yusuke is taken to Tsubaki's side.

episodes.title: Retaliation
episodes.overview: With the golden power of his red form, Yusuke defeats Unidentified Lifeform #39, shark-type monster Go-Gamego-Re but the media and police department emphasize that the enormous damage caused by #39's giant explosion was due to #4's independent actions.

episodes.title: Trouble
episodes.overview: With the golden power of his red form, Yusuke defeats Unidentified Lifeform #39, shark-type monster Go-Gamego-Re but the media and police department emphasize that the enormous damage caused by #39's giant explosion was due to #4's independent actions.

episodes.title: Cooperation
episodes.overview: The TryChaser2000 is forced to finally be retired due to the metal fatigue of combining with Goram and the battle with grasshopper-type monster Go-Badaa-Ba.

episodes.title: Tremble
episodes.overview: A case breaks out of consecutive mysterious deaths of Midorikawa Academy second year boy students.

episodes.title: Emotion
episodes.overview: Unidentified Lifeform #42, porcupine-type monster Go-Jaraji-Da, is given the rule to kill Midorikawa Academy's second year boy students and repeatedly murders.

episodes.title: Complication
episodes.overview: Sakurako studies the letters drawn in blood that were left at the scene of Unidentified Lifeform murder cases, and tells Ichijo who has arrived in Nagano that those letters were originally of the Gurongi alphabet.

episodes.title: Approach
episodes.overview: While Sakurako at Shinano University examines the characters for 'warrior' carved on the restored ruins, Yusuke and Sakurai's force are running about Tokyo after the appearance of Unidentified Lifeforms #3 Zu-Gooma-Gu and #43 Go-Zazaru-Ba.

episodes.title: Transition
episodes.overview: Ichijo is injured by the woman with a rose tattoo and taken to Kanto Medical University. Thinking he has to do his best on Ichijo's behalf as well, Yusuke ruminates on the rules of Unidentified Lifeform #43 Go-Zazaru-Ba's game.

episodes.title: Gooma
episodes.overview: Unidentified Lifeform #43 Go-Zazaru-Ba continues the murder game within the city and Unidentified Lifeform #3 Zu-Gooma-Gu rampages in Chiba prefecture.

episodes.title: Impulse
episodes.overview: While Unidentified Lifeform #0 continues slaughtering a great number of other Lifeforms, Yusuke, Sakurako, Ichijo, Hikari and others all gather at Jonan University and report the results of each of their investigations.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.overview: Kuuga approaches Unidentified Lifeform #44, shark-type monster Go-Jaaza-Gi, but he is injured when Go-Jaaza-gi attacks suddenly from the sea.

episodes.title: Battlefield
episodes.overview: Unidentified Lifeform #45, buffalo-type monster Go-Baberu-Da appears, and a massacre larger than any others so far unfolds throughout the city.

episodes.title: Reality
episodes.overview: Unidentified Lifeform #45, buffalo-type monster Go-Baberu-Da is defeated, and in the brief moment of peace he's given, Ichijo heads to Mika Natsume's flute competition.

episodes.title: Crisis
episodes.overview: In response to the Unidentified Lifeforms who are growing stronger one after another, the combined police force feels a growing sense of danger and tasks Hikari Enokida of the Police Science Division with making countermeasures.

episodes.title: Enemy
episodes.overview: Finally Unidentified Lifeform #46, rhino beetle-type monster Go-Gadoru-Ba begins the Gegeru.

episodes.title: Indomitable
episodes.overview: Yusuke has been trying to enhance his golden power even further for the fierce battle with #0 he expects to have, and just then becomes able to control that golden power to defeat Unidentified Lifeform #46, rhino beetle-type monster Go-Gadoru-Ba.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.overview: Through the efforts of Kuuga and the police, Unidentified Lifeform #46 Go-Gadoru-Ba is defeated. However it simultaneously means #0 will bring forth the ultimate darkness.

episodes.title: Kuuga
episodes.overview: Yusuke resolves to become the 'dreadful warrior' in order to defeat #0, and before that final deciding battle, he rides his bike through the unrelenting downpour to give thanks once again to all the people who supported him.

episodes.title: Yusuke
episodes.overview: To defeat the one who brings the ultimate darkness, N-Daguba-Zeba, Yusuke transforms into the Ultimate Form, the dreadful warrior. Staining the brilliant white snow field with crimson blood in this literal fight to the death, at last the conclusion is reached.

episodes.title: The Warrior's Awakening
episodes.overview: To take preventive measures against further atrocities caused by the Unidentified Life Forms, the police introduce the G3 unit. But when it is time to fight the murderous Pantheras Luteus, the G3 falls short to the power of Agito.

episodes.title: Blue Storm
episodes.overview:
After the murders of the Saeki family, Makoto Hikawa decides to do some digging into the photo he found of the son, Nobuhiko. Halfway through his investigation two more "Unknowns" appear.

At the same time Shoichi Tsugami, who is trying to get along with his adoptive family, falls into a trance-like state and becomes the Kamen Rider Agito.

episodes.title: My Transformation
episodes.overview:
Agito turns on G3 after defeating Pantheras Albus and Pantheras Tristis, damaging the G3's suit severely. The police have no choice but to label Agito dangerous.

Shoichi Tsugami comes to grips with his situation and declares that he must "protect the place where he belongs".

Ryo Ashihara finally awakens from his critical state to quit the swim team and go rogue.

episodes.title: Puzzle Decoding
episodes.overview:
The O-Parts lab finally unwound the ancient puzzle, revealing a mysterious DNA model, and they try to replicate the DNA.

Shoichi Tsugami decides to leave home after being seen transforming into Agito by Mana Kazaya.

Ryo Ashihara's swim coach tracks down his star swimmer and Ryo decides to "show him everything".

episodes.title: The Third Warrior
episodes.overview:
The O-Parts lab has been disassembeld after the DNA baby escaped, leaving more questions than answers.

Ryo Ashihara, after being distanced from his swim coach, tries to get back together with his former girlfriend Mayumi Kitahira, Mana Kazaya's new math tutor, as a way to keep him grounded as he tries to figure out what is happening to him.

episodes.title: Sorrowful Monstrous Fist
episodes.overview:
After being saved by Agito from the two snake Unknowns and seeing Ryo Ashihara accidentally change into Kamen Rider Gills Mayumi Kitahira decides she must put distance between herself and her former boyfriend.

Seeing her leave Ryo decides to put his transformation to the test, but he must battle the monster within himself.

episodes.title: A Piece of a Memory
episodes.overview:
After defeating one of the Snake Unknowns Ryo Ashihara goes into shock due to the recoil of his powers and is abducted by the DNA child.

Makoto Hikawa's supervisors feel that they must rethink Makoto operating the G3 unit and have suspended all operations of the G3-System. Makoto reflects on the incident that led to him becoming G3.

Mana touches Shoichi Tsugami's head when he collapses and accidentally dives into his memory with her powers, discovering a terrible connection between him and her late father.

episodes.title: Sword of Red Flames
episodes.overview:
Mana Kazaya distances herself with Shouichi while she sorts out what she saw in his memories.

Agito unleashes a new power in order to stop the Corvus Croccio Unknown from causing anymore casualties.

The police department finally decides what action to take with the G3-System.

episodes.title: The Two G3s
episodes.overview:
The OverLord has fully matured and vanishes, leaving a frightened Gills wondering why he should be so scared.

Toru Hojo has succeeded in becoming the G3-System operator and is out to prove that he can not only defeat the Unknowns but capture Agito.

Shoichi Tsugami bumps into someone who says she knowns who he is, but she seems to be hiding something dangerous.

episodes.title: Silver Points and Lines
episodes.overview:
Shoichi Tsugami has been taken into questioning for the murder of the woman he was suppose to meet, Tomoko Miura. In order to prove his innocence Mana Kazaya must use her psychic abilities to find the true culprit.

Ryo Ashihara learns about his father's death, who up until now has been missing.

The octopus Unknown, Mollipes Octipes, that melted after the battle with Toru Hojo, comes back to finish the job.

episodes.title: The Past Tied Together
episodes.overview:
Toru Hojo flees the battle with the octopus Unknown after his attacks fail to work, abandoning the G3 suit and leaving Agito to defeat the Unknown.

Shouichi and Mana decide to track down a friend of Tomoko Miura who may or may not know about Shouichi's past.

Ryo Ashihara discovers a notebook in his father's belongings full of names and tries to figure out what his father was working on before he passed away.

episodes.title: The Crash in the Lake!
episodes.overview:
Due to his excellent deduction work and saving a woman, with some help from Agito, from a pair of Unknowns Makoto Hikawa is once again instated as the operator of the G3 unit.

Saeko Shinohara tells Shouichi and Ryo that there are ruins of an ancient civilization in the nearby lake and that the people of the civilization use to revere a warrior whose mark bears a similar resemblance to Agito's mask. Unfortunately, Saeko seems to have closed herself off to other people after the Akatsuki incident.

episodes.title: Dad's Clue
episodes.overview:
The OverLord has been declared mentally unstable and was moved from the jail cell to a hospital, where he is paid a visit by a mysterious man.

At the same time Koji Kono and Makoto Hikawa walk though Professor Nobuyuki Kazaya's murder.

Shouichi and Taichi try to figure out what to do for Mana's birthday.

episodes.title: The Strongest Kick
episodes.overview:
G3 comes to the rescue after Shouichi is stung by the scorpion Unknown. The diagnosis is that Shouichi only has 24 hours to live, he decides to live out his day normally telling Makoto Hikawa that he just dosen't feel like he is going to die.

Ryo Ashihara continues with the list in his father's notebook but comes up short.

The G3 team takes a further look into the ball and VHS tape hidden by Professor Nobuyuki Kazaya.

episodes.title: A Trap Begins
episodes.overview:
With the help of The OverLord Shouichi defeats the scorpion Unknown and lives to see another day.

Toru Hojo has received permission to capture Agito, but not to the extreme measures he wanted.

Taichi falls ill and a woman claiming to be a housekeeper, hired by Professor Misugi for while he is away, treats him back to health.

episodes.title: A Suspicious Woman…
episodes.overview:
The Misugi household's new housekeeper, Aki Sakaki, is confronted by Ryo Ashihara because her name is in his father's notebook. Unfortunately for Ryo she claims she knows nothing, but he doesn't believe her and follows her.

After becoming closer to Shouichi and Taichi, Aki becomes the target of an Unknown... and Mana's wrath.

episodes.title: Capture Tactics!
episodes.overview:
Ryo Ashihara is ever persistent and keeps pushing Aki Sakaki about what happened to his father on the Akatsuki-go.

Mana still believes that Aki is not Shouichi's girlfriend but despite her wishes Shouichi becomes enticed with the idea of having a girlfirend, even if he can't remember her.

Toru Hojo puts his team in place to capture Agito, but will it be enough?

episodes.title: The New Boss
episodes.overview:
Kamen Rider Gills is left for dead after being assaulted by Toru Hojo's firing squad and G3's attack.

Shouichi decides to live at Aki Sakaki's house while she's gone.

Due to the lack of progress in anti-Unknown defense the police decide to bring in Toru's ex-partner Ryuji Tsukasa to head the G3 team.

episodes.title: Breakup Decision?
episodes.overview:
Shouichi decides to take over the bakery he works at when his boss, Sashi Hanamura, is murdered.

Ryuji Tsukasa convinces the police department that the current G3 team should be disbanded and a new one should be made with him at the helm.

Toru Hojo figures out that Hanamura's death was not caused by an Unknown but by a human making it look like an Unknown.

episodes.title: That Awakening
episodes.overview:
Ryo Ashihara remains in critical condition but is being cared for by Shoichi Tsugami. The OverLord imparts a portion of his power to Tetsuya Sawaki after Tetsuya sees what humanity has to show him.

Aki Sakaki's powers awaken nine months after the Akatsuki-go incident. She uses her new found powers to hunt the members of the Agito Capture plan.

episodes.title: Rampaging Power
episodes.overview:
Thinking that Ryo Ashihara is dead Aki Sakaki goes after the Agito Capture team for vengeance. Ryo awakens to a voice in his head and finds Shoichi Tsugami living in Aki's house.

With proof of people who have supernatural powers the G3 team starts connecting the dots to why the Unknown attack people.

episodes.title: Fateful Showdown
episodes.overview:
Seeing Aki Sakaki dead in the hands of Agito, Ryo Ashihara mistakenly believes he killed her and attacks Agito as Gills. Agito, Gills, and G3 have a heated battle resulting in the G3-System being damaged far beyond repair.

After the battle the police department say that the new G3-System, G3-X, will have to compete against Toru Hojo's new system, the V-1 system, to see what suit will be used against the Unknowns in the future.

episodes.title: The Qualified Person
episodes.overview: After his body is pushed to the limit Makoto Hikawa is forced to give up his position as the G3-X operator. Sumiko Ozawa feels that Makoto uses too much force and that he will not sync with the G3-X's AI system, she instead needs a much more relax and carefree person... like Shoichi Tsugami.

episodes.title: The Flawless Machine
episodes.overview: After going berserk, destroying the V-1 system and the second bee Unknown, and then attacking Agito, Makoto Hikawa faints in the G3-X system. He is hospitalized and comes to the realization that while the G3-X system is perfect, he has many flaws. Makoto turns to the only other person he sees as a suitable candidate for the G3-X, Shoichi Tsugami.

episodes.title: Another Clash!
episodes.overview:
Makoto Hikawa takes full responsibility for going berserk after seeing Shoichi Tsugami effectively deal with an Unknown in the G3-X suit. The police cheifs recognize this and decide to have Toru Hojo operate the G3-X once the V-1 system is disbanded.

Sumiko Ozawa must come to grips that her G3-X system is too perfect and too smart and in order for Makoto to operate it she must make it flawed.

Ryo Ashihara is fully healed and looks for revenge against Agito.

episodes.title: Restored Memories
episodes.overview:
Agito is defeated by Gills, leaving him to drown. Shouichi doesn't die but regains his memory and then proceeds on a trip to find out just who the real Shoichi Tsugami is.

Ryo Ashihara continues to work down the list of names in his father's notebook, meeting Aki Sakaki's "friends": Masumi Sekiya and Katsuhiko Sagara.

episodes.title: Ryo Dies…
episodes.overview:
After being saved by Ryo Ashihara, Masumi Sekiya and Katsuhiko Sagara decide that Gills possesess too much of a threat to them and must die.

Shouichi and the real Shoichi Tsugami meet face-to-face and talk about their one common link: late sister and girlfriend Yukina Sawaki, who was one of the first people with powers and committed suicide.

episodes.title: That Summer Day
episodes.overview:
A few weeks before Episode 27...

A boy running from his past, and two men in black suits, bumps into Ryo Ashihara. Ryo decides to help the boy run far away... until they run into an Unknown.

episodes.title: A Numerical Mystery?!
episodes.overview: A victim of an Unknown attack happened to be a safe cracking thief whose accomplise was his younger brother. The police figure that if they can find the younger brother than they can protect and arrest him. Makoto Hikawa recruits Mana and Shouichi to help in the effort.

episodes.title: Hidden Power
episodes.overview:
Toru Hojo decides to take Nobuyuki Kazaya's murder case saying that it wasn't an Unknown that killed him but a human with telekinetic powers.

Tetsuya Sawaki, going against the OverLord's principles, tries to revive Ryo Ashihara using a super powered human. Unfortunately, the man who killed him, Katsuhiko Sagara, is not powerful enough to do it.

episodes.title: A Person's Whereabouts
episodes.overview: After attacking the tennis team at the fireworks display Mana believes that she unknowingly killed her father. Mana tries to distance herself from the people she loves and gets kidnapped by Katsuhiko Sagara, who hopes that she can make a future safe for people with supernatural powers.

episodes.title: Gills' Resurrection
episodes.overview:
Mana, under the guidance of Tetsuya Sawaki, starts the process of reviving Ryo Ashihara and it seems to have a backlash on her body.

Shouichi tries to reach out to Mana who's run away from home, showing her that she's not alone in trying to find "the place where they belong".

episodes.title: The Enemy Who Appeared
episodes.overview:
The El of Water has possessed Masumi Sekiya and it's reviled that it killed the two Akatsuki-go members from Gills' Resurrection in her body without her knowing. The El of Water has now turned its sights on Agito.

Shouichi comes face to face with the El of Water and believes no matter what he can't defeat it, becoming scared. He starts to question why he became Agito.

episodes.title: Summoning Souls to Meet
episodes.overview:
After being beaten by the El of Water both Gills and Agito retreat. Shouichi becomes bedridden with injuries and Ryo must protect him even though both of them known they are no match for the deadly Unknown.

One of the last remaining survivors of the Akatsuki-go incident, Koji Majima, becomes targeted by a mantis Unknown.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Messiah
episodes.overview:
Shouichi, fighting for himself, transforms into Agito Burning form and defeats the mantis Unknown and the El of Water. The El of Water, in a last ditch effort, retreats into the OverLord's body and vows vengeance against Agito. Shouichi regains his self-esteem and rejoins the Misugi household.

Ryo Ashihara witnesses someone being attacked by an Unknown and goes to save her, he encounters a strange man in black named Kaoru Kino.

episodes.title: The Fourth Man
episodes.overview:
Kaoru Kino saves Ryo Ashihara and Koji Majima from an Unknown. He tells Ryo that his sole purpose in life is to save people, either as a doctor or as Agito. But can this man, haunted by his past, really be trusted?

Makoto Hikawa finally figures out that the Unknown are targeting the people that he once rescued but doesn't know why.

episodes.title: The Warrior of Darkness
episodes.overview: Kaoru Kino hunts down and brutally injures Ryo Ashihara, claiming that the world only needs one Agito. As Koji Majima and Ryo flee Kino turns back into a human from Another Agito and is seen by both Makoto Hikawa and Toru Hojo. While Makoto is truly thankful that Agito is a "pure" person, Toru believes that he can once and for all capture Agito when he transforms back into a human.

episodes.title: The True Form…
episodes.overview:
Shouichi is captured by Toru Hojo on accident when leaving a battle with an Unknown. Toru takes him in for questioning even though Toru saw Kaoru Kino transform from Agito previously.

Ryo Ashihara, who escapes from the murderous scalpel of Kino, finds himself once again hunted by Another Agito.

episodes.title: Gills' Howl
episodes.overview:
Agito and Another Agito battle and come to a draw, allowing enough time to let Ryo Ashihara, Koji Majima, and Makoto Hikawa escape. Tetsuya Sawakii meets Koji and Ryo and tells Koji that there is only one way to save Ryo... to transfer his seed of Agito to Ryo.

Toru Hojo and Sumiko Ozawa report to their superiors that Shoichi Tsugami is Agito and that he should be allowed to act freely. Their superiors decide to keep this fact a secret leaving Hikawa to wonder about who is Agito.

episodes.title: United Front!
episodes.overview: Ryo Ashihara awakens a new power, Exceed Gills, and manages to severely damage Another Agito but decides not deal the finishing blow. Makoto Hikawa, now knowing the identity of Agito, doesn't know how he should face Shoichi Tsugami.

episodes.title: Light and Darkness
episodes.overview:
Shoichi Tsugami and Makoto Hikawa have finally created a good fighting bond and their relationship is back to normal. Shouichi feels that it is best to figure out why Kaoru Kino attacked them is to talk to him and figure out why he is living in the past.

The El of Water has finally recovered and seeks to eliminate all the Riders once and for all.

episodes.title: The Akatsuki
episodes.overview:
Shoichi Tsugami has fallen unconscious during the fight with the newly evolved El of Water and all the pieces of his memories on the Akatsuki have put themselves together.

Meanwhile, Mana uses her powers to translate the letter found by Toru Hojo and learns the history behind the Overlords of Light and Darkness and the origin behind the seeds of Agito.

episodes.title: The Darkness that Begins to Move
episodes.overview: Agito unleashes his Shining Form and combines his strength with the other Riders and defeats the El of Water. The OverLord of Darkness realizes that Agito's power has become too strong and he must deal with the Riders directly to save his beloved humans.

episodes.title: Dad and Older Sister and...
episodes.overview:
After Kaoru Kino's seed of Agito is stolen from him the OverLord of Darkness turns his sights on Ryo Ashihara, looking to take Gills' power.

Shoichi Tsugami and Mana Kazaya go to Toru Hojo for answers about Mana's father's murder but is the truth they uncover more than they can handle?

episodes.title: Stolen Power
episodes.overview:
Thanks to Ryo Ashihara, Shoichi Tsugami escapes from the OverLord of Darkness. Shouichi begins to question what it means to be Agito now that he believes that his sister killed Mana's father.

Makoto Hikawa is released and back on duty. Unfortunately, he is still suffering from a severe concussion.

episodes.title: Warriors, Those Bonds
episodes.overview: Shoichi Tsugami takes solace knowing that he is no longer Agito and that he is free from a fate that could be much like his sister's. But with Agito, Gills, and Another Agito out of commission who will save Mana when she is attacked?

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Sky!
episodes.overview:
One month later, there have been zero sightings of Unknowns so the police decide to temporarily disband the G3 team with the hopes that this whole mess is coming to a close.

Shoichi Tsugami and Ryo Ashihara find jobs and try to once again have normal lives.

The Overlord, seeing his beloved humanity turn on him, decides it is time to start over.

episodes.title: The Governor of Stars
episodes.overview:
A string of strange suicides are occurring where all the people are Scorpios. Makoto Hikawa doesn't believe that these deaths are just coincidences and decides this needs further investigation.

Shoichi Tsugami tries to help a female apprentice struggling to be a full time chef, believing that he can help her follow in her father's footsteps.

Ryo Ashihara tries to convince a girl that there is more to life than just racing her bike.

episodes.title: Footsteps of Destruction
episodes.overview:
After being beaten by the El of the Wind, Ryo Ashihara and Shoichi Tsugami are nursed back to health by the two girls they helped.

As the Scorpio constellation continues to shift more and more people who were born under the constellation commit suicide. Makoto Hikawa believes that they die after seeing their doppelgänger.

episodes.title: Now, Time to Battle
episodes.overview: The G3 and G3-X have been dispatched for the purpose of protecting Unknowns. The police believe that a race of Agitos will one day overthrow humanity so why not have the Unknowns kill them before it happens.

episodes.title: AGITΩ
episodes.overview: With people killing themselves because of the OverLord and two Els killing people with the Seed of Agito the Kamen Riders must unite their strengths to save humanity from extinction.

episodes.title: The Secret Story's Birth
episodes.overview: News reporter Shinji Kido is drawn into a case involving a series of abductions involving reflections when he suddenly found a mysterious deck left by the individual in the victim's apartment. As Shinji tries to figuring out the cause of this mystery, a mysterious woman and a man with a black coat pursues Shinji, asking if he was a Kamen Rider.

episodes.title: Giant Spider Counterattack
episodes.overview: Having become a Kamen Rider himself, Shinji tries to discover more from another Rider and his female partner as the mysterious dragon continues to pursue him while his female partner talking about her brother's existence. Having witnessed the battle he participates, Shinji decided to participate in the war as Kamen Rider Ryuki.

episodes.title: School Ghost Story
episodes.overview: Shinji discovers the truth of becoming a Kamen Rider and the battles yet to come while a school becomes haunted by the emergence of a pack of Mirror Monsters. Suddenly, a mysterious figure from the mirror appears in front of Shinji, urging him to fight for his own destiny.

episodes.title: School Ghost Story 2
episodes.overview: When Darkwing appeared to scare a student, Shinji inquires further about Ren after suspecting that he had a darker intention in his means as a Kamen Rider. However, Yui denies Shinji's accusation about Ren's act as Yui explains to Shinji about Ren's true purpose of fighting.

episodes.title: The Monster's Antique Store
episodes.overview: Shinji investigates an antiques shop where Reiko was attacked by a mysterious person when she investigates the mystery of antique shop owner's disappearance. In order to meet a mysterious person, Shinji gave mysterious person a name card, without realizing that Shinji's action had putting Yui's life in danger.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Rider
episodes.overview: As Ren tries to close in on the antique store murderer, Shinji unknowingly gives Kamen Rider Scissors the fuel for gaining an edge in the Rider Fight.

episodes.title: A New Species Is Born?
episodes.overview: Yui is pursued into finding a man by her visiting grandmother, while Shinji encounters a lawyer who brings forth trouble around every corner. In the meantime, Reiko meets an old man who claims he owns some of the mutated species he found near a river bank.

episodes.title: The Fourth, Zolda
episodes.overview: An investigation leads Shinji to find out more on Shuichi while trying to prove his worth to Yui's grandmother to get a new place to stay.

episodes.title: Shinji's Arrested!?
episodes.overview: Shinji is arrested after being falsely accused for abducting Nanako, leading to Yui and Ren hiring Shuichi to bail him out. However, as Shuichi attempts to free Shinji from his false accusation, he suspects that Shinji was Kamen Rider Ryuki.

episodes.title: Knight's Crisis
episodes.overview: Discovering Shuichi is Kamen Rider Zolda, Ren tries to back out of using the lawyer in saving Shinji, even as Shuichi goes through a crisis of morality and mortality. While Nanako is finally recovered from her last assault, she discovers a shocking discovery about Shuichi.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Empty Train
episodes.overview: Shinji pursues Ren after he loses his memory while Yui returns to her brother's university in an attempt to locate his whereabouts. In the meantime, Reiko is investigating the mysterious disappearances of several passengers on a train.

episodes.title: Ren Akiyama's Lover
episodes.overview: Ren's past comes to light as both he and Yui return to Shiro's last known whereabouts and the birthplace of Kamen Rider Knight, as well as Eri's fate following the secret experiment's aftermath. When Yui finds nearly dead Professor Ejima in the Room 401, he blames Yui for causing a disaster before he dies.

episodes.title: That Man, Zolda
episodes.overview: An investigation into elevator abductions leads Shinji to encounter the one he thinks is Zolda while Ren encounters a fortuneteller who wants to stop the Rider Fight. As Shinji encounters Zolda, he accidentally unleashes the finisher that 'killed' Zolda in the process.

episodes.title: Revival Day
episodes.overview: When Shinji learned that Zolda is actually Goro, Shuichi blames Shinji for his actions, making him believe that he killed Zolda in the previous fight. Learning from the troubles Shinji suffered, Ren arrives to clean up his name by exposing the true culprit behind Zolda's death.

episodes.title: Iron Mask Legend
episodes.overview: With Yui hired as a part-time journalist following Chief Editor's absence, Shinji and Yui investigate a series of incidents involving masked men fighting each other controlled by a cruel gamemaster. Meanwhile, the fortuneteller predicts something terrible would happen to Ren if he continues to fight.

episodes.title: Card of Destiny
episodes.overview: The ORE Journal is in jeopardy when Jun Shibaura suddenly appears and becomes the new Editor-in-Chief, only to reveal his plans to use ORE Journal to promote the fatal fighting game to the subscribers in larger scale. To make matters even worse, Jun threatens Shinji by attempting to burn the Dragreder card he stole from him if he tries to turn against him. Ren puts his duel to Jun to decide who's the strongest, while Miyuki warns Ren about the terrible fate that might happen to Ren if he continues to fight Jun.

episodes.title: The Grieving Knight
episodes.overview: With Ren doubting his ability to go through killing other Kamen Riders, Shinji and Miyuki contemplate his possible paths and the potential doom that he faces. As Sanako decided to go out for her 'secret association meeting', Yui continues to investigate the truth behind the secret experiments her brother conducted. Meanwhile, Shuichi attempts to release a prisoner.

episodes.title: Jailbreak Rider
episodes.overview: Imprisoned criminal Takeshi Asakura is approached by Shiro in joining the Rider Fight to grudge against lawyer Shuichi Kitaoka who refuses to release him. Meanwhile, after Yui saw Eri's terrible condition in the hospital, she blames herself for causing this disaster. With the breaking news of Takeshi's sudden jailbreak spreading across the nation, Shinji ride into his action as a journalist for the first time.

episodes.title: Rider Gathering
episodes.overview: Shinji becomes trapped with Takeshi as he holds hostages in order to gain a battle with his former lawyer Shuichi. Meanwhile, in Atori, Jun invites Ren and Miyuki to participate in a game that gathers all Riders together in the Mirror World for one big battle, only to realize that the game he held has backfired on himself.

episodes.title: The Traitorous Ren
episodes.overview: Shinji questions Takeshi on why he enjoys killing people for his own satisfaction without thinking about others. In the real world, Shinji is surprised when Ren suddenly decides to help Takeshi evade being recaptured by the police. Meanwhile, Yui tries to uncover more secrets about her brother's experiments when she finds a film containing an image of the house she obtained from a research file. As Shinji battles against Takeshi once again in Mirror World, Ren suddenly appears and attacks Shinji.

episodes.title: Yui's Past
episodes.overview: After discovering Ren's reason for entering the Rider Fight, Shinji hesitates if he should fight or not. Meanwhile, Yui and Miyuki make a discovery at the old mansion that is connected to her and Shiro's past. As Ren prepares another battle with Takeshi, Shinji appears in front of them, deciding that he will fight Ren till the end.

episodes.title: Raia's Revenge
episodes.overview: As Ren tries to learn about Yui's past, Miyuki felt time is running short when Shiro targets him for death for disobeying his desires for the Rider Fight. In the meantime, Takeshi kidnaps Goro to force Shuichi to fight him face to face.

episodes.title: Changing Destiny
episodes.overview: Ren battles with Shuichi in the Mirror World to decide who will survive. Miyuki reveals his past to Shinji as he contemplates the costs of changing destiny, as Shiro orders Takeshi to eliminate Raia for his refusal to fight. In the meantime, Reiko goes out to investigate Takeshi's disappearance.

episodes.title: Ouja's Secret
episodes.overview: Reiko tracks down and investigates Takeshi in order to find out the truth behind his aggressive, vexed behavior, only to discover that Takeshi had a long-lost brother who still lives. Following Miyuki's death, Shinji blames himself for letting Miyuki die in Takeshi's hands. Disgusted by her brother's reckless action, Yui decides to revisit the old mansion, urging Shiro to stop the Rider War. While Ren, Shinji and Shuichi battle against Mirror Monsters, they discover that the Contract Monsters they owned suddenly disappeared, when Shiro appears telling them that the Rider War is over.

episodes.title: Combining Ouja
episodes.overview: Shinji and Ren are forced to track down Yui as she confronts her brother about her connection to the Rider War and their childhood memories. Reiko tries to find Takeshi's younger brother, believing that will change him for good, only to discover that Takeshi used his younger brother to feed his Contract Monsters. As Ren, Shinji and Shuichi battle against Takeshi, he unleashes a new Card that does something the Riders didn't expect to happen.

episodes.title: Zolda's Assault
episodes.overview: After learning the truth about Takeshi's continuous acts of monstrosity, Reiko feels guilty over Takeshi's younger brother's fate. When Goro goes out to replace Shuichi's job, he hires Shinji as a temporary secretary for him as he tries to change his perspective on what to fight for. Still not satisfied by her brother's actions, Yui decided to confront Shiro once again in the mansion. Reiko tries to investigate the truth behind Takeshi's sudden jailbreak.

episodes.title: The 13th Rider
episodes.overview:
A young boy learns about the Rider War and steals Shinji's Deck before coming to realize that it is not all it is cracked up to be.

Yui, after a confrontation with Shiro in the Kanzaki Household learns that her brother is dead

The 4 remaining Riders meet a new Rider, claiming himself to be the "13th" Rider.

episodes.title: Time Vent
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider Odin uses Time Vent to correct an error in Time but appears to inadvertently send Shinji back in time also. Shinji attempts to save the Riders by changing the flow of time but fails.

episodes.title: Marriage Interview Battle
episodes.overview:
Yui tells Reiko about her brother's appearances even though he is apparently dead.

Reiko and Nanako both are stalked and also go missing after having marriage interviews with a man.

A monster is revealed to be the Kidnapper.

episodes.title: Zolda's Lover
episodes.overview: Shuichi's previous Secretary, Megumi sues him for breaking off their engagement. After finding out that she is sick, Goro finds out that she is dying. Shuichi goes on a date with Megumi only to find that her supposed fatal disease is just low blood-pressure

episodes.title: The Girl and Ouja
episodes.overview: Shinji and Ren trying to protect a traumatized girl who witnessed a mysterious disappearances among the passengers on a ship when they discovered Takeshi was boarding on it. To make matters even worse, a girl running towards him, claiming that Takeshi had saved her life.

episodes.title: Secret Data Gathering
episodes.overview:
Takeshi's three Contract Monsters reach their breaking point and attempt to attack him on multiple occasions.

Reiko discovers more information about Shiro Kanzaki's actions in America.

Takeshi eventually manages to feed his three monsters after nearly being stopped by Ren.

episodes.title: The Mirror's Magic
episodes.overview:
Megumi attempts to see why Shinji can walk into and out of glass and supposedly finds out but is later shown to be wrong.

Reiko & the Chief Editor make links between the disappearing people, Shiro Kanzaki & the Mirrors.

Yui begins to fade as do the Riders in the Mirror World.

Ren notices that Eri's health is critically deteriorating, and she only has a few weeks to live.

Shuichi is struggling with his disease as his health is gradually declining.

At the abandoned Room 401, a mysterious Rider makes his entrance.

episodes.title: Friendship's Battle
episodes.overview:
Shinji receives a Survive Card from Shiro Kanzaki.

Takeshi searches for Shuichi in order to fight.

Disgusted by Shinji, Ren and Yui's discouragement, Sanako forces them to get out and take a walk for a while.

After getting into an argument, later on, Ren asks Shinji to fight him.

In order to survive, Shinji uses the Survive Card and declares that he won't allow Ren to kill him.

episodes.title: Enter Tiger
episodes.overview:
Ren and Shinji continue to fight.

Yui learns that Ren will continue to fight for Eri's sake by any means, even if it means he will be dead before his wish can be granted.

Takeshi is arrested a tip-off from Shuichi.

Daisuke and Reiko try to find a connection between the recent disappearances with the mirrors, and more secrets behind Shiro Kanzaki and the Ejima Lab (now known as Kagawa Lab).

Ren challenges Shiro to fight by force in the Mirror World, but is overpowered by Odin. However, before Odin can destroy Knight's Card Deck, he stabs Odin with his Winglancer.

Shinji learns that the occupants of Room 401 at Seimeiin University are planning to seal Mirror World.

episodes.title: The Battle Ends
episodes.overview:
Takeshi, who was going to be transferred to a prison instead, escapes thanks to the Metalgelas card.

Ren continues to look for another fight with Takeshi, while Shinji is looking for Ren to tell him the truth about Eri's condition.

Yui tries to tell Ren that Eri has just regained consciousness.

Someone tries to drag Yui right into the Mirror World.

episodes.title: Sleep Is Awakening
episodes.overview:
Yui is attacked by a new Rider.

The doctor tells Ren that Eri's sudden awakening is a coincidence.

Shinji continues to find a way to seal the Mirror World.

Eri leaves the Hospital and is nearly killed by a Monster.

Eri learns that Ren was fighting Monster all the time as a Kamen Rider.

Satoru works as a part-timer waiter at Atori tea house.

episodes.title: Targeted Yui
episodes.overview:
Shinji learns that in order to stop the Rider War, Yui must be eliminated.

After having her first meeting with Ren since she regained consciousness, Eri falls back to sleep.

Satoru betrayed Hajime by killing him the moment Hajime finishes Ryuki in the process.

Shinji learned that Satoru was Kamen Rider Tiger.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Sign
episodes.overview:
Takeshi tricks his new lawyer into showing him his belongings.

Ren learns that Hideyuki and Satoru are targeting Yui and confronts both of them.

Reiko's curiosity about Shinji's behaviour becomes even more stronger as Reiko learns that Shinji knows about Shiro Kanzaki.

After destroying two monsters, Satoru attacks Shinji from behind.

Yui is targeted by a monster that was at the Lab at Seimeiin University.

Yui discovers that the Mirror and Contract Monsters all came from drawings she and Shiro made during their childhood.

episodes.title: Memories of an Older Brother and Younger Sister
episodes.overview:
The ORE Journal staffs discover the secret of Mirror Monsters.

Takeshi once again managed to escape prison.

Shiro threatens Kagawa for his attempt to seal Mirror World.

The 6 remaining Riders fight in a large battle against a large group of Monsters.

A new Rider appears.

episodes.title: Imperer
episodes.overview:
Satoru finds out that Hideyuki has his own family, much to the dissatisfaction of Tojo himself.

Takeshi attempts to find Satoru by asking Shuichi, and later Shinji.

Shuichi finds Room 401, the room where Shiro Kanzaki worked.

Having learned the secrets about the Mirror World, Satoru attempts to kill Reiko.

Mitsuru Sano reveals himself to everyone as Kamen Rider Imperer, offering his services as an ally for cash.

episodes.title: Room 401
episodes.overview:
Mitsuru accepts both sides' offer to ally with them but ultimately chooses Hideyuki and Satoru.

Shiro tells Takeshi where Satoru and Hideyuki are and tells him to kill them. Takeshi later finds out that they aren't there, until he confronts Shinji, Ren and Shuichi at the same time.

Reiko questions Shuichi about the thing that attacked her last time.

Ren is enraged by Shinji's decision to include Mitsuru as his comrade.

Hideyuki brings Satoru to lunch with his family to teach him the moral lesson about being a hero.

Satoru kills Hideyuki and shatters the Alternative Deck.

episodes.title: The Hero Fights
episodes.overview:
Mitsuru, after being dumped as an ally by Satoru attempts to ally himself with Shinji, Shuichi and Takeshi, but none of them works.

Shinji and Ren go searching for Yui inside Mirror World but none of them found her.

Takeshi nearly kills Satoru and later, Shuichi nearly kills Satoru. However, he survives both in the end.

As Shiro finally met Yui for the first time inside the Mirror World, several Mirror Monsters tried to threaten Yui before Shiro uses his psychic powers to resist the Mirror Monsters' assault.

episodes.title: Glassy Happiness
episodes.overview:
Yui returns to the Normal World and doesn't remember anything.

Mitsuru becomes the head of his father's company and tries to pay others to be his allies.

Despite becoming president, Shiro warns Mitsuru that even though his wish is granted, he has to continue fighting as a Kamen Rider or face a terrible consequence.

There is public backlash against ORE Journal after they publish the photos of the Mirror Monsters.

After becoming Mitsuru's friend, Satoru backstabs him allowing Takeshi to easily kill Mitsuru.

episodes.title: The Twentieth Birthday
episodes.overview:
Shinji realises that Yui is fading but doesn't believe it at first. However, Yui realizes it herself later and begins to panic, and she calls Ren to pick her up.

ORE Journal is seized due to the failure of the Mirror Monster scoop. However, Chief Editor tells Shinji that as long as his PC is in hands, the ORE Journal will continue to exist.

A child version of Yui appears inside the mirror, and warns present Yui that on her 20th birthday, she'll disappear.

Reiko orders Nanako and Megumi to spy on Shuichi.

Asakura tells Tojo that he was really the one that killed Mitsuru.

One of the Sheerghosts begins to multiply, creating thousands of them.

episodes.title: Tiger's a Hero
episodes.overview:
Shinji learns that the Rider War was created to save Yui.

Satoru challenges the other Riders to a battle. Later, he douses their cars with gasoline to stop them from leaving Mirror World.

Takeshi seemingly dies in an explosion after igniting a gasoline-covered car.

Satoru sacrifices himself by jumping in front of a truck to save a boy and his father.

Shinji made his final decision to fight Ren for Yui's sake.

episodes.title: Determination of Battle
episodes.overview:
On two separate occasions, Shinji is unable to destroy Ren even though he had found a reason to fight until his hesitation forces him to refuse to fight.

Shinji had to pretend to be cheerful, much to Ren and Yui's concern over Shinji's sudden overacting of joyfulness.

Shuichi collapses from his illness.

Reiko returns from New York with the documents which contain the information about Shiro Kanzaki.

A savage Destwilder is slain by Shinji and Ren after killing a couple.

Continuing from the previous battle, Shinji fights Ren once again.

The multiplying Sheerghosts curl into a pool and later hatch into Raydragoons.

episodes.title: The Final 3 Days
episodes.overview:
Shiro tells the remaining Riders to finish the battle in three days. Otherwise, no one will get their wish.

Shuichi has in fact not died and is recovering in hospital.

Yui tries to jump off of a high building to stop the Rider War but Shiro prevents her.

Reiko and Chief Editor trying to solve mystery about Mirror World and Kamen Riders.

Reiko discovers that Shinji is a Kamen Rider.

episodes.title: Granting a Wish
episodes.overview: This episodes marks the revelation of the Mirror World and Shinji's identity as a Rider to Reiko, as well as Yui's final appearance.

episodes.title: A New Life
episodes.overview: With his status as the last Rider standing, Ren faces off against Odin in order to grant his wish, while Asakura prepares for his final battle against Kitaoka once and for all. Later, Asakura successfully kills Zolda only to realize it was Goro the whole time, only for him to be gunned down to death by the police. After hearing Yui's appeal to stop the Rider War, Kanzaki finally realizes the pointlessness, while Ren is the sole surviving Rider with his wish granted.

episodes.title: The Start of a Trip
episodes.overview: Yuji Kiba leads a peaceful life until a truck hits his car, killing his parents and himself. Two years later, he awakens to find his life in ruins — his girlfriend Chie had left him for his cousin, and his house is gone. In rage, Yuji kills his cousin with his newfound powers. Meanwhile, Takumi follows Mari after realizing that they accidentally switched bags. However, the two are attacked by an Orphnoch. Mari attempts to use the Faiz belt to fight, but fails. She pushes Takumi to use it, and he defeats the Orphnoch.

episodes.title: The Belt's Power
episodes.overview: Mari and Takumi continue to reluctantly travel together to Tokyo. Yuji still has not come to terms with what has happened to him. He tries to kill himself but finds he can't. He meets up with his old girlfriend thinking they can start over. She turns on him when the police arrive to talk to her about his cousin's death. He later kills her.

episodes.title: The King's Sleep...
episodes.overview: Takumi still refuses to help Mari protect the Faiz Gear and leaves her when he finds that she has been lying to him about her wrist being hurt.

episodes.title: My Name
episodes.overview:
Keitaro and Takumi take Mari to the hospital after the battle with the Ox Orphenoch.

Meanwhile, Akai, the Cactus Orphenoch, kills a fuel station attendant, much to the annoyance of his partner, Midorikawa.

episodes.title: Original
episodes.overview: Takumi, Keitaro and Mari go to see her father as he will know about the Orphenochs. Yuji takes Yuka to see someone who can help her.

episodes.title: Trio × Trio
episodes.overview: While working in Keitaro's laundry business, Takumi burns some clothes. Mari believes that he is distracted due to what happened to his friend.

episodes.title: The Power of Dreams
episodes.overview: Yuji fights Faiz as the Horse Orphenoch to protect the Snake Orphenoch and even stops Faiz's finishing attack, injuring Takumi. Naoya abandons the hurt Yuji, despite being saved by him.

episodes.title: The Protector of Dreams
episodes.overview: The Owl Orphenoch retreats from Faiz. Keitaro tries to get Kazuhiko to see his mother, but he refuses until he can prove to her that he is serious about music. Yuka tries to talk to Naoya but he is accused of killing another student.

episodes.title: Enter, the President
episodes.overview: Faiz destroys the Scarab Beetle Orphenoch. Yuji and Naoya try to decide what they should do next. Naoya wants to attack humans, but Yuji believes they should protect them.

episodes.title: The Enigmatic Rider
episodes.overview: At the beginning of this episode, Takumi no longer has the Faiz gear. It was surrendered to the Chief of Smart Brain in the previous episode. He appears to be a bit depressed and takes off on his own for a bit. In the meantime, we learn that the Chief has made Naoya the new Faiz and learn that the Chief's philosophy regarding Orphnochs is if they don't attack humans or if they defend them then they are worthless and are to be eliminated.

episodes.title: The Enigmatic Belt
episodes.overview:
Takumi is beginning to think that maybe he was meant to be Faiz.

We meet members of Lucky Clover for the first time. Chief Murakami ask Jay, a member of Lucky Clover, to take back the Faiz belt and get rid of Takumi. Murakami arranges for Takumi and Mari to be at the same amusement part that Keitaro has taken Yuka to. Takumi has a hard time fighting Jay in Orphenoch form. The new rider makes a brief appearance and fires on Jay at the end.

First appearance of Kamen Rider Kaixa.

episodes.title: Ryūsei School
episodes.overview: Takumi and the main girl were able to meet with her friends and teacher from Ryusei School. They discussed that whomever uses the Kaixa Gear will die. They were then attack by an Orphenoch known as Jay. One of the students transformed into Kaixa, just to get the stuffing beat out of him and die. Just then, Takumi as Faiz, saves the day. But this is a hollow victory as the group of students lost their teacher before he had a chance to tell them what happened on the day of the reunion.

episodes.title: Friend of Foe?
episodes.overview:
Mari, Takumi, and Keitaro begin looking for Mari’s schoolmate Masato Kusaka.

Yuji has decided not to attack humans. Naoya is still trying to figure out what he wants. Yuka is trying to figure out Naoya. Naoya decides to be human and date. He drags Yuka out on a practice date.

Takumi, Mari, and Keitaro find Masato. As he and Takumi have a fencing battle, Mari’s former schoolmates are attacked by an Orphenoch. They go to rescue them. Masato follows and transforms using the Kaixa belt. He defeats the two Orphnochs .

episodes.title: Takumi's Spirit
episodes.overview: Masato stayed with Mari as the remaining Ryuseiji went to search for their other partners to find out about the past. Murakami assigned the Lucky Clover to their tasks. Realizing that he was targeted for not wanting to attack humans, Yuji told Naoya and Yuka to decide for themselves on what they wanted to do from now on.

episodes.title: The Fallen Idol ~ φ's vs. χ
episodes.overview:
Yuji and Takumi have been knocked unconscious and into the river. Takumi’s Faiz belt was knocked off of him. His friend picks it up. Takumi’s friends find Yuji and Yuji’s friends find Takumi. Each returns to their own friends.

The attacks of the Lucky Clover continue.

During a fight with Orphenochs, Takumi realizes that Osada is one of them. Masato transforms into Kaixa to fight Osaka who is in Orphenoch form. To everyone’ssurprise, Takumi protects the Orphenoch.

episodes.title: Human Heart
episodes.overview: Masato seems to be trying to sow discord between Takumi and his friends. Takumi won't explain why he attacked Masato and defended the Orphenoch. Masato lets Takumi know that he is trying to replace him with Mari and Keitaro. According to him, people who don't like him are in his way.

episodes.title: Takumi, Revival
episodes.overview:
Masato and Takumi begin by squaring off again. Kusaka thinks Takumi's days as Faiz are numbered. Mari and Keitaro can't understand what is going on with Takumi. Kusaka take advantage of this to make himself look good and to try to get rid of Takumi.

Yuji's dead girlfriend's older brother contacts him to get him to help find her killer. He gets turned into an Orphenoch and attacks anyone who seems to be speaking bad about her.

Yuji realizes that the older brother has become an Orphenoch and as lost his soul as a human but he can do nothing about him. Takumi fights him.

episodes.title: Narrow Escape from Death
episodes.overview: Masato went off with his old classmate as they went to find out more about the third belt. Smart Brain continues on their attempts to recover Faiz and Kaixa. Meanwhile, a girl had been followed by an Orphenoch. As glum mood surrounds the Kiba household, Yuji wondered about the identity of the Faiz user.

episodes.title: Pure White Justice
episodes.overview: The battle between Yuji and Faiz ends in a stalemate as the other Orphenoch gets away. Lucky Clover member J is given a final chance to retrieve either belts for the sake of his dog Chaco.

episodes.title: The Beautiful Assassin
episodes.overview: Two of the members of Smart Brain are ordered to get the Faiz Gear back and kill all traitors. Saeko of Lucky Clover meets another Orphenoch that wants to take Jay's spot. Takumi faces off against one of the members while Yuji Kiba faces the other one. Both fights end up the same: defeat, but Takumi's is much worse because the Orphenoch that he lost to took his Faiz Gear and transformed into Faiz to kill Takumi and finish his job.

episodes.title: Accelerating Spirits
episodes.overview: Takumi and Yuji were blasted away into the river because of the new Faiz. The new Faiz also gloats to the female member of the Lucky Clover that he will take back the Kaixa Gear as well. Kaixa returns to fight the new Faiz and take back the belt. But Takumi gets the belt again with a new gadget that lets him change into Axel Form. Using this form, he defeats the Centipede Orphenoch.

episodes.title: Masato's Confession
episodes.overview:
The story begins with Yuji and Takumi fighting each other in Orphenoch form and Faiz form, respectively. Neither know that the other can transform.

Masato comes back from his trip. He doesn't say much about it other than that the others from Ryuseiji Tutor are fighting. He continues to push Takumi's buttons. He lets Mari know that he likes her.

Murakami suggests training a new member for Lucky Clover to replace Jay.

Masato overhears Mari questioning her feelings for Yuji. This upsets Masato. Yuji and Yuka ask Mari to consider going out with Naoya.

episodes.title: False Friendship
episodes.overview: Having accidentally found out about Yuji, Masato announced a truce as they fought Saeko and another Orphenoch that had come to kill them. Realizing the fact Yuji did not know of Faiz's true identity, Masato hatched a plan to use that against Yuji as he learned about Lucky Clover.

episodes.title: The Door to Darkness
episodes.overview: Takumi joined into the fight as he witnessed Masato fighting two Orphenochs as Murakami arrived to stop them. Masato revealed his intention to wanting to join Lucky Clover. Yuji wondered what Masato really is. Is he an enemy or ally? Naoya made another decision as he was rejected by Mari.

episodes.title: The Dark Laboratory
episodes.overview: Smart Brain recovered Faiz and Kaixa as Kusaka was captured. Mari and others sneaked into Smart Brain to save him. While escaping from Takumi, both of them discovered the entrance to the underground Ryusei School. Over there they stumble into a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Enter, Delta
episodes.overview: Kyouji was disappointed about the loss of the belts as he looks for another Lucky Clover candidate. Masato reminds Takumi to keep quiet about what they saw at the school as they met the Ryuseiji later. On the other hand, the remaining Ryuseiji fought over who should keep the Delta belt. A girl appeared at Keitaro as she offered to work part-time. Delta appeared.

episodes.title: Ryūsei School Breaks Up
episodes.overview: Members of the Ryusei School are trying to find the Delta belt and are arguing over it at the same time. Itsuro of Lucky Clover continues to try to kill Yuji. As they are fighting, they run into Keitaro and Saya. Keitaro encourages Saya to run and soon Delta appears on the scene. Everyone thinks that Aki has the Delta belt. Kyosuke and Ken kidnap Mari to lure out Aki, who continues his murderous rampage as an Orphenoch. Aki kills Kyosuke and Ken as Takumi and Masato arrive on the scene to save Mari. Delta arrives on the scene.

episodes.title: Dark Clover
episodes.overview: Faiz and Kaixa are fighting Aki with little success. Before Delta can join in, Mari intervenes and Aki escapes. Everyone is still trying to figure out who has the Delta belt. They are beginning to suspect that maybe Saya has it. The belt was originally sent to her. Mari and Masato try to arrange a meeting with Aki. In the meantime, Itsuro meets up with Kitazaki. Anyone who Kitazaki touches dissolves. Three crooks found that out when they tried to steal from Kitazaki. Aki eventually meets Masato and Mari. He tells Mari that he has always liked her. By killing her he can completely throw away his humanity and grow stronger as an Orphenoch. He and Masato transform and fight.

episodes.title: Excellent Bike
episodes.overview: Kitazaki now has the Delta gear. Masato vows to get it back. Kitazaki proposes a bet with the other members of Lucky Clover to see who can kill Yuji first. The winner gets to slap everyone on the arm. This strikes terror in Itsuro who is scared of Kitazaki. Aki goes after Yuji and knocks out Naoya and Yuka. Itsuro arrives and joins in the battle. Yuji manages to get away and is found by Saeko. As Takumi goes to deliver Yuji's laundry, he comes upon the fight and transforms. He immediately attacks Yuji, who is still in Orphenoch form. As they are fighting Kitazaki arrives on Delta's motorcycle. Both get knocked around by Kitazaki and transform back to normal.

episodes.title: Masato's Trap
episodes.overview: The battle between Yuji, Takumi, and Kitazaki continues. Itsuro interferes, allowing Takumi and Yuji to escape. Masato meets up with Aki and tries to convince him to get the Delta gear for him. Aki refuses and they fight.

episodes.title: Origami Tears
episodes.overview: Masato continues to sow the seeds of distrust between Yuji and Takumi. Takumi fights Aki but hesitates to finish him off. Aki takes advantage of this and fights him off. Aki is still battling his humanity. He agrees to meet up with Mari. When Mari goes to meet Aki she is attached by another Orphenoch. Aki saves her. Masato arrives to fight Aki.

episodes.title: Intertwined Threads
episodes.overview: As Masato is about to deliver the rider kick, Mari intervenes. Takumi gets there just in time to save her by blocking the kick with his bike. Takuma tries to steal the Delta gear from Kitizaki. Mari arranges to meet with Aki again. However, before she does Takumi meets him. Aki tells Takumi that Mari is the only one who can help him become human again. When Mari arrives she is attached by Saeko's Orphenoch assassin again. As Takumi battles him he encourages Aki to take Mari to safety. After saving her again Aki punches her hard enough to send her flying into a building. She is hospitalized. Naoya and Keitaro manage to save a child from a fire.

episodes.title: Mari Dies
episodes.overview: Masato continues to blame Takumi for Mari's injuries. He believes Takumi's soft attitude about Orphenochs lead to Mari being injured. Takumi and Yuji decide to meet up again to fight. This time they fight until both are exhausted. Kitazaki tries to join in the fight as Delta but both Yuji and Takumi make it clear that this is a fight between the two of them. Kitazaki decides to fight the winner. Kitazaki is losing interest in the Delta gear. After telling Itsuro that he threw the belt away, he gives it to Aki. Takumi decides he no longer has the right to be Faiz and gives the Faiz belt to Keitaro. Both the Delta belt and the Faiz belt both end up being given to Masato.

episodes.title: True Form
episodes.overview: Takumi wants to revive Mari and Masato knows that the only chance she has lies with Smart Brain. Yuji finds out that Takumi is not the one that injured Mari. Masato wants to give away the three belts for her life, but decides that his mission to destroy Smart Brain is more important than Mari. Takumi goes to the chief of Smart Brain and asks to revive Mari. He says that he'll only do it if he becomes a member of Lucky Clover by killing Aki. However, he says that it's impossible because he is not an Orphnoch. Meanwhile, Masato manages to get the most scared student of the Ryusei School to fight as Kamen Rider Delta and they both try to defeat the Lobster and Spider Orphnoch.

episodes.title: The Resurrection Riddle
episodes.overview: Since only Lucky Clover members have complete access to Smart Brain, Takumi has decided to defeat Aki and become a member of Lucky Clover. He transforms into the Wolf Orphenoch to fight him.

episodes.title: Restored Memories
episodes.overview: As the story begins, Naoya begins to show an interest in the boy he saved from the fire. Everyone is still in shock about Takumi being an Orphenoch. Mari and Keitaro imagine seeing him in familiar places. Mari is starting to remember the reunion. She remembers that Masato was there even though he insists he wasn't. She and Keitaro get Takumi to come back home. He stays for a little while but leaves again when he realizes that the others are uncomfortable around him. Kyouji tracks him down and shows him a video of him in Orphenoch form at the reunion.

episodes.title: Kaixa's Justice
episodes.overview: Takumi runs from his fight with Yuji, making Yuji think that Takumi is afraid of being the wolf Orphnoch and is trying to kill himself. Meanwhile, Lucky Clover thinks that Takumi will completely throw away his humanity and become one of them. Mari continues to confront Masato about the night of the reunion, but he somehow refuses to tell Mari he was at there. Takumi calls Yuji who comes to meet him, and learns he is running from the Lucky Clover. The episode concludes with Yuji interrupting a fight between Takumi in Orphenoch form and Masato in Rider form.

episodes.title: The Wandering Spirit
episodes.overview: Saeko continues to pursure Takumi for Lucky Clover. Takumi continues to resist. Mari tells Masato that she trusts Takumi. Masato implies that Mari's memories of the reunion might be true. He tells his friends to be on the look out for Takumi. As Masato's friends are attacked for the Delta belt, Takumi arrives and transforms into Delta to save them then passes out. As the program concludes, both Takumi and Yuji are fighting members of Lucky Clover.

episodes.title: Faiz 2
episodes.overview: As the story begins, Masato and Yuji come to Takumi's rescue. Later, Masato tells Mari that he doesn't remember everything about the night of the reunion. Masato and Mari both go to see Aki to ask what happened the night of the reunion. He tells them. According to Aki, Takumi came upon the students at the reunion as they were being attached by other Orphenochs. Takumi continues to think it was him until Mari talks to him and returns the Faiz belt. Takumi doesn't want to take the belt as he is still afraid of himself and doesn't know when he will lose his humanity like Aki did. Masato goes off to battle Lucky Clover members. He comes across Kitazaki and battles him.

episodes.title: Proof of Humanity
episodes.overview: As the story begins, Kitazaki loses a battle to Faiz. He can't believe he lost. Takumi still doesn't quite believe in himself and gives the belt back to Mari.
