Kazuma Kenzaki appears, saying that Tsukasa's existence is the real cause of the worlds blending before confronting him as Kamen Rider Blade in King Form in order to force him to leave the world at once with Asumu keeping Yusuke and Wataru from interfering as Decade is easily defeated.

episodes.title: W’s Search/Two Detectives in One
episodes.overview: Akiko Narumi arrives in Futo to be the landlord of the "hard-boiled" detective Shotaro Hidari, who finds himself involved in a case involving a former female love and a Dopant on the attack.

episodes.title: W’s Search/The One Who Makes the City Cry
episodes.overview: After his missing target is killed by another Dopant, Shotaro works with his partner Philip to figure out the truth regarding the killer while being dogged by Akiko and her strange sightings.

episodes.title: Don’t Touch the M/How To Get Into Heaven
episodes.overview: Shotaro is hired to save a girl from a legendary casino who offers ultimate riches for victory… and ultimate penalty for loss.

episodes.title: Don’t Touch the M/Betting on Joker
episodes.overview: Tracking down the legendary casino, Shotaro must defeat it’s Dopant owner as Philip deals with a crisis hindering his mental abilities.

episodes.title: Girl… A/Papa’s a Kamen Rider
episodes.overview: Tracking down the legendary casino, Shotaro must defeat it’s Dopant owner as Philip deals with a crisis hindering his mental abilities.

episodes.title: Girl… A/The Price of Lying
episodes.overview: Shotaro debates the cost of keeping up Asuka’s belief Double is her father as Museum steps up their motive in protecting their Gaia Memory factory.

episodes.title: Looking For C/Phillip Can’t Stand It
episodes.overview: Philip chases after a street dancer key to a locked memory, while Shotaro pursues a cockroach avenger taking out hired victims.

episodes.title: Looking For C/Dancing Hero
episodes.overview: As several of Double’s Gaia Memories are taken by the Cockroach Dopant, Shotaro tries to find his true identity while Philip tries to reunite the dance partners for their legendary move.

episodes.title: Trembling Before S/I Saw the Maid Detective!
episodes.overview: Akiko gets a job as a maid for the Sonozaki family in order to investigate a Dopant abducting pastry chefs.

episodes.title: Trembling Before S/The Ace Detective’s Daughter
episodes.overview: Shotaro gets embroiled deeper in the Sonozakis connection to the Dopants as Akiko attempts to find the criminal behind the patisserie abductions.

episodes.title: V For Vendetta/Infected Vehicle
episodes.overview: Shotaro decides to help an underworld gang after a member is killed by a Dopant-possessed car.

episodes.title: V For Vendetta/Raging Beast
episodes.overview: When the search for the Virus Dopant takes an unexpected turn, Shotaro and Philip must work to find the true controller and the reason behind their grudge.

episodes.title: Q on the Radio/Princess Under Fire
episodes.overview: Shotaro and Philip investigate a Dopant stalker causing chaos in order to impress Wakana.

episodes.title: Q on the Radio/Live Broadcast at the Riot
episodes.overview: As Shotaro continues to try and lure out Wakana’s violent stalker, Philip continues to get unusually close to the radio-broadcasting Sonozaki.

episodes.title: Flash of the F/Robbery Rider
episodes.overview: A suspicious woman hires Shotaro to find a Dopant who is running amuck while taking the name “Kamen Rider” as his own.

episodes.title: Flash of the F/Take Back Your Partner
episodes.overview: Discovering a horrible secret from Saeko and seeing his partners captured by Arms Dopant, Philip must figure a way to save them even if using the unstable Fang Memory.

episodes.title: Farewell to N/The Memory Kids
episodes.overview: When Shotaro is hired to find the daughter of his barber, he discovers horrible new developments regarding the Gaia Memories.

episodes.title: Farewell to N/Friends in the Wind
episodes.overview: As Shotaro and Philip discover the truth regarding the teens using the Bird Memory, Kirihiko discovers the truth behind Museum and his usage by the Sonozaki family.

episodes.title: I Won’t Stop/His Name is Accel
episodes.overview: The new leader of Fuuto Police’s Dopant investigation division uses Shotaro to track down a Dopant attacking victims with ice.

episodes.title: I Won’t Stop/Kamen Rider Style
episodes.overview: As Ryu’s intensity and Kamen Rider Accel powers threaten to harm innocents, Shotaro and Philip must discover the reason behind his anger while putting a stop to the ice-powered Dopant.

episodes.title: The Return of T/That Melody Doesn’t Suit A Lady
episodes.overview: Makura involves Shotaro in a case in rooting out a traitor within the Fuuto police leaking out information on the Gaia Memories.

episodes.title: The Return of T/The Undying Man
episodes.overview: Aya tries to gain Shotaro and Ryu’s trust in using her Dopant power to be an asset, hiding her true intentions and desires of her situation.

episodes.title: L on the Lips/Singer-Song Rider
episodes.overview: A request from Queen & Elizabeth leads to an investigation of a terrible street performer mysteriously winning a popular singing competition.

episodes.title: L on the Lips/You’re the Liar
episodes.overview: While trying to figure a means to defeat the tricky Liar Dopant, Shotaro confronts Jimmy about his confidence and trust in his female fan.

episodes.title: P’s Game/The Sticky Fingered Doll
episodes.overview: Akiko is asked by a little girl to find her lost doll, which has been terrorizing targets throughout Fuuto.

episodes.title: P’s Game/Akiko on the Run
episodes.overview: As Horinouchi is taken by the bizarre Dr. Isaka for further usage, Akiko tries to decipher the meaning of the doll and the truth behind Horinouchi’s daughter.

episodes.title: D Was Watching/Invisible Magical Lady
episodes.overview: A ditzy female magician who turns invisible asks Shotaro to find the seller of her Gaia Memory, which ultimately leads Terui to the man who killed his family.

episodes.title: D Was Watching/Life-or-Death Twin Maximum
episodes.overview: Akiko and Philip desperately try to stop Terui from taking immediate revenge on Shinkuro when he becomes key to saving Lily from her deadly Gaia Memory.

episodes.title: Nightmarish H/The Melancholy of Sleeping Beauty
episodes.overview: Shotaro accepted a request from a girl fearing a Dopant who attacks it’s victims in their dreams which it can control.

episodes.title: Nightmarish H/Who is the Prince?
episodes.overview: As Philip is taken by the Xtreme Memory to meet with Shroud, Shotaro continues to try and figure a way to discover the culprit behind Nightmare Dopant’s attacks.

episodes.title: The B Brought By the Wind/To Pursue The Beast
episodes.overview: A mob friend of Soukichi asks Shotaro to help him settle an old score and get back what he returned to Fuuto for.

episodes.title: The B Brought By the Wind/Now, Amidst the Radiance
episodes.overview: While under pressure of being abandoned by Philip as his Double partner for not keeping up, Shotaro tries to decipher the truth behind Bitou’s framing.

episodes.title: Y’s Tragedy/The Woman In Search of Yesterday
episodes.overview: Shotaro decides to help a peculiar woman find her lost cat while Terui investigates people committing strange actions beyond their control.

episodes.title: Y’s Tragedy/Brother and Sister
episodes.overview: Shotaro fights to prevent Yukie from joining the Museum for the sake of herself and of the memory of her deceased brother Kirihiko.

episodes.title: Beyond R/A Monstrous Rain Approaches
episodes.overview: As Shotaro is asked to pursue a young teacher by her students, Terui also goes after her due to a remarkable similarity between her and his deceased sister.

episodes.title: Beyond R/Leave All Behind
episodes.overview: Terui must master the Trial Memory in order to save Nagi from Shinkuro, who has made his move with Saeko for Ryuube’s downfall.

episodes.title: Visitor X/The Bridge of Promises
episodes.overview: Shotaro is hired to find a mysterious man’s family, while Philip is confronted by Wakana about her position in the Museum with her sister gone.

episodes.title: Visitor X/In the Name of the Museum
episodes.overview: As Terui tries to gain more information regarding Yamashiro’s knowledge of the Museum, Philip contemplates leaving Fuuto forever with Wakana.

episodes.title: The Likelihood of G/Bad Cinema Paradise
episodes.overview: Shotaro is brought in to help a movie-theater worker who has unwittingly become the star of an epic others are forced to watch.

episodes.title: The Likelihood of G/I Can’t Forgive You
episodes.overview: As Akiko desperately tries to complete Tooru’s movie, the insular director is targeted by Wakana to allow her access to the full potential of her Dopant power.

episodes.title: J’s Labyrinth/A Bizarre Villainess
episodes.overview: Jinno asks Shotaro to help him find a cold-hearted, diamond-obsessed woman who set him up for arrest.

episodes.title: J’s Labyrinth/A Damaged Diamond
episodes.overview: Shotaro fights to save Rui from destroying herself, while Philip tries to figure out how to outsmart Wakana in gaining his library research.

episodes.title: The O Cycle/Elderly Detective
episodes.overview: Shotaro and Terui are asked by a mother to save her daughter, who has been turned old to satisfy a grudge hit as Shroud approaches Phillip and Terui, wanting them to become Kamen Rider Double Cyclone Accel Xtreme.

episodes.title: The O Cycle/Shroud’s Confession
episodes.overview: Terui tries to decipher the truth regarding Shroud and her intentions as she tries to force him and Philip to join together into the ultimate Double to defeat Ryubee. Meanwhile, an agent of Foundation X takes possession of the new Gaia Memories…

episodes.title: What K Demands/The Devil’s Tail
episodes.overview: A request from a worker at the Fuuto museum forces Shotaro to find an artifact required by Ryuube for his final master plan.

episodes.title: What K Demands/The Last Supper
episodes.overview: With Shotaro gripped by fear and Terui injured, Philip is at the mercy of his father Ryuube, who prepares to use his son and Wakana to bring about Gaia Impact.

episodes.title: The Remaining U/Phillip’s Case
episodes.overview: Philip chooses to ask Shotaro to help him find Wakana, so he could see her one last time, as she is being held by Kazu for Foundation X’s own plans.

episodes.title: The Remaining U/Partners Forever
episodes.overview: Shotaro and Philip must endure the ultimate hardships to stop Kazu from completing his own Gaia Impact in order to complete what could be their final case together.

episodes.title: Goodbye to E/A Bouquet of Justice For This City
episodes.overview: One year after Philip’s departure, Shotaro continues onward alone, but a case involving saving a boy’s sister from Dopant bullies brings forth a change for the better.

episodes.title: Medal, Underwear, Mysterious Arm
episodes.overview: A mysterious arm reawakens the Greeed from their slumber and decides to use Eiji Hino, a cheerful wanderer, as his means of getting back what he desires as Kamen Rider OOO.

episodes.title: Greed, Ice Candy, Present
episodes.overview: Ankh explains the Greeed and the purpose of the Medals to Eiji, even as the human desires to merely use his new power to fight for good instead of for selfish needs.

episodes.title: Cat, Evolution, A Glutton
episodes.overview: Ankh becomes troubled when Eiji prevents him from eliminating his possessed body's sister while another Greeed uses a man's gluttony to create more Medals.

episodes.title: Doubt, Photo E-mail, Saving Hand
episodes.overview: Ankh threatens to leave OOO for Kazari and the Greeed while investigating the evolution of humanity while Eiji tries to find more about Hina.

episodes.title: Game of Tag, Nest, Celebrity
episodes.overview: Kougami asks for a share of Eiji and Ankh's Medals, while Mezool decides to use Hina's shopaholic classmate to create a new Yummy.

episodes.title: Western Clothing, A Contract, Ultimate Combo
episodes.overview: Hina confronts Yamano's shopping addiction when her father goes bankrupt while Ankh confronts Kougami about his share deal of the Cell Medals.

episodes.title: Useless Husband, A Trap, Big Win
episodes.overview: Eiji tries to research a husband bullied by his wife that is being mocked by Gamel while Ankh follows a lead for a missing Core Medal.

episodes.title: Slacking Off, Lack of Ambition, On a Break
episodes.overview: Eiji gets to the root of the Komoris' problem involving greed and loss of ambition while Ankh fights for survival after a failed confrontation with Uva.

episodes.title: Soaked, The Past, Scorching Hot Combo
episodes.overview: A serial bomber tied to a nest of Yummies leads to Eiji to reveal his past to Hina and forces him to encounter a strange man he believes is Mezool's victim.

episodes.title: Fist, An Experiment, Super Bike
episodes.overview: Eiji must figure the means of stopping the mad bomber and his Yummies to prevent any more lost lives, even with Maki observing the creation of his worker's monsters.

episodes.title: Traveler, Swallowtail Butterfly, Celebrity
episodes.overview: Eiji's traveler friend becomes manipulated by Uva into becoming famous as he steals others attributes; while Gotou doubts Eiji's effectiveness as OOO.

episodes.title: Unagi, The World, Heavy-Hitter Combo
episodes.overview: Eiji teaches a lesson to Tsukuba and Gotou about going forth to gain what is desired; while Ankh tries to figure a way to manage the flying Ageha Yummy using Gamel.

episodes.title: Siamese Cat, Stress, Genius Surgeon
episodes.overview: Ankh is at a breaking point with everything surrounding his human host; a highly sought after doctor has been repeatedly removed from the operating room, making her frustration a perfect target for the Greeed.

episodes.title: Pride, Surgery, Secret
episodes.overview: Both Hina's brother and the hospital director are in critical condition after Ankh's detachment and the Yummy attack. Eiji must find both Ankh and the affected surgeon before it's too late.

episodes.title: Struggle for the Medals, Transport Truck, Container
episodes.overview: Ankh finds one of his core medals; Gotou is transporting a truck full of medals to Doctor Maki; Kazari appears to Ankh and Eiji, telling them that Hina is in Gotou's truck.

episodes.title: Conclusion, Greeed, New Rider
episodes.overview: Eiji learns about how the Greeed were born; Gamel searches for Mezool; Kamen Rider Birth joins the fight.

episodes.title: Kendo Girl, Oden, Splitting Yummy
episodes.overview: The Greeed take an interest in a girl who wants to get better at kendo; Ankh takes an interest in Kamen Rider Birth; Hina gives both Eiji and Ankh gifts for saving her.

episodes.title: Destruction, A Reason, Unagi Whip
episodes.overview: Eiji and Ankh try to find out the reason that the Yummy split in two, but Kamen Rider Birth is one step ahead of them.

episodes.title: A Red Medal, A Detective, A Betrayal
episodes.overview: Kougami tries to give Eiji one of Ankh's medals, but he refuses; a face from the detective's past shows up at Cous Coussier; thanks to Kazari, a criminal that the detective put away is on the streets and looking for revenge.

episodes.title: Decoy, Qualifications, Flaming Combo
episodes.overview: Ankh tricks Kazari by telling him that Eiji knows where his last medal is and then chases after Hina who has his own medal; Date and Gotou discuss the skills need to be Kamen Rider Birth; Kougami changes his mind and sends Ankh's medal to Eiji.

episodes.title: Hopper, Parent and Child, Hero
episodes.overview: The Cous Coussier gang runs into a young boy getting attacked for telling off a man for littering, learning that it's something he picked up from his father; the Greeed creates a Yummy from the desire to help people.

episodes.title: Choco, Conviction, Power of Justice
episodes.overview: Susumu lets his desire for justice get out of hand and it's up to Eiji to stop him before it's too late; Gotou and Takashi have a heart-to-heart conversation about their ideals.

episodes.title: Beauty, Egg, Dormant Desire
episodes.overview: Kazari is drawn to the vanity of woman whose sister takes all the credit for her work.

episodes.title: Memory, Love, Sea Combo
episodes.overview: Eiji is head over heels for Yuumi and it's up to Date to save his old friend before she does something that she'll regret.

episodes.title: Boxer, Left Hand, Bird Yummy
episodes.overview: Ankh is acting more standoffish than usual; a boxer is forced into retirement just before a big match and is captured by a bird Yummy.

episodes.title: Ankh, Ring, Pile on Everything
episodes.overview: Eiji is still super beat up from the previous battle but he is the only one who believes that Ankh did not create the bird Yummy; Kazuki heads back to the ring as Date and Gotou rush to stop him from injuring himself more.

episodes.title: 1000, Movie, Combatant
episodes.overview: Kougami invites Eiji and Ankh over to celebrate the 1000th episode of Kamen Rider and decides to make a movie to celebrate; Kazari is drawn to a Shocker grunt who joins the movie.

episodes.title: 1000, Kamen Rider, Birthday
episodes.overview: Even though he's injured, Date still wants to finish directing the movie; Sendou starts sabotaging the movie with his new friends.

episodes.title: Older Sister, Doctor, The Truth About Ankh
episodes.overview: Kazari uses Dr. Maki's desire to make a Yummy; Gotou goes back to work; a strange monster shows up with Ankh's other arm.

episodes.title: King, Panda, Memory of Flame
episodes.overview: Dr. Maki and Chiyoko have a heart-to-heart talk about his sister; Kazari takes Ankh's memoryless body under his wing; Kougami tells Gotou the story of the medals as Eiji and Date get Ankh to finally tell his story.

episodes.title: Repaying a Favor, Scheme, Purple Medals
episodes.overview: Dr. Maki and Kazari try to awaken a brand new Greeed; a man has been unknowingly using Greeed money to pay off an old debt; Eiji gets infected by purple core medals.

episodes.title: A New Greeed, Void, Unrivaled Combo
episodes.overview: An x-ray reveals that there should be nothing wrong with Eiji; Date tells the others about the time he previously ran into Eiji; Eiji uses the purple medals.

episodes.title: Friendship, Out of Control, Left-Behind Belt
episodes.overview: Eiji is forced to use the purple medals again; an old friend from High School invites Eiji to an amusement park where Hina is then kidnapped; a Yummy abducts Date and Gotou.

episodes.title: Best Friends, Using, That Relationship
episodes.overview: Ankh tells Eiji about what his friend has been doing; a Yummy kidnaps Ankh; Eiji forces himself to use the purple medals.

episodes.title: Dreams, Brother, Birth's Secret
episodes.overview: Hina wins first place in a fashion contest and is offered a chance to study in France; Dr. Maki creates a Yummy that destroys people's dreams; Date collapses in battle and Kougami finds an interesting x-ray on his brain.

episodes.title: Broken Dream, Body, Greeed Revival
episodes.overview: Hina's brother has woken up, leaving Ankh without a host; Eiji discovers Hina destroying all of her clothes after getting her dream broken; Uva revives Mezool and Gamel.

episodes.title: Sleep, 100 Million, Birth's Employment Shift
episodes.overview: Gotou finds Date avoiding his checkup; a Yummy causes people all over the city to suffer from insomnia; Dr. Maki makes Date an offer.

episodes.title: A Situation, A Parting, A Tearful Birth
episodes.overview: Date joins forces with the Greeed; Gotou tries to raise the 100 million yen himself; a new Birth is born.

episodes.title: Nightmare, Surveillance Camera, Ankh Strikes Back
episodes.overview: Ankh has nightmares about losing Eiji to the purple medals and other Ankh; a man has set up surveillance cameras all over the neighborhood, trying to force out Eiji and Ankh because they make the neighborhood look bad; now that Gotou is Birth, Kougami assigns Satonaka as Birth's new partner.

episodes.title: Control, Birthday Party, Ankh Disappears
episodes.overview: The Cous Coussier crew get thrown out of town where they decide to throw Ankh the birthday party for Hina's brother; the Yummy has holed himself up with a human barricade, forcing our heroes to wait until he surfaces again; the other Ankh waits for his other self to let his guard down so that he can become whole again.

episodes.title: Siblings, Rescue, Eiji Leaves
episodes.overview: Ankh is absorbed into a single body, but the two halves are still not completely whole; Eiji begins to wonder about his place in the Izumi family's life as Shingo tries to help him out in Ankh's place; Gotou helps Eiji on his mission to rescue Ankh, but Eiji is stopped by Dr. Maki.

episodes.title: Ice, Greeed Form, Broken Wings
episodes.overview: Dr. Maki explains to Eiji about the process of becoming a Greeed and the dulling of the human senses, leading Eiji to discover that it is already happening to him; a Yummy is trapping people in ice and calling out for OOO's help, but HIna refuses to let him go; Eiji does battle with Ankh, destroying.his core medals.

episodes.title: Vulture, Antagonism, Ankh Returns
episodes.overview: After Ankh's cores were destroyed, he becomes in need of a body and yet again takes the detective's, also realizing that he's different now and creates a Yummy; Hina comes to the conclusion that she's been too selfish and reliant in regards to other people, making the decision to change and stand by Eiji no matter what; Ankh revives Uva and makes a deal with Dr. Maki to become his container of medals.

episodes.title: All Members Together, Full Revival, Your Desire
episodes.overview: Kazari and Ankh butt heads over who is the leader of the Greeed; Hina and Gotou try to find Eiji's desire so that the purple medals will stop making him go berserk; Hina stops Ankh from taking medals from Eiji, but Kazari swoops in and gets the last of his nine medals; Eiji destroys one of Kazari's core medals, allowing Dr. Maki to steal the remaining medals from a weakened Kazari.

episodes.title: Surprise Attack, Proto Birth, Desire for Love
episodes.overview: With Birth in need of repair, Erika retrieves the Prototype Birth driver in order to make do; because they are at a major disadvantage, Eiji and Gotou decide to go on the offense and attack the Greeed first; the other Greeed confront Dr. Maki and Ankh, with Mezool fully reviving and leaving Gamel, who also has the remainder of his medals.

episodes.title: Eiji Greeed, W Births, Ankh's Desire
episodes.overview: Gamel rampages throughout the city trying to revive Mezool with one of her core medals; Eiji washes up on the beach with the purple medals acting up, and before he can find his driver, Ankh shows up to stop him from turning into a Greeed; Gotou has his Birth driver back, but he's in trouble and Erika gives the prototype to a familiar face.

episodes.title: Red Days, Fulfilled, Eiji the Container
episodes.overview: Dr. Maki makes Eiji go berserk and fight Ankh when he won't give up the purple medals, but Ankh can't force himself to purposefully hurt Eiji; Ankh believes that one of his medals was broken by Dr. Maki and lets Hina know that her brother will be returned soon; Eiji discovers his true desire; Uva is fully revived.

episodes.title: Tomorrow's Medals, Underwear, A Grasping Hand
episodes.overview: Eiji receives a present from Kougami; Dr. Maki decides to make Uva the container for the core medals; Ankh returns to Eiji's side as they prepare for the final battle.

episodes.title: Transforming High School Life
episodes.overview: The new school year begins at Amanogawa High School, and Kengo Utahoshi is detecting strange energies around the school. And things get stranger when yankee-looking Gentaro Kisaragi transfers into the school and decides that he wants to be Kengo's friend.

episodes.title: Come On, Outer Space
episodes.overview: Kengo reveals to Gentaro that he must turn off the Zodiarts Switch used by the person who activated it in order to truly defeat a Zodiarts. As Gentaro and Yuki search the campus for the owner of the Zodiarts Switch, she begins to tell Gentaro more about Kengo and how he came to have the Fourze Driver and the Astroswitches.

episodes.title: The Queen Festival Competition
episodes.overview: When the annual Queen Festival comes around, Gentaro decides if he wants to befriend Miu Kazashiro, he must convince Yuki to enter a talent contest that Miu wins every year and beat her.

episodes.title: Changes and Secret Moves
episodes.overview: Gentaro decides to help Miu retain her title as Queen and Fourze goes after the Chameleon Zodiarts to protect Miu.

episodes.title: Two Sides to Friendship
episodes.overview: While Miu intergrates herself with the group, JK finds himself being targeted by a Zodiarts and Gentaro finds a new Astroswitch difficult to use, the Elek Switch.

episodes.title: Full Blown Electric Assault
episodes.overview: Gentaro finds out that JK was just using him for protection against the Zodiarts and has stolen the Elek Astroswitch but Gentaro is determined to show JK the power of frienship and help JK despite being tricked by the other.

episodes.title: A Really Cruel King
episodes.overview: Kengo, Yuuki, and Gentaro are forced to take supplementary lessons on a Sunday due to missing classes whilst defeating Zodiarts. Meanwhile, Shun grows angry with the Kamen Rider Club and Miu's involvement with them. JK and Miu try and hold down the fort whilst the others are in class.

episodes.title: Coordinating with Heavy Metal
episodes.overview: Gentaro, Miu, JK, and Yuuki continue to track down the Hound Zodiarts, and Shun decides it's time to make his own choices about his friends and school activities.

episodes.title: Birth of a Witch
episodes.overview: Tomoko tells the group that the end of the world is coming- and that she will become the Luna Witch. When three witches and Tomoko start performing magic around the school the Kamen Rider Club must find out whether this is witchcraft or actually a Zodiarts.

episodes.title: Collision in the Moonlight
episodes.overview: Tomoko must decide whether to use a Zodiarts Switch to get her wish or help the others defeat the Zodiarts currently rampaging through the school.

episodes.title: Disappearing Moon Door
episodes.overview: Yuuki is targeted by a Zodiarts who is obsessed with her. Meanwhile, the locker which attaches the Rabbit Hatch to the school goes missing leaving Kengo trapped on the moon.

episodes.title: Mission: Ken's Life
episodes.overview: The Pyxis Zodiarts decides the only way to get revenge is to use his power to kill all the girls who rejected him, including Miu, by driving a bus with them all inside off of a bridge. Meanwhile, Kengo is still trapped in the rabbit Hatch.

episodes.title: School Refusal
episodes.overview: Gentaro and the others decide to bring back those students who were Zodiarts to the school, starting with Toshiya Miura.

episodes.title: Stinger Onslaught
episodes.overview: To save Miura from using a Zodiarts Switch again Gentaro must go up against one of the Horoscopes, Scorpian, a commander Zodiarts.

episodes.title: Christmas Eve Choir
episodes.overview: Yuuki is invited to join the Glee Club for a performance for the Kindergarten Class, however, her singing disrupts a fellow student in possession of a Zodiarts Switch.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong Conflict
episodes.overview: The Perseus Zodiarts seems to be too powerful for Fourze to stop on his own, however, the appearance of the new Kamen Rider Meteor may change this battles ending...

episodes.title: Meteor Appearance
episodes.overview: After Kengo reaches a dead end in finding out the identity of the mysterious new Rider, Sonoda-sensei introduces new transfer student, Ryuusei Sakuta.

episodes.title: Gen/Ryu Showdown
episodes.overview: Ryuusei tries to gain membership to the Kamen Rider Club to further his own agenda but whilst most of the Club is fine with a new member, Gentaro is against Ryuusei joining...

episodes.title: Steel Dragon, Unmatched
episodes.overview: Kengo has a fight with Gentaro due to his decision to let Ryusei for adjusting the Astroswitch (the reason of fight actually because trying to complete the imperfect Magnets Switch)

episodes.title: Transcendent Magnetism
episodes.overview: Gentaro and Kengo must find a way to overcome their rift before a powerful Zodiarts defeats both Fourze and Meteor.

episodes.title: Mislead Course
episodes.overview: With Sonoda still absent from the school Gentaro's class gets a new homeroom teacher who is far more interested in Kickboxing than teaching.

episodes.title: True Self Dismissal
episodes.overview: Gentaro and the others are convinced that their new Homeroom Teacher is the Zodiarts that is currently rampaging, however, Ryusei figures out that the culprit is not their teacher.

episodes.title: Swan Alliance
episodes.overview: Gentaro and friends hear about a new hero from their classmate Norio Eguchi, who identifies the hero as Cygnus and also happens to be a member of the Ugly Duckling Society, a fan club dedicated to Cygnus. However, this new hero is not as good as he seems...

episodes.title: Hero's Desire
episodes.overview: The gang must race to find out who the Switcher is- before the new 'hero' wipes out Fourze and Meteor to become the sole hero in the city...

episodes.title: Graduation Reluctance
episodes.overview: Miu and Shun are due to graduate- however, it seems like it might not be smooth sailing as previous Zodiarts return.

episodes.title: Perfect Round Dance
episodes.overview: Gentaro and the others protect the Prom for their friends who are graduating, while, Miu and Shun deal with the fact that they won't be part of the Kamen Rider Club anymore as they are going to college.

episodes.title: Transformation Rejected
episodes.overview: During Spring Break the gang decide to try and make the most of what should be a Zodiarts free time, however, Kijima tries to recruit Ryuusei to his side whilst playing a deadly game with students. And those who don't win are placed into permanent comas.

episodes.title: Star Storm Comeback
episodes.overview: The Cancer Zodiarts threatens the members of the Kamen Rider Club now that he has attained the Supernova ability. While he still cannot transform, Ryusei discovers that Jiro's condition has taken a turn for the worse.

episodes.title: Junior Silence
episodes.overview: Gentaro and his friends enter the third-year class headed by Mr. Ohsugi, and Gentaro tries to befriend new first-year students Haru and Ran. However, Haru is given a Zodiarts Switch by the Libra Zodiarts.

episodes.title: Senior, Useless
episodes.overview: Gentaro and the Kamen Rider Club must figure out how to deal with Haru as the Musca Zodiarts and Mr. Ohsugi's discovery of the Rabbit Hatch, along with the latter's confiscation of the 38th Astroswitch.

episodes.title: Subaruboshi Kingdom
episodes.overview: After the 39th and 40th Astroswitches are developed, Amanogawa and Subaruboshi High Schools hold a test transfer of some of AGHS's students to SBHS, which causes problems when the Aries Zodiarts makes itself known to the AGHS students...

episodes.title: Super Space Sword
episodes.overview: After Gentaro's death at Ryusei's hands, Kengo does not know how to resurrect him as the Aries Zodiarts takes the other Kamen Rider Club members captive. Elsewhere, having betrayed Tachibana, Ryusei is able to talk to the revived Jiro.

episodes.title: Ancient City Mayhem
episodes.overview: The third-year class goes on a field trip to Kyoto where they believe they will be free from the Zodiarts for once, but are ambushed by the Libra and Leo Zodiarts. While there, Kengo meets one of his father's old friends. Meanwhile, a enamored girl is determined to snag Gentaro's heart, and poor Yuki is forced to help...

episodes.title: Heavenly Hole, Offensive and Defensive
episodes.overview: The Kamen Rider Club must work to stop the Libra and Leo Zodiarts from destroying the last two altars in Kyoto to destroy the city with The Hole's Cosmic Energy. In the process, Kengo finally learns the circumstances of his father's death.

episodes.title: Monster's Broadcast
episodes.overview: With The Hole gone from Kyoto, AGHS is the focus of its Cosmic Energy and the other Horoscopes will soon be found. An internet radio show started up by the mysterious DJ Gene, soon discovered to be none other than JK, grabs the school by storm. He starts up a musical contest, which grabs the attention of the Kamen Rider Club and a fellow student who turns out to be the Capricorn Zodiarts.

episodes.title: Serious Legend Song
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider Fourze must defeat both the Capricorn Zodiarts and the Zodiarts' song that has enraptured the school, but with Cosmicstates out of commission after Gentaro's bond with JK is severed, can he find a way to rebond?

episodes.title: Star Follower Selection
episodes.overview: Gentaro, Yuki, Kengo, Tomoko, Ryusei, the student council president Sugiura, the former Pyxis Zodiarts Hiroki Makise, and transfer student Erin Suda are chosen for an astronaut test in a closed environment and endurance test, but Kengo's weak constitution and the arrival of the Aquarius Zodiarts cause trouble for the group.

episodes.title: Winner Determination
episodes.overview: Yuki passes under suspicious means, while Gentaro tries to convince Erin to not follow the path the Horoscopes want of her, as well as give up her hatred for Yuki.

episodes.title: Campus Decree
episodes.overview: Acting student council president Sugiura institutes a new set of rules that all students have to follow, severely limiting the freedoms the school initially allowed them.

episodes.title: Principle or Pathos
episodes.overview: As the Taurus Zodiarts, Sugiura continues to stifle everyone's creativity, but Ryusei (as Meteor) challenges to a game of golf to get everything back to the way it was, while Gentaro and Yuki try to find out why Yuta had changed.

episodes.title: Club Collapse
episodes.overview: The Virgo Zodiarts begins attacking other members of the Kamen Rider Club, scaring them away from the club, blocking Fourze from accessing Cosmicstates. However, Tachibana arrives on Earth to show Gentaro a way to fight with other abilities at his disposal.

episodes.title: Archer's Reign
episodes.overview: With most of the Kamen Rider Club taken out of commission the Virgo Zodiarts, Gentaro and Kengo are on their own in their fight against Virgo after Meteor is sent to the Dark Nebula and the others distance themselves from the Club. And things get worse when the new powerful member of the Horoscopes, Sagittarius, appears...

episodes.title: Light and Dark Twins
episodes.overview: Yuki starts acting stranger than usual, and when strange incidents gets traced back to Yuki, and Yuki somehow transforming into the Gemini Zodiarts, Gentaro begins to suspect something is up.

episodes.title: Star Luck Ritual
episodes.overview: The Kamen Rider Club work to save Yuki from ceasing to exist as Dark Yuki begins to take her place as the real Yuki.

episodes.title: Scale's Estrangement
episodes.overview: While celebrating Kengo's birthday, the Horoscopes have located their final member, Pisces, in Ran Kuroki, who has been given the chance to study abroad in America. But after Leo attacks, Hayami gathers the Kamen Rider Club to tell them the truth of what has been happening and prevent Ran from becoming the final Horoscopes.

episodes.title: Aloof Archer
episodes.overview: Ran refuses to give her Pisces Zodiarts Switch that will finalize Gamou's plans, so he sends Tatsugami to take her Switch. Elsewhere, Kengo discovers a secret from the USB drive he found in the late Emoto's office.

episodes.title: Parting Friends
episodes.overview: With Gamou's scheme with all twelve Horoscopes Switches thwarted, Kengo reveals the truth of his origins to the Kamen Rider Club and his eventually parting with his friends. However, the Horoscopes attack the Rabbit Hutch to kill Kengo, getting the Kamen Riders to desperately fight back to protect their friend, who must go back to the Presenters.

episodes.title: Final Episode: Youthful Galaxy
episodes.overview: With Kengo's death at the hands of Sagittarius Nova and the destruction of the Rabbit Hatch, a distraught Kamen Rider Club reads the final letter from the Core Child written before his death. A resolved duo of Riders must face the Horoscopes one last time to avenge their fallen friend and stop the Day of Awakening for good.

episodes.title: The Ringed Magician
episodes.overview: When strange magical creatures including something resembling the Minotaur begin to attack in Toriizaka, they are all confronted by a man with a strange ring and belt calling himself "Wizard".

episodes.title: I Want to Be a Magician
episodes.overview: While trying to battle the Phantom Hellhound, Haruto is accosted by Shunpei Nara, who wants to be a magician just like him.

episodes.title: Transform! Live Broadcast
episodes.overview: Shunpei Nara decides to go on live television to show off his burgeoning magical powers while Haruto tries to deal with both the young man and Hellhound's attempts to attack him now that it is clear Shunpei is a Gate.

episodes.title: The Doll and the Pianist
episodes.overview: While trying to fight a new Phantom that has appeared looking for a new Gate, Koyomi is suddenly attacked by Medusa.

episodes.title: The Deciding Match of the Contest
episodes.overview: Haruto must find a way to defeat Caitsith before he converts Takagi while also helping Koyomi discover the truth of her origins.

episodes.title: To a Beautiful Flower
episodes.overview: Shunpei, the donut shop worker, and Wajima all fall for a woman selling power stones, but she sticks close to Haruto, particularly when a Phantom appears to be chasing after her.

episodes.title: Buying Memories
episodes.overview: Yamagata must remember where he first met Manami before she falls victim to Gnome and falls into despair.

episodes.title: A New Magic Stone
episodes.overview: After a mysterious white Garuda delivers a new Magic Ring and stone to Omokagedo, Medusa sends out Ghouls to attack a young boy who is suspected of being a Gate as Haruto finds himself facing Phoenix.

episodes.title: Dragon's Cry
episodes.overview: After finding out that Hiroki is the son of his old friend Mikiko, Haruto suggests that he watches over him until the Phantom case is solved. However, Phoenix attacks Mikiko instead of bringing Hiroki into despair and when Haruto realises this, he searches for his father.

episodes.title: National Security Agency's Section Zero
episodes.overview: The National Security Agency's Section Zero obtains a green Magic Stone, and so Kizaki abducts Wajima so he can commission his own Wizard Ring. At that time, a Phantom arrives to create a new Phantom from a child traveling from Akita to Tokyo, leaving Haruto alone on his mission.

episodes.title: The Promise to Defend
episodes.overview: While hunting down Gargoyle and having to deal with Kizaki, Kamen Rider Wizard appears to fall into a trap set up by Phoenix.

episodes.title: The Wagashi of Hope
episodes.overview: After receiving a new Magic Stone from Kizaki, Shunpei believes that Haruto's abilities are getting better enough for him to start teaching him magic. Meanwhile, a high school student named Tetsuya begins an apprenticeship at a wagashi store and is targeted by the Phantoms.

episodes.title: Heir to the Dream
episodes.overview: As Haruto must keep Valkyrie and Medusa from placing Matsuki in despair, Shunpei questions his worth in helping in the fight against the Phantoms.

episodes.title: The Film Director Came Back
episodes.overview: As Haruto fights a familiar Phantom on a film set, Koyomi starts to think that she remembers some of the people involved in the filming.

episodes.title: After the Last Scene is...
episodes.overview: Haruto must stop Lizardman from bringing Chizuru into the depths of despair while trying to figure out what Satoshi's plans are.

episodes.title: The Miracle of Christmas
episodes.overview: Around Christmas time, Misa locates a new Gate in the form of a young man with a Yankee fashion sense named Tatsuro, and Haruto must get to the bottom of what his hopes are in order to protect him from becoming a Phantom.

episodes.title: Another Magician
episodes.overview: Both the Phantoms and Haruto keep an eye on the mysterious young man Kosuke Nitoh.

episodes.title: The Magic of Food
episodes.overview: Haruto's and Kosuke's differing ways of handling things, from how to approach the issue on Phantoms to even eating doughnuts, causes a rift between the two magicians.

episodes.title: Today's Life, the Life of Tomorrow
episodes.overview: The three-way battle between Kamen Rider Wizard, Kamen Rider Beast, and the Phantom Hydra continues, with Oikawa's livelihood at stake as he is on the verge of becoming a Phantom. To try to get Kosuke to change his mind, Shunpei and Rinko tell him what really happens to Gates when they fall into despair.

episodes.title: Learning the Truth
episodes.overview: While Haruto tries to help Shiho, a housewife whose life is falling apart around her after being attacked by Ghouls and the new Phantom, Rinko tries to discover the identity of a young man who got into a drunken fight, without knowing that he is the Phantom Phoenix.

episodes.title: The Dragons' Wild Dance
episodes.overview: Kamen Rider Wizard takes on the Beelzebub Phantom. Meanwhile, Rinko discovers more on the identity of Yugo, and discovers what had happened to him.

episodes.title: The Phoenix's Rampage
episodes.overview: When Rinko disappears and all that's found is her bloodied ID, Haruto seeks out her attacker, unaware that Yugo has disobeyed Wiseman and acted on his own volition, with Rinko in the way of his goals.

episodes.title: The Decisive Battle
episodes.overview: With Rinko's life on the line, Haruto readies himself for a battle with Phoenix who has become more powerful, despite Kosuke's intention to take Phoenix's magical power for himself.

episodes.title: The Magician's Grandmother
episodes.overview: Kosuke's grandmother, Toshie, has appeared to visit him, but things get personal when she and Shunpei are targeted by the newest Phantoms.

episodes.title: Choosing the Life
episodes.overview: Gremlin and Weretiger keep Shunpei hostage and offer to free him in exchange for Toshie. Meanwhile, Kosuke has a crisis over his choice to become the Ancient Magician, as it has brought danger to his loved ones. Toshie, however, is willing to give up her life to free Shunpei...

episodes.title: Academy Infiltration
episodes.overview: Kosuke discovers Medusa's true identity as the school-aged girl Misa and attacks her, only for Rinko to arrest him. Going on the magician's hunch that she's after another schoolgirl as a Gate, Haruto and Shunpei attend the school to try to thwart Medusa's plans.

episodes.title: Big Sister and Little Sister
episodes.overview: When it is discovered that Mayu is the twin sister of Misa, the girl who has become Medusa, Mayu makes it her mission to seek out the one part of her sister that is still alive within Medusa, even though Haruto believes it is better to save Takako first.

episodes.title: The Stolen Belt
episodes.overview: Kosuke is meeting an archeologist to get the new Beast Color and a gun-like weapon. However, the BeastDriver is suddenly stolen. To make things worse, Gremlin and a new Phantom appear to defeat the magicians.

episodes.title: The Evolving Wild Beast
episodes.overview: Kosuke must find a way to retrieve his Beast Driver and Wizard Rings back from Spriggan while Chimera tells him about his chance to eat him alive.

episodes.title: The Day Magic Vanished
episodes.overview: Gremlin unleashes a dangerous Phantom who assumes form of a man called Naitō. But unlike the Phantoms Haruto and Kosuke had faced before, Naitō is attacking humans without discrimination.

episodes.title: Tears
episodes.overview: With Legion too strong for even Kosuke to battle, Haruto must find a way to restore Wizardragon's powers before Legion strikes again.

episodes.title: Dangerous Part-Time Job
episodes.overview: Nitoh's high school friend Tsuchiya arrives in town, having discovered a job offer that will pay ¥1 million for a day's work. Nitoh joins him on the interview, but Haruto and Koyomi suspect something is off.

episodes.title: Things Money Cannot Buy
episodes.overview: Haruto and Nitoh must race to Tokyo to save Tsuchiya, who has won a shopping spree at a mall, as well as 5 other contestants, from falling victim to the Phantom Bogy.

episodes.title: The Reverse Side of a Popular Model
episodes.overview: While Haruto and Rinko send by Kizaki to investigate Gremlin's human identity as Sora, Nitoh and Shunpei help save a young woman attacked as a possible Gate, only to discover that she is their favorite fashion model Chiaki. Meanwhile, Gremlin is acting stranger than usual...

episodes.title: The Other Side of Sora
episodes.overview: With Chiaki revealed to be the Gate sought out by Argus, Omokagedō group tries to figure out what her despair may arise from, with Nitoh believing it may be her loss of popularity. Elsewhere, Haruto has met with Sora, the Gremlin Phantom, and upon realizing that not is all it seems, asks Rinko and Section 0 to investigate, and they discover what exactly happened to Sora Takigawa, as Haruto suspects the Phantom still has his human mind.

episodes.title: The Myna Speaks
episodes.overview: With Sora's words in mind, Haruto meet Wiseman to get answers. Meanwhile, Rinko investigates an arson case with Shunpei, only to discover that a man with a caged myna bird may be a Gate.

episodes.title: Wanted: Despair
episodes.overview: The group must protect Nemoto from both the Phantom Raum and the police who want to question him on an arson case. However, can they clear Rinko's name before it's too late?

episodes.title: The Stolen Hope
episodes.overview: When Haruto goes to save a soccer player from a Phantom, the man recognizes him, and Haruto's former dreams of being a professional soccer player are revealed. Elsewhere, a well-dressed man enters the Omokagedō, although his reasons are not clear.

episodes.title: What was Forgotten on the Pitch
episodes.overview: With Kazuya in the hospital, Haruto must find a way to defeat the Phantom Bahamut, even though the Phantom is much too powerful for him as Kamen Rider Wizard. Meanwhile, the mysterious Fueki commissions a Wizard Ring from Wajima.

episodes.title: I Want to Ride a Bike
episodes.overview: While Rinko tries to investigate Fueki, Nitoh starts to teach a boy named Yuzuru to ride a bicycle after he watches Kamen Rider Beast battle a Phantom and his Ghouls with a mountain bike.

episodes.title: Magician is Fate
episodes.overview: With Mayu now as Kamen Rider Mage, she focuses her attention on her former sister Medusa, with Haruto asking her what her true goals are now that she is a witch. Meanwhile, Sylphi continues its attack on Yuzuru, just as White Wizard gains interest in him as well.

episodes.title: The Ringed Novelist
episodes.overview: Haruto is alarmed to find Kizaki has disappeared after he has been asked to search for Fueki, who kidnapped Yuzuru to seek out another person worthy of becoming a magician. After Kamen Rider Wizard saves Saionji, a novelist, Saionji reveals he is looking for a young woman to give him the inspiration to write again.

episodes.title: White Wizard's Secret
episodes.overview: Saionji reveals it is Koyomi who he has been looking for all this time, saying he met her once 10 years ago. Meanwhile, Sora warns Nitoh about White Wizard, and he prepares to face him in battle as Kamen Rider Beast and Beast Hyper.

episodes.title: The Son's Keepsake
episodes.overview: Haruto discovers that Koyomi is the daughter of Fueki, but he keeps this to himself. Meanwhile, elementary school teacher Yoshikazu Kumagai, who comes to the Omokagedō to purchase an antique toy plane for his late son, is discovered to be a Gate when he is attacked by the Phantom Siren.

episodes.title: A Smile in the Chest
episodes.overview: Haruto must split his attention on saving Kumagai from Siren while they try to find a toy for his son and revealing what he knows to Koyomi about her past. Meanwhile, a red crack appears on Koyomi's hand. What does this mean? Medusa and Mayu face each other again.

episodes.title: Shattered Memory
episodes.overview: Mayu approaches White Wizard asking to become stronger so she may defeat Medusa. Haruto and Nitoh have trouble battling a fast moving Phantom. Sora approaches Haruto at Hungry, inquiring as to whether or not he has found out about Koyomi's past.

episodes.title: Wiseman's Truth
episodes.overview: Even though Haruto reveals that Koyomi is Fueki's daughter, the group keeps their mission to save Yamamoto from Arachne, particularly when his pregnant wife Aya goes missing.

episodes.title: The Philosopher's Stone
episodes.overview: With the knowledge that Fueki is not only White Wizard, Koyomi's father, and the Phantoms' leader Wiseman, Haruto, Kosuke, and Mayu work together to try to discover his true plans.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the Sabbath
episodes.overview: With Yamamoto and Yuzuru both Kamen Rider Mages under White Wizard's thrall, Haruto and Koyomi are kidnapped to begin the new Sabbath. After Kosuke is approached by Beast Chimera in his dreams, he goes to assist Rinko and Shunpei to help save Haruto and Koyomi.

episodes.title: The Important Thing is...
episodes.overview: Haruto finds he must battle White Wizard on his own for Koyomi's sake after Kosuke uses the last of his mana to disrupt the Sabbath. Elsewhere, Yuzuru and Yamamoto come to their senses and plan to fight alongside Mayu and Haruto for Kosuke.

episodes.title: The Last Hope
episodes.overview: With Gremlin in possession of the Philosopher's Stone, Koyomi dies. However, Fueki says that the light in Haruto's heart is the true Philosopher's Stone. Meanwhile, Gremlin, now evolved, goes on a rampage, and Kosuke cannot battle to save anyone or even himself from the monstrous Phantom.

episodes.title: The Kamen Rider Rings
episodes.overview: After Gremlin's defeat, Haruto is lost in the World of Kaijin, a parallel world where it is inhabited by monsters created by an entity called Amadum who wants to steal the powers of the Kamen Riders for himself. Using the Legend Rider Rings, he will summon 13 Heisei Kamen Riders.

episodes.title: Neverending Story
episodes.overview: Haruto and Kosuke must defeat Amadum before he can use the Rider Rings to transform their world into a kaijin's paradise.

episodes.title: Transform! An Orange Fell From the Sky!?
episodes.overview: While in Zawame's Free Performance Zone, Mai and Mitsuzane of the dance team Team Gaim are having a free-spirited dance when members of rival Team Baron scare them away when an Inves Game gets out of hand. When Mai goes to former teammate Kouta Kazuraba to reveal something strange has happened, he reveals that Team Gaim's leader Yuya gave him a strange Lockseed, and Mai reveals Yuuya informed her of it as well. The two eventually find a way into the Helheim Forest that has appeared in the Free Performance Zone.

episodes.title: Finisher! Pine Kick!
episodes.overview: Kouta tries to use his new abilities to help out at his part-time job, but he only gets in the way. And when Yuuya mysteriously disappears, Kouta wonders if what happened in the forest was real, and now that he is in charge of Team Gaim, he must lead the group in a dance-off against Team Baron.

episodes.title: Shock! My Rival Transforms into a Banana!?
episodes.overview: Kouta starts to gain a reputation in Inves Games by fighting them as Kamen Rider Gaim, when Kaito Kumon reveals he too has a Sengoku Driver and the Banana Lockseed.

episodes.title: Birth! The Third One is a Grape Rider!
episodes.overview: Kouta and Kaito work together to try to find Yuya, but they instead face off against an even more terrible enemy.

episodes.title: Revive! The Strawberry Arms of Friendship!
episodes.overview: Kouta tries to overcome the events that befell him in the Helheim Forest against Zangetsu while Kaito challenges Mitsuzane to a fight, with the new Armored Rider Ryugen unable to fight Baron on his own.

episodes.title: The Durian Rider appears!
episodes.overview: Hase and Jonouchi transform into Armored Riders Kurokage and Gridon, but something strange happens during their fight with Baron against Gaim and Ryugen. Later, Kouta tries to get a part-time job at a pastry shop, only to be disturbed by the effeminate head chef.

episodes.title: Giant Watermelon, Big Bang!
episodes.overview: After easily defeating both Kurokage and Gridon, Kamen Rider Bravo steals their Lockseeds and sets his sights on defeating all of the Armored Riders. Kouta is angered that Oren has made it his mission to defeat all of the Armored Riders, but Kaito just tells him to beat him to get it over with. Before long, Bravo issues a challenge to Baron, but it is not Baron who he is really after.

episodes.title: Baron's New Power, Mango!
episodes.overview: After his defeat at the hands of Bravo, Kaito believes he is no longer strong enough and seeks out a new strength. While Kouta seeks out a new job, Mai finds herself trapped in the Helheim Forest again, forcing Kouta and Mitch to go and rescue her.

episodes.title: The Big Plan to Capture the Monster Inves
episodes.overview: Kouta and Mitsuzane must hunt down a fully manifested Inves that is randomly attacking people in the city while also dealing with keeping up their Beat Rider ranking.

episodes.title: Big Rider Gathering! Expose the Mystery of the Forest!
episodes.overview: Kouta and Mitsuzane begin to postulate on the identity of the white Armored Rider who seems to be destroying all evidence of the Inves entering their dimension. To try to figure out what should be done about both the Inves and the white Rider, Kouta decides to consult with the other Armored Riders

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Christmas Game
episodes.overview: As the Lockseed gathering "game" begins, Baron and Bravo fight between themselves, while the white Armored Rider, Kamen Rider Zangetsu, investigates the infiltration into Helheim Forest. Meanwhile, Kouta, who has also entered the forest, decides to track down the white Rider and finds the base of operations that may be the cause for the tears into Helheim Forest opening on their own.

episodes.title: A Next Generation Rider Appears
episodes.overview: Kouta and Mitsuzane attempt to warn the Beat Riders about Yggdrasill's manipulation, only to find that Yggdrasill is deploying Kurokage Troopers to silence anyone who knows the truth as Zangetsu uses a new belt model. Meanwhile, Mai encounters the mysterious girl who resembles her.

episodes.title: Gaim and Baron's Tag Team of Friendship!
episodes.overview: A mysterious bacteria is infecting people in Zawame City. In the crisis situation, Kouta, Mai, and Mitsuzane try to find out the cause behind this.

episodes.title: The Secret of Helheim Forest
episodes.overview: After Hase transforms into an Inves, Gaim tries to take him out before he can do much damage but finds it difficult to harm someone who he believes is still human inside. Meanwhile, Baron does his best to combat Zangetsu Shin but is overcome by Kurokage Troopers and captured. And Mitsuzane, who realizes his brother is their foe the white Armored Rider, infiltrates the Yggdrasill Corporation headquarters on his own to see what is truly going on.

episodes.title: The Man Who Developed the Belts
episodes.overview: With Kouta and Kaito both captured by the Yggdrasill Corporation, they are brought to Ryoma Sengoku who reveals that he created the Sengoku Drivers and Genesis Drivers, and reveals the truth about the Helheim Forest to them. Elsewhere, Mai and Zack try to convince the other teams to hold off the Inves Games due to the damage they cause and how they are missing most of the Team Leaders. While under Yggdrasill's custody, Kouta is approached by DJ Sagara who tells him more of the truth behind the Yggdrasill Corporation, and suggests that he do something about it.

episodes.title: New Arms! The Birth of Jimber Lemon!
episodes.overview: After escaping the clutches of the Yggdrasill Corporation, Kouta wonders why all three of them were able to escape so easily, knowing how Ryoma Sengoku was interested in them. Later, Mai and Chucky continue to try to convince other teams to end the Inves Game, but they instead witness an Elementary Inves robbing a jewelry store. Meanwhile, Takatora has shown Mitsuzane a horrible scene hidden within the Helheim Forest and revealed that he easily beat Kouta.

episodes.title: Peach Rider, Malika's Angelic Entrance!
episodes.overview: After Takatora reveals the truth about Helheim Forest to Mitsuzane, he tasks his brother with recovering Kouta's Sengoku Driver. Elsewhere, Oren and Jonouchi plan to perform the same act with their own plan in mind. Kouta later receives a phone call that tells him his sister has been kidnapped.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Beat Riders
episodes.overview: Mai tries to host a dance contest to bring everyone's morale up, but none of the teams will participate. Mai tries to get Kouta to convince Team Baron to join, but he is not sure that he will dance either. It is only the appearance of Oren who changes the minds of the others, as he turns their friendly dance competition into an outright fight.

episodes.title: Given a Secret Weapon
episodes.overview: Duke fights against Gaim and Baron and manages to come out on top. As they lick their wounds, DJ Sagara appears and gives Kouta a present in the form of a Tulip Hopper Lockseed. When they arrive in the Helheim Forest, they are quickly surrounded by Yggdrasill, pressuring the two Beat Riders to fight to stay alive.

episodes.title: The First Invasion of the End of the World
episodes.overview: Takatora shows Kouta the truth behind Helheim Forest, at the same time Kaito would learn the same thing from Ryoma, Sid, and Yoko. Meanwhile in Zawame City, more Inves invade and it's up to Mitsuzane and Zack to stop them.

episodes.title: Yggdrasill's Secret
episodes.overview: The Helheim Forest will soon destroy the Earth if no one acts on it. Kouta informs Mitsuzane about this fact and says they must do something, but Mitsuzane is hesitant as he already knows the truth. Meanwhile, Kaito examines a photograph taken from within the Helheim Forest and believes he sees a human figure, then goes into the forest to investigate.

episodes.title: The One-in-Seven Truth
episodes.overview: The Crack at Yggdrasill's lab causes more and more Cracks to appear throughout Zawame. Kouta believes the solution is to close Yggdrasill's Crack before any more Inves can attack. However, Kouta encounters Ryoma and Yoko waiting for him in Helheim Forest, ready to stop him so their plans may continue.

episodes.title: Into Battle! Kachidoki Arms!
episodes.overview: Now aware that he killed Yuya, Kouta loses all will to fight, and will not even seek to destroy the Scalar System. As he struggles with the thought of telling the truth to his friends, Kaito encounters the strange Inves in Helheim Forest, once more.

episodes.title: The New Powerful Enemies, the Overlords
episodes.overview: Baron continues to attempt to defeat the Over Lord Inves to no success, until Marika suggests a new plan. Mitsuzane tries to get Kouta, now that he has the Peach Energy Lockseed, to track down the Over Lord Inves, while also finding out that DJ Sagara has been helping him all this time, leading him to wonder who Sagara really is and what his plans are.

episodes.title: Guridon and Bravo the Ultimate Tag Team
episodes.overview: After watching Kouta, Mitsuzane, and Zack battle Inves, Jonouchi realizes that the dance team days are over, again. Later, Oren arrives to begin Jonouchi's next set of training. Kaito tries to tell Kouta about the Over Lords, while DJ Sagara is confronted by Ryoma, Yoko, and Sid. After Gaim, Bravo and Gridon fought the Inves that appeared Oren and Jonouichi goes home but Jonouichi reveals to Oren that the Inves Game is no more. Later, Oren finds a crack and tries to investigate it but discovers something yet to be revealed.

episodes.title: Baron's Genesis Transformation!
episodes.overview: Mai wants to know why Kouta has been hiding from her, and he reveals the truth to her about Helheim Forest, as well as the Inves and the fate of Yuya, upsetting Mitsuzane, who is still under orders from his brother. Meanwhile, Kaito plans to finish his fight with Demushu.

episodes.title: Time to Know the Truth
episodes.overview: Kouta is knocked unconscious by Ryugen's backhanded attack, and Baron fights Ryugen for acting so cowardly. Meanwhile, Takatora mulls over the idea of having to cull the Earth's population down to only one billion people through the use of the Sengoku Drivers, remembering back to the days of first developing them, unaware that even then Ryoma was conspiring against him. When Kouta regains consciousness, he explores Helheim Forest once more, only to be approached by someone unexpected.

episodes.title: Zangetsu's Betrayal
episodes.overview: Takatora reports to Ryoma, Sid, and Yoko that Kouta will be working for them in hunting down the Over Lords in an attempt to stop Helheim Forest. They agree to the plan, but the next time they all enter Helheim Forest, Ryoma has set up a trap to take Takatora out of the equation.

episodes.title: The Overlord King
episodes.overview: In the forest, Takatora is saved by the Over Lords and introduced to their leader Rosyuo who tells him of their past as the Femshinmu people and the secrets of Helheim. Later, Kouta, Kaito, and Mitsuzane all search the forest for Sid, but Sid has set a trap for Kouta. Then Kouta fights with Zangetsu Shin in Helheim Forest, unaware that it is actually Mitsuzane attacking him using his brother's weapons.

episodes.title: Red and Blue Kikaider
episodes.overview: Kouta and Mai meet a young man who can remember nothing about himself other than his name, Jiro. During a rain storm, Kota tries to pull Jiro out of the rain, but noticed his hand feels like metal instead of skin, bringing up the question if Jiro is a robot. Elsewhere, Ryoma looks over the schematics for an android developed by a colleague. Its model name is Hakaider.

episodes.title: Location of the Forbidden Fruit
episodes.overview: The "Fruit of Knowledge" gives someone the power to remake the world itself and become God. Sid overhears from one of the Over Lords, Redyue, that Rosyuo has been safeguarding the fruit. Sid plans to steal it so he can become God. While this unfolds, the Over Lord Demushu has left Helheim to invade Zawame City and begins to randomly destroy the city.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Power! Kiwami Arms!
episodes.overview: Baron Lemon Energy Arms and Knuckle cannot hold off Demushu forever, and he escapes them. With Sid murdered at the hands of Rosyuo, he instructs Redyue to continue the invasion of Zawame much to Takatora's shock and terror, while Mitsuzane seeks out the Fruit of Wisdom still. Elsewhere, Kouta wakes up, and DJ Sagara presents him with something that will help him out.

episodes.title: Beat Riders Gather!
episodes.overview: The Inves are invading, Kouta's sister takes shelter, and Kouta patrols with the others. Trying to get the Golden Fruit, Ryoma reveals Project Ark to the world, which erupts into chaos. Then, without help from the Japanese government or Yggdrasill, Kouta and the other Riders lend a hand to the people left behind.

episodes.title: The Monarch's Power and the Queen's Revival
episodes.overview:
With the world falling into chaos thanks to Ryoma, Zawame City has become an isolated place infested with Inves. Kouta's sister Akira, along with others in shelters, go outside to call for help. Meanwhile, Redyue broadcasts an announcement over the radio to the whole world stating that Helheim will completely take over the Earth in a year. At the same time, Inves are commanded to hunt the citizens of Zawame City.

Yoko confronts Mitsuzane about his actions as Zangetsu Shin and whether or not he will tell Kouta, while Redyue plans on using human technology to further her own goals as well as bring back Rosyuo's queen. But to do that, Redyue requires a sacrifice.

episodes.title: Micchi's Ark
episodes.overview: Rosyuo begins the invasion of the Earth by opening Cracks around the world. Kouta, Kaito, and Yoko plan an assault on the Yggdrasill tower to stop him, while Kouta also seeks out Akira. However, Mitsuzane has other plans after seeing Mai, again.

episodes.title: Sibling Settlement! Zangetsu VS Zangetsu Shin!
episodes.overview: As Mitsuzane/Zangetsu Shin is about to kill Kouta, Takatora appears and stops him, revealing the two's relationship as brothers to Kouta. Later, the fight of the two brothers begins as Takatora returns as Zangetsu to fight Mitsuzane.

episodes.title: Baron's Soccer Showdown! The Summer Battlefield!
episodes.overview: Kaito meets DJ Sagara, who provokes him and summons a ghost-like Gaim Kiwami Arms. After the battle, he gets caught up in an alternate world where he leads Team Baron in the competition for soccer's All Rider Cup.

episodes.title: The Professor Returns
episodes.overview: Mitsuzane seems to be hallucinating, claiming he can see Takatora even though he knows he defeated him. Elsewhere, Ryoma returns to Zawame City, and Kouta believes he may now be an ally against Mitsuzane and the Over Lords.

episodes.title: The Desperate Plan to Break Into The Tower!
episodes.overview: Kouta and Ryoma work together to break into Yggdrasill Tower to free Mai and Akira.

episodes.title: Overlord's Awakening
episodes.overview: Kouta follows the passage to Yggdrasill Tower and to his surprise discovers an underground dungeon. Redyue informs Kouta that he has become one of the Over Lords, rather than a human, and proceeds to show him his apparent destiny.

episodes.title: Clash! The Overlord King
episodes.overview: Kaito fights with Mitsuzane but the two are disrupted by Ryoma. Meanwhile, Mai talks to Rosyuo and is entrusted with the Forbidden Fruit before entering a fight against Kouta and Kaito.

episodes.title: Mitsuzane's Last Transformation!
episodes.overview: Kouta tries to prove that he has not changed, despite all Kaito has seen in Helheim, and helps the others clear Zawame of Inves. However, Mitsuzane and Ryoma discover that Mai, who has been taken ill, is now the host of the Golden Fruit, and wonders why Rosyuo has placed it in her.

episodes.title: Baron's Ultimate Transformation!
episodes.overview: As Gaim and Ryugen Yomi continue their battle, Kaito realizes that there is only one way for him to surpass Kouta now that he possesses the powers of the Over Lord King.

episodes.title: Two People's Visions of the Future
episodes.overview: As Mai accepts the powers of the Golden Fruit and attempts to change the fate that has befallen her friends, Kaito seeks her out to gain its power, as well.

episodes.title: The Final Battle of the Fated Two!
episodes.overview:
Zack sets a trap for Kaito, but...

Meanwhile, Kouta has gained command over an Inves army whilst battling Kaito.

episodes.title: The Fated Victor
episodes.overview: Betting both their lives and beliefs, the final battle between Kouta and Kaito reaches its conclusion.

episodes.title: Transform! And Towards the Future
episodes.overview: Seven months after Kouta and Mai have left and colonized a new planet, all traces of Helheim Forest have been cleared from Zawame City, but a returning threat appears to change things forever. Mitsuzane realizes that Kouta isn't on Earth anymore and that it's up to them to save Zawame City.

episodes.title: Why Did My Time Stop?
episodes.overview: After mysterious and destructive large-scale incidents happened all over the world, humans who were caught in a "time has stopped-like" sensation appeared frequently. In order to understand this phenomenon, the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department set up a "Special Unit" to work on incidents that happen under special circumstances. Shinnosuke Tomari, a former elite police detective, was re-assigned to the Special Unit, but...

episodes.title: What is a Kamen Rider?
episodes.overview: After transforming into Kamen Rider Drive and discovering the strange occurences throughout the city are caused by the Roidmude, Shinnosuke seeks out more information from his former colleague Hayase while the Roidmude named Heart revives Roidmude 029 after he has been defeated by Drive.

episodes.title: Who Took Her Smile?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke and Kiriko are sent to investigate an art gallery where there have been rumors of women's ghosts being eaten by a monster, but when they arrive they find the owner Asaya refuting the rumors while asking Kiriko to model for him. While suspicious of Asaya, Shinnosuke investigates the gallery, only to be hit by the "Heaviness" and the appearance of a Roidmude targeting Kiriko.

episodes.title: What is the Proud Hunter Thinking?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke must deal with both Chaser and the Paint Roidmude, as Rinna reveals to him the secrets to Asaya's paintings.

episodes.title: What is the Steel Thief Gang After?
episodes.overview: While Shinnosuke and Kiriko investigate Roidmude attacks on transportation vehicles, Brain and Heart instruct Chase to follow a criminal named Crush.

episodes.title: What Does the Warrior Fight For?
episodes.overview: While Shinnosuke is still under the effects of Brain's poison, he must figure out how to stop the Crash Roidmude from obtaining explosives from the Font-R company, when its president prevents the Special Investigations Division from looking into his factory.

episodes.title: When is the Decisive Moment to Take a Photo?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke must figure out why he is being dogged by a reporter and discover who is responsible for demolishing several buildings when he cannot find the source of the Heavy Acceleration.

episodes.title: What is the Secret That Lies Buried in That Heart?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke is still followed by the reporter, who is unwillingly becoming part of a story himself.

episodes.title: How Do I Get a Cool Body?
episodes.overview: When the Roidmudes seem to discover a new form of evolution for themselves, Mr. Belt decides it is the time for Kamen Rider Drive to use the new Shift Car: Shift Technic to further combat the Roidmudes.

episodes.title: What Happened in Belt's Past?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke and Kiriko investigate a series of power outages that they believe to be caused by the Roidmudes, but it only brings up questions of Mr. Belt's past when Heart himself becomes involved.

episodes.title: Who Can Prevent the Dark Christmas Eve?
episodes.overview: When it is discovered that Volt is trying to cause a blackout on Christmas Eve to further the Roidmudes' plans, Shinnosuke and Kiriko race to stop them.

episodes.title: Where Did the White Kamen Rider Come From?
episodes.overview: While investigating a land shark who seems to have been involved in Roidmude activities, Shinnosuke cannot detect any Heavy Acceleration particles but instead comes across a young man who says he has something interesting to show him.

episodes.title: Why Doesn't My Brother Have Brakes?
episodes.overview: Kiriko wonders about her brother's arrival and true intentions when a group of thieves is discovered using a device that creates Heaviness.

episodes.title: Who is the Black Shadow After Her?
episodes.overview: While Chase is haunted by the fact that Kiriko and Mr. Belt's voice appears in his memories, Shinnosuke escorts a popular fashion model who has come to the police station because she fears she is being followed by a supernatural creature.

episodes.title: When Will Those Feelings Be Told?
episodes.overview: Mashin Chaser is revealed to be Kamen Rider Protodrive, but Mr. Belt cannot figure out how to get him to return to his original self. Meanwhile, Shinnosuke tries to figure out why Rira is being targeted and/or protected by Roidmude 096.

episodes.title: Why Was Rinna Sawagami Nervous?
episodes.overview: There has been a series of marriage scam incidents, and a Roidmude seems to be involved. Shinnosuke and Kiriko investigate, while Go goes undercover as a guest at a wedding ceremony.

episodes.title: Who Can Control Dead Heat?
episodes.overview: While Shinnosuke and Go deal with the out-of-control Drive Type Dead Heat, Rinna falls into the clutches of the Voice Roidmude. Disappearing together, Shinnosuke must piece together what happened in Rinna's past.

episodes.title: Why is Lieutenant Otta After Him?
episodes.overview: A case that was supposed to be over has resurfaced again after 5 years. Genpachiro has taken this one personally, and vows to solve the case, even quitting the police force if he doesn't solve it.

episodes.title: What is a Detective Judged By?
episodes.overview: Tachibana reveals that he collaborated with the Judge Roidmude in order to lure out the true Judge, who has risen again. Who is this true "Judge"?

episodes.title: How Long has Kyuu Saijou Been a Roidmude?
episodes.overview: The Unit is shocked to find two Kyu Saijos. Which one of them is real, and which is not?

episodes.title: What Do You Say to These Unusual Victims?
episodes.overview: Simultaneous murders are going on, and Chase keeps popping up in surveillance tapes. While Kiriko and Shinnosuke believe in Chase's innocence, Go does not. But what is really going on?

episodes.title: How Do I Fight With an F1 Body?
episodes.overview: Just as Shinnosuke had deduced, the bodies were of people the Roidmudes had copied in the past. Having avoided being defeated by Mashin Chaser after using a new Shift Car, Shinnosuke tries to see if there was anything left of his once righteous spirit. Also, Type Formula’s restrain on Shinnosuke’s body puts his life at serious risk. Go continues to insist on equating Roidmudes with evil and declares his intention of ending Chase as soon as he can. Meanwhile, the supposedly dead bodies stored at the morgue start crawling into the Special Investigation Unit's office.

episodes.title: Who Can Stop the Mischievous Smile?
episodes.overview: Mysterious bombings continuously happened in Tokyo. As for now, Roidmudes are primarily suspected of the bombings. While Drive and Mach went to an amusement park, Mach was quickly incapacitated by a bomb. Meanwhile, an injured Chase is currently in a hospital with Kiriko as his caretaker.

episodes.title: What Drives Mach Forward?
episodes.overview: Kiriko continues to secretly harbor Chase while an impatient Go tries to rush the Mach Driver's repair.

episodes.title: Why Did This New Battle Begin?
episodes.overview: Mitsuhide Nira of the 1st Division pays a visit that leaves an unpleasant taste in the Special Unit. Meanwhile, a Roidmude targets Hayase, Shinnosuke's former partner. When things get out of hand, Shinnosuke has no choice but to reveal his identity as Drive to the public.

episodes.title: Which Path Will Chaser Choose?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke’s secret identity as Drive is now public knowledge. Chief Honganji, who had known this all along, purposefully leaked this information to the media, calling it a “move ahead against the enemy”. He thinks that now that Roidmude 001 has started to move, making Drive a widely known hero is a more advantageous circumstance. Also, the fact that Roidmude 001 could be involved in Shinnosuke’s father death has arisen. What kind of powers does Roidmude 001 have? Meanwhile, Chase has helped Drive once but he is still confused. What is he fighting for? What is he supposed to protect? In the middle of his thoughts, both Shinnosuke and Heart pay him a visit at the same time…

episodes.title: What is the Reason Go Shijima Fights?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke and the rest of the Special Unit are now more confident thanks to the new Ride Booster support vehicles. Kiriko and Go eventually get into an argument whether to trust Chase or not as a Kamen Rider. Later, Shinnosuke joins a joint investigation from the Central Government Office where Brain (in his human form) tries to frame Shinnosuke, whom is already aware of Brain's involvement in the division. Meanwhile, a girl named Yoriko seeks Go's help as her brother was attacked by a Roidmude.

episodes.title: Why Are They After My Family?
episodes.overview:
Go turned out to be the son of Professor Banno, the inventor of the Roidmudes. This fact was not known by Kiriko, of course. Shinnosuke, now knowing the reason behind Go’s particular animosity against the Roidmudes, is left speechless.

As for the ongoing case of the residential complex victims, it is now theorized that the ultimate target could have been Go all along. Could Go’s refusal to accept Chase come not from him becoming a Kamen Rider but because of his Roidmude condition? Shinnosuke has promised Kiriko that he’ll rescue Go no matter what.

episodes.title: What Really Happened at the Robbery?
episodes.overview: Cases of mass robbery are believed to be by a culprit who was responsible for murdering Eisuke Tomari. Shinnosuke is pumped up to solve the case alone. Meanwhile, Brain appears before Go and offers an alliance.

episodes.title: Who Will Reveal the True Culprit?
episodes.overview:
Due to Mach’s intervention, Shinnosuke could not apprehend the murderer of his father. Has Mach become the enemy? In addition, Shinnosuke is regretful about prioritizing his need for answers over saving lives and lets Chase know.

In contrast, Kiriko, having seen Go's betrayal, is starting to have trouble with solving the case and is getting hasty. The reason: this change in Go is no doubt the work of Roidmude 001 and this case is deeply connected to him as well. Brain is trying to get rid of anyone with any relation to the bank robbery from 12 years ago and Maruya (Negishi's former accomplice) testifies feeling something that could very well be a "thick air" event.

episodes.title: Why Did the Precious Memories Disappear?
episodes.overview: A young man named Toru Fujiki has asked the Special Investigation Unit for help. Toru says that his father, who runs a factory in town, has suddenly disappeared. To make matters worse, all memories of Toru's father have been erased from his family and the factory employees.

episodes.title: What is Waiting at the End of Evolution?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke continues his fight against the Freeze Roidmude, undeterred by the power the first Roidmude possesses. However, Freeze obtains his Over Evolved form, and uses it to kill Drive for good.

episodes.title: Who Took Shinnosuke Tomari's Life?
episodes.overview: Shinnosuke has fallen at the hands of Freeze's Over Evolved State, and the Special Investigation Unit has no choice but to disband. Meanwhile, Chase works to find a way to bring Go back to his senses.

episodes.title: Who Took Eisuke Tomari's Life?
episodes.overview: After being revived, Shinnosuke has gained a new power in the form of Type Tridoron. However, he can’t help but be worried by Freeze’s final words. Meanwhile, a Roidmude has stolen reports from a crime lab. The stolen documents were all cases that involved Shinnosuke’s father, Eisuke Tomari.

episodes.title: Why Did the Siege Happen?
episodes.overview: Mitsuhide Nira, who has been revealed to be the murderer of Eisuke Tomari, takes steps with Brain to hide away the evidence from 12 years ago.
