episodes.overview: The president of ZAIA issues a challenge to Aruto over the acquisition of Hiden Intelligence.

episodes.title: This Is My Magnificence
episodes.overview: Fuwa accuses Yua of fixing Horobi; Aruto learns that ZAIA's representative cheated in the contest.

episodes.title: She is a Realtor Huma Gear
episodes.overview: ZAIA issues their second challenge to Hiden with the task of selling houses; Fuwa tries to find Horobi's other accomplice.

episodes.title: That is 1000% the Best House
episodes.overview: Smile is fixed when a huge offer is put forth in the house selling competition.

episodes.title: Objection! That Trial
episodes.overview: ZAIA and Hiden's third competition will take place in a courtroom, with a Huma Gear defense attorney going up against a prosecutor equipped with ZAIA spec.

episodes.title: But He Didn't Do It
episodes.overview: ZAIA looks like it has the case as good as closed; Gai plans to sabotage the Zero-One powers.

episodes.title: Falling In Love With Your Intelligence
episodes.overview: Chiharu comes to Aruto in search of a Huma Gear that can find her a husband.

episodes.title: It's Our Turn
episodes.overview: When Aruto is hospitalized, Izu rallies the Huma Gear to fix his Zero-One powers.

episodes.title: I Save Huma Gear
episodes.overview: Izu is not feeling well and so she calls a Huma Gear doctor to fix the situation.

episodes.title: The Firefighters of Our Flames

episodes.overview: Keiwa is a wreck over losing Sara while Daichi sends the world into panic over the Jamato.

episodes.title: New World 4: Goddess Complete, Blade of Darkness
episodes.overview: Keiwa has taken Tsumuri and the staff plan to use her to create a new Goddess.

episodes.title: New World 5: The Name is Gyaago!
episodes.overview: Keiwa gets his ideal world of every competitor returning granted, but it comes at a price.

episodes.title: New World 6: Shine On, Neon
episodes.overview: Neon's dad starts treating Neon like his actual daughter; Tsumuri refuses to be the next Goddess.

episodes.title: New World 7: A Wish's Outcome
episodes.overview: Beroba recruits DaPaan to be a Rider again while Ace prepares to face Keiwa.

episodes.title: New World 8: Farewell, Micchii
episodes.overview: Ace remakes the world back to before Keiwa's wish.

episodes.title: New World 9: A Genuine Kamen Rider
episodes.overview: Kekera wipes out all other Kamen Riders to teach Keiwa a lesson.

episodes.title: New World 10: Tsumuri's Requiem
episodes.overview:
"Let the game that leads to the destruction of this world, begin."

No matter what, a dangerous game that threatens peace must be stopped. Ace and the others transform into Kamen Riders to confront their troublesome "enemies"!

And the situation will come to an end in the most unprecedented way ever...

episodes.title: Daybreak 1: Now for the Highlight!
episodes.overview:
Tsumuri points her Magnum Shooter 40X at Ace... and a gunshot rings out! Was Ace shot?!

A world where everyone can be happy, just what is Ace's true wish? For that... we witness the end!

episodes.title: Gotcha! Hopper 1!
episodes.overview:
Houtarou is a high school student in search of his own "Gotcha" (something unique to him). However, he is still in a daze, unable to even decide on a career path. His classmate Rinne looks down on him.

Then, Houtarou meets a grasshopper. "I don't know what it is, but when I'm with you, I feel a stirring in my heart..." Then, Steamliner suddenly appears and takes Houtarou to another space. In the other space, a mysterious man entrusts Houtarou with a Driver, saying it is his hope for the future. Then an enemy attacks!

The target is Houtarou's Driver. Houtarou loads the card into the Driver! He transforms into Kamen Rider Gotchard..!

episodes.title: Chase, Alchemy, Skateboards!
episodes.overview:
After transforming into Kamen Rider Gotchard, Houtarou wants to learn more about the Chemmies and is advised by his teacher Minato to take the entrance exam for the secret Alchemy Academy. However, Houtarou runs into a problem.

Meanwhile, Ryo Kajiki meets a talking skateboard who loves to play with children, but...

episodes.title: Finding Bushido
episodes.overview:
Houtarou continues his quest to befriend all the Chemies as he meets a Chemy known as Apparebushido, and is given his card by Minato.

A new Malgam appears and Houtarou attempts to fight it using Apparebushido, but it defies orders and causes Houtarou to be defeated.

"Just how can I get Apparebushido to open up to me?" Houtarou asks himself as he begins to secretly train. Just then, he is approached by alchemist named Spanner Kurogane, who demands the Gotchardriver!

episodes.title: Antrooper Labyrinth
episodes.overview:
Houtarou can't help but exclaim in admiration at Valvarad's powerful might. However, Spanner says that he didn't acknowledge Houtarou as a Kamen Rider and leaves.

Houtarou and Rinne, who continue their search for Chemies, come face to face with the Three Dark Sisters, Atropos, Clotho and Lachesis. Lachesis then absorbs a Chemy and transforms into Malgam. Houtarou transforms into Gotchard, but immediately after that, they are sent to a huge, different space!

episodes.title: Burn! Fight! Wrestler G!
episodes.overview:
Seeking the teachings of Renge and Sabimaru who has sealed away a lot of Chemies, Houtarou and Rinne go to a certain professional wrestling Dojo with Renge and the others.

When Houtarou immediately tries to find a Chemie, he's attacked by gang-like men who are after the Dojo's land. However, Alchemy can't be used against ordinary people. In front of a confused Rinne and the others, Houtarou borrowed Renge cards and transformed into Gotchard! However this time, a powerful Malgam suddenly appears!

episodes.title: Super A Class☆The Twisted Star
episodes.overview:
A mysterious man appears in front of Supana after tracking him. He changes into a Malgam before attacking the former and Houtarou. Supana then transforms into Valvarad and counters, and so does Houtarou into Gotchard, but the Malgam escapes after Valvarad's counterattacks.

However, the man, who is set on overthrowing Supana, kidnaps Rinne in front of Houtarou in order to lure his nemesis out.

Who on earth is this man? And why is he so obsessed with Supana!?

episodes.title: Farewell SaboNeedle
episodes.overview:
A boy appears in front of Houtarou and others, asking to take over Saboneedle. Since Ordinary people and Chemies cannot coexist, Rinne, who values the rules, tries to accept the boy's request, but Houtarou is not convinced.

Doesn't he really want to be with Saboneedle? Houtarou tries his best to find out the boy's true feelings, but then a new Malgam appears. What is the true identity of Malgam who is targeting the boy for some reason!?

episodes.title: Great Bonds
episodes.overview:
Saboneedle flew out of the driver during the battle with Dragonfly Malgam. Houtarou senses something as Riku becomes more distraught than ever, asking, "Where has Sabosuke gone?"

Meanwhile, Atropos suddenly appears in front of Rinne...!

episodes.title: Dash to Kyoto! School Trip!
episodes.overview:
Houtarou and his group from Furasu High School go on a school trip to Kyoto. Houtarou is assigned to a group study with Rinne and Kajiki, and by chance Kajiki meets a girl named Hijiri, and they hit it off. They immediately become attracted to each other.

At the same time, one of the Three Dark Sisters, Clotho, was also sighted in Kyoto in order to obtain something. But Clotho happens to see Houtarou and the others, and in her anger, she creates a new Malgam...!

episodes.title: Blazing Kyoto! Scorched Love: The Chemy Thunderous Affair
episodes.overview:
Hijiri, whom Kajiki is in love with, has a boyfriend! Although Kajiki is depressed, he learnt that Hijiri boyfriend is most likely the remaining suspect who made his escape after Clotho attacked the police van!

If that's the case, then there's a possibility that the suspect has already became a Malgam. Hijiri who is with Kajiki is in danger! Houtarou and Minato start searching for the suspect together, but...!

episodes.title: Catch! It's a Spy?! Can't Be a Rider!
episodes.overview:
Clotho captures a Level 10 Chemy for the Three Dark Sisters and subjects it to their creepy experiments, bringing them closer to completion of "something".

Meanwhile, Kugimiya and Harima from the Alchemys Union arrive at the academy and warn the students that there may be a mole within their ranks. However before he begins investigating on who the possible mole is, he heavily criticizes Houtarou's fighting style as a Kamen Rider.

episodes.title: Out of Control Liner! Dark Rider!
episodes.overview:
The spy for the Three Dark Sisters turned out to be Shiori Harima, an investigator from the Alchemy Union. Houtarou lashes out in anger at Shiori, who attacks the Chemy, but is tormented by her use of forbidden alchemy.

Then the Three Dark Sisters appear. When Atropos and her sisters get their hands on a mysterious driver, they say "now it's your turn" to the mysterious warrior known as Kamen Rider Dread, and begin a new terrifying experiment.

Just who is this dark destroyer, Dread?

episodes.title: Return to Normal! Friends x Forever!
episodes.overview:
"Sabimaru-Senpai is gone."

Houtarou laments his immaturity and weaknesses in the face of fleeting, yet endless suffering. How can he help Sabimaru? Just then, Houtarou is invited by Kajiki to call out a UFO whose sighting has recently become more frequent.

Houtarou and his friends find a possibility to rescue Sabimaru by befriending UFO-X. However, the Three Dark Sisters and Sabimaru with the Dreadriver appear before them! Equip yourself with the Number 10 Chemy and Change to Super Gotchard now, Houtarou Ichinose!

episodes.title: Open Wide Rex! Dangerous X!
episodes.overview:
"There's something I'd like to ask of you, Ichinose."

Houtaro is asked by Rinne, who has a thoughtful look on her face, to confide in him about a certain problem of hers. Just what exactly is on her mind?

Then the two are dispatched to the appearance of a new Level 10, X-Rex. Houtaro and Rinne attempt to tame it but encounter a little girl instead...

episodes.title: Seize Happiness! Shine Gotchalibur!
episodes.overview:
The raw power of Super Gotchard overwhelms Dread and gains an upper-hand, but Dread is capable of executing counterattacks, resulting in a back-and-forth battle.

Meanwhile, Lachesis approaches the daughter-father duo Sawa and Manabe. Rinne attempts to protect them but Atropos intervenes with her magical abilities.

"So you are powerless after all."

Rinne is robbed of her bodily freedom by the triumphant Atropos...?!

episodes.title: Crisis Xmas! Serpent Incident
episodes.overview:
Supana returns to his master Kyoka Edami to have her repair his Valvarusher, which was heavily damaged during his battles with the Three Dark Sisters. As he arrives in her laboratory, he becomes intrigued by the blueprints of a new weapon she is developing.

A giant snake suddenly appears from the sky and attacks people with its petrification rays. Houtaro transforms into Gotchard and confronts the snake, who speaks in an eerie voice.

"Are you Kamen Rider...?"

What is the true identity of the giant snake?

episodes.title: Moonbreak Messenger
episodes.overview:
While Houtarou is serving New Years Food to Rinne and the others, he's wondering who is the Orange Gotchard that appeared during Christmas, and the sudden strengthening of the Malgam...

Suddenly, a Malgam appeared before Houtarou! Houtarou transformed into Gotchard, but he struggled against the empowered Malgam. As the Orange Gotchard appeared, he tells the shaken young man "As you are right now, you'll never defeat that Malgam."

A suprising development awaits Houtarou and co. as a person starts to move after Geryon's revival...

episodes.title: Sweep Through! The Evolutionary Firelord!
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and Rinne are disappointed in a world where not only the Alchemy Academy, but also their teacher Minato does not exist. The Moon Malgam then appears in front of the two and mocks Rinne where it takes her into the shadows.

"What should I do to become stronger and defeat the Moon Malgam?", asks a worried Houtaro.

Gotchard Daybreak then replies. "I will transport you to the past."

Just what is in Houtaro's past? What should he do there?

episodes.title: The Dawn of Rinne! Transform, Majade!
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and his friends are in high spirits once they formed the Kitchen Ichinose Alliance. However, Rinne is still dispirited as she wonder if this is the 'rules' she had to follow as an alchemist.

While Rinne is elated to know that Fuga is in fact not a traitor at all, Minato suddenly comes to her and invited her back into the academy! While this might be the right thing to do as an alchemist, Rinne is shaken by her former teacher's invitation. Meanwhile, Atropos arrives with a new Malgam and ordered the Malgam to exclusively attack Rinne. With Gotchard struggling, Rinne is cornered!

episodes.title: Smiling Angel, Unfunny Joke
episodes.overview:
Kyoka arrives to see Houtaro and the others. Kyoka, who claims to be Supana's teacher, begins to talk about Supana's past, which even Houtarou and the others did not know. "It all started 10 years ago..."

At that time, Supana's parents appear before him, worried that he will never be as strong as Houtaro and Rinne. Supana is happy to see his parents again after a long time, but...!?

episodes.title: Mad Warrior! The Black Flame, Valvarad!
episodes.overview:
Houtaro drives the runaway Wheel Malgam into de-transformation with the power of Fire Gotchard. However, Supana stubbornly shuts his mind, saying to Houtaro and the others, "This is my battle," and remains engulfed in black flames.

Houtaro and the others support Kyoka in making a new driver for Supana. They continue working on it through the night, but now Geryon's evil hand is closing in on Kyoka..!

episodes.title: Love Is a Saber! A Sudden Chemy Story
episodes.overview:
Renge has fallen under the spell of Zukyumpire. Zukyumpire attracts many men and women, but when Houtaro and his friends investigate, they discover that Renge and the others are in danger...!?

Meanwhile, Geryon, who has failed to dye Supana with malice, begins a new course of action using Clotho!

episodes.title: Always Hit Right in the Heart
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and Rinne try to stop Zukyumpire, who steals energy from people. Then, Renge and others bring one of the Zukyumpire worshippers, Yui, to the scene.

Houtaro and the others, after hearing from Yui about the circumstances surrounding Zukyumpire, desperately try to persuade him. When Zukyumpire learns that he has been tormenting people, he is devastated, and at the same time, something strange happens around him. At the same time, strange happenings occur around them, and Clotho shows up to take advantage of them..!

episodes.title: A Sudden Twist! The Forbidden Steel Rider!
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and the others are overjoyed to receive a letter from Minato saying that he will take down Geryon. They immediately rush to the location Minato has designated, but suddenly a new Malgam appears. Houtaro is deprived of all his cards except for Steamliner.

He is unable to transform into Gotchard. Houtaro still wants his cards back, so he consults with Kyoka and learns that there is only one way to transform, though it is a forbidden technique...

episodes.title: The Faults of a Young Sensei
episodes.overview:
Houtaro transforms into Iron Gotchard, but his physical strength is depleted and the transformation is canceled. He is saved by Fuga, the father of Rinne, who suddenly appears and escapes from the battle with Dread Type One.

Fuga explains about "an incident" that occurred 10 years ago, which is the reason why Minato abandoned Houtaro and the others to follow Geryon. Houtaro and the others, who understand Minato's true intentions, confront him once again...!

episodes.title: Thwarting Evil. The Jet Black Winds
episodes.overview:
Geryon has unleashed the deadliest Malgam to open the door to darkness. Rinne and Supana transform into Riders to face him, but they are cornered by his powerful force.

Houtaro transforms into Iron Gotchard to save them. They go head-to-head, but gradually his strength is depleted and he is unable to transform. Just when all seemed to be lost, Fuga appears.

"I will light the way for these youth." And then Fuga...!

episodes.title: Gotcha! X Hopper!
episodes.overview:
Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana transform into Riders in front of Geryon, who tries to open the dark door! Geryon also transforms into Dread and tries to steal the Gotchardriver.

However, Iron Gotchard soon reaches the limit of his strength and is attacked by Dread, causing him to untransform. Geryon gets the Gotchardriver and finally opens the door to darkness...!?

episodes.title: It's Licking Bizarre! Renge Visits Home!
episodes.overview:
Renge, who was visiting her grandmother's village, informs Houtaro and the others that a yokai has appeared and she wants them to come immediately. In that village, a man named Starshine Hoshino, who calls himself a specialist in exterminating yokai, appears, and his apprentice is Kajiki!?

Houtaro and Rinne arrive in the village and immediately discover the yokai! Houtaro transforms into Gotchard...!

episodes.title: This Town Is Weeping
episodes.overview:
The village chief is found in a grisly state, and the villagers assume it is the work of Starshine Hoshino and make a big fuss. They lock Hoshino and his apprentice Kajiki in a warehouse.

Kajiki would never attack anyone. As Houtaro and the others begin their search for the real culprit, a new Malgam appears. Houtarou transforms into Gotchard, but he feels something strange about the Malgam's behavior. What is this discomfort? And what is the truth behind the incident...!?

episodes.title: A Rival Appears?! Gotcha and Juliet
episodes.overview:
In order to save the drama club, Houtaro and his friends decide to help put on a performance of "Romeo and Juliet". Mikuriya, the head of the club, selects Houtaro to play Romeo, while Seina, a transfer student and childhood friend of Houtaro, runs for the role of Juliet, while Rinne is put off by the fact that she is not a member of the club.

Rinne is bothered by Houtaro and Seina's sudden closeness. Atropos appears, sees through Rinne's emotional turmoil, and unleashes a Malgam. Rinne desperately defends Seina who is nearby...!

episodes.title: The Darkness Pair, Believe in Each Other
episodes.overview:
"Kudo! Fight like you are!"

With the advice of Minato, Houtaro and Rinne manage to escape their predicament, but Rinne's feelings and the future of the "Romeo and Juliet" production become uncertain.

Furthermore, Atropos appears with a new Malgam. Houtaro and Rinne transform into Riders, but Majade strikes them with a powerful blow...!

episodes.title: A Great King Is Here! A Puppet's Dilemma
episodes.overview:
Houtaro, who defeated the Malgam and got a new Chemy, was attacked by an angry Clotho!

With Geryon gone, what is the point of fighting? Houtaro fights back and pleads desperately, but Clotho refuses to listen to him. Then, suddenly something unusual happens and a new enemy appears to attack Houtaro and the others...!?

episodes.title: Legend Rider? 100 Years Too Early!
episodes.overview:
Saigetsu, Mimei, and Tasogare of a mysterious organization appear before Houtaro and the others. The three, who say they are looking for a super weapon in this world, call in the Kasshine army to attack the people.

We will stop them! In front of Houtaro and the others, who are furious, Saigetsu and the others transform into Kamen Riders such as Dark Kiva! Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana also transform into Riders and stand up to them...!

episodes.title: Only One! All Roads Lead to Gorgeous
episodes.overview:
Kaguya, who is reunited with Houtaro, comes to Furasu High School and charms the students with his "gorgeousness." Houtaro is taken aback by the notoriety that even a fan club has been formed.

Houtaro and Kaguya are again faced with the appearance of the Hundred's Kasshine army. Houtaro and the others transform into Riders and defeat them, but Kaguya utters ominous words about the leaders still being nearby...?!

episodes.title: Gorgeous Time! Legendary Is Never Ending
episodes.overview:
Kaguya transforms into Legend and attacks Houtaro. Houtaro also transforms into Gotchard and fights back, but Kaguya shuts him down and says, "Gorgeous time is over," and leaves him alone.

They are supposed to have made up, but why? Houtaro and the others are puzzled by Kaguya's sudden change, but then a giant clock appears in the sky above them. What does the ticking of the clock mean? Moreover, the Dark King Gigist begins to act in secret...!?

episodes.title: Origin of the Chemy! I Understand
episodes.overview:
The Dark King Gigist appeared at the Union headquarters. Supana, angered by Gigist's defeat of one of the Union leaders, transforms into Kamen Rider Valvarad. He boldly attacks Gigist, but...

Gigist appeared in front of Houtaro, took away Skebows' card, and turned it into a Malgam. Houtaro transforms into Gotchard and challenges the Malgam to save Skebows, but he feels something strange in the battle...!?

episodes.title: Hopper-1 and Treasure
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and others show Kyoka the completely white Skebows. They want to somehow regenerate Skebows! Houtaro and the others look at it as if praying, and Kyoka...!?

Hopper1 sets off alone on a journey to find "something" to cheer up Houtaro. Meanwhile, Gigist has taken Antrooper from Houtaro and turned it into a Malgam. The Malgam attacks people, and Houtaro and the others...!?

episodes.title: On the Other Side of the Rainbow
episodes.overview:
Houtaro, who was spirited away from Rinne and the others by a giant egg, finds himself in a black space with a floating blue egg. "What is this place? Who are you?" Houtaro asks the egg.

Gigist stands before Supana, who was on his way to rescue Houtaro. Supana transforms into Kamen Rider Valvarad, only for Gigist to unleash the mighty Malgam, which he had created by rallying his Chemies, on Kamen Rider Valvarad!

episodes.title: Gotcha Complete! Climax 101!
episodes.overview:
Renge proposes a competition to retrieve the two remaining Chemies, with Nijigon at stake. Despite a stunned Houtaro, Rinne, Sabimaru, and even Nijigon get involved...!

Gigist appears before Houtaro. Gigist tries to dye the Chemies in darkness, but Houtaro uses the power of Nijigon to prevent him from doing so. He transforms into Rainbow Gotchard and clashes with Gigist!

episodes.title: A Wicked Arrival! The Triply Great Dark King
episodes.overview:
It was the Underworld King Germain and Gaelya who descended to earth from the Ouroboros world. Their target is Fuga, the father of Rinne, the most powerful alchemist. The Three Dark Kings, including Gigist, are closing in on Fuga.

Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana rush to the scene and transform into Riders! They confront the Dark Kings to protect Fuga, but they are cornered by the unprecedentedly vicious power used by Germain and the others...!

episodes.title: Trace of God, Grace of Rainbow!
episodes.overview:
While Houtaro and the others continue their search, Nijigon is wandering the streets, refusing to return until he finds something he can do to help. Nijigon meets a woman practicing dance.

Germain appears before Houtarou and the others again. Together with Rinne and Supana, they transform into Riders and face Germain with a strong determination to defeat him!

episodes.title: Let's Search! 102 Bodies and a Brother's Feelings
episodes.overview:
Houtaro and his team receive information that the 102nd Chemy has unexpectedly appeared. Houtaro, Supana, and Sabimaru begin a search based on this information, and arrive at a certain research institute where Sabi's brother, Ken'ichi, works.

A new Malgam appears at the institute. Is the 102nd Chemy real after all? And behind it all is the resurrected Geryon!? Houtarou and Supana transform into Riders...!

episodes.title: Love, Sorrow, or AI? The Power to Erase Hate
episodes.overview:
Mami, the director of Kongo Laboratory, begs Houtaro and the others to protect the laboratory from Geryon. Protect it from Geryon? What is the relationship between Mami and Geryon...?

Houtaro, suspicious of the Chemy's behavior, asks Sabimaru if it was really Kenichi who created the Chemy. For a moment, Sabimaru is perplexed, but then he reveals the truth behind the Tsuruhara brothers and Chemies. What is that unexpected truth!?

episodes.title: When Deep Memories Are Unsealed
episodes.overview:
Kajiki is depressed after being cold-shouldered by Hijiri, but is beginning to remember the memories that have been erased by Minato. Houtaro suggests to Minato that he revive all of Kajiki's memories for Kajiki and Hijiri's sake, but...

Meanwhile, the Dark King Gaelijah had begun a new course of action using Clotho. And that Malgam is in front of Houtaro and Rinne!?

episodes.title: Meeting of Fate, Crossroads of Love and Hate!
episodes.overview:
When Hijiri is brought to Gaelijah, she is shocked to discover that she has been transformed into a Malgam herself. Gaelijah tries to release her despair and transform her back into a Malgam.

Houtaro and Kajiki arrive on the scene. Houtaro transformed into Gotchard and entrusted Kajiki with rescuing Hijiri, but for some reason Hijiri shuns Kajiki, saying, "Don't come!" And Kajiki shuns her...!?

episodes.title: Black Astrology, Kurogane Oath
episodes.overview:
People's memories come back and information spreads that Chemies are terrifying entities that turn humans into monsters. The town is in a state of panic, filled with people who fear Chemies and Malgams, and those who want to obtain Chemies and use them for evil purposes.

Then, Golem Gouriki appears before Houtaro and transforms into the Gorilla Malgam. The alchemists are accused of being the masterminds behind the series of disturbances. If nothing is done, the world will be in chaos... Supana makes a decision and takes action!

episodes.title: A Great Clash! Houtaro VS Spana
episodes.overview:
Supana summons Houtaro and the others, erases the Chemy Cards so that they cannot be re-sealed again, and takes all the Chemy Cards from Houtaro and the others. However, Kyoka and Lachesis appear and reveal Supana's true intentions in front of Houtaro and the others.

When Houtaro learns the horrifying truth about Supana, he approaches Supana with fury. "Why are you always like this?" Houtaro and Supana finally clash!

episodes.title: Farewell to Twilight
episodes.overview:
Rinne, who is suffering, disappears from the presence of Houtaro and the others, and is kidnapped by Gaelijah along with Atropos.

Rinne's life will be in danger if nothing is done. Fuga and Glion, who has called for help, head for the rescue of Rinne and the others, only to find Gaelijah's evil trap awaiting them...!

And what about Houtaro, who arrives late to the scene!?

episodes.title: Metal Warrior! Silver Valvarad
episodes.overview:
Gotchard defeats the Malgam, who threatens the people, but the people of the city still fiercely condemn Chemies and the alchemists. A world where people and Chemies can live together.... Houtaro has no end to his worries.

Supana has lost his driver, and Gigist calls on him to fight with him. Supana refuses, and fights as Valvarad, but is engulfed by the black flames that Gigist unleashes. Supana foresees his own demise... but then!?

episodes.title: The CHEMY×STORY of You and I
episodes.overview:
Glion, transformed into Kamen Rider Eld by the power of the Philosopher's Stone, summons an army of Dreatroopers. The city and its people are transformed into gold, and El Dorado is steadily approaching completion.

Houtaro tells his mother, Tamami, that as a Kamen Rider he will create a future where humans and Chemies can live together, and that he doesn't want to run away from his Gotcha! He then joins Rinne, Supana, and the other Chemies in a final battle to defeat Glion!

episodes.title: The Snack Kamen Rider?!
episodes.overview:
Shoma, who comes from a different world, is saved by a boy named Hajime when he collapses from hunger. Shoma excitedly eats the snacks that Hajime gave him, but as soon as he does, Gochizo are born one after another.

Meanwhile, freelance writer Hanto is gathering information on the appearance of "monsters" while doing research.

Hajime hides Shoma in his secret base and hurries home when a mysterious man appears before him. The man transforms into the monster Granute and approaches Hajime.

episodes.title: Happiness Crunchy Chips
episodes.overview:
Shoma, who has collapsed from hunger again, is helped by Sachika, who runs an anything and everything general store, and treats him to lunch and snacks.

Hanto, while working on a case story, discovers information about Gavv on a social networking service. He starts interviewing witnesses.

Shoma is asked by Sachika's friend Ritsu to assist her in her "anything goes" job.

That night, Shoma is led out by a Gochizo, who suddenly appears, and runs into a man dressed in a jogging outfit. The man transforms into a Granute, and Shoma transforms into Gavv, and they clash!

episodes.title: The Taste of Soda Punch is a Crime
episodes.overview:
By chance, Shoma meets a tough-looking man named Sujimoto and decides to help him with his work as he is asked.

Then Sujimoto is attacked by a Granute. Shoma receives a call from the Gochizo and rushes to the scene, where he transforms into Gavv and challenges the Granute to a fight.

The Kamen Rider appears! Hanto receives the news from Sachika and witnesses Gavv's battle...!?

episodes.title: Marshmallow Seconds!
episodes.overview:
Shoma mistakes the vegetables in the field for wildflowers and is caught by the owners of the field, Ryoji and his wife Mutsuko. After the misunderstanding is cleared up, Shoma is welcomed kindly by the couple.

Hanto visits Granute researcher Suga and begins researching the Granutes. When Hanto is told about the true nature of Granutes, who kidnap humans to spice up sweets, he...!?

An agent appears in front of Shoma, who is spending time with an elderly couple. Shoma escapes and confronts the agent, but then an unexpected person appears...!

episodes.title: Memories Sting
episodes.overview:
Shoma collapsed from hunger and was saved by a mysterious monster. Is it a new Granute? Shoma wakes up and transforms into Gavv, but his movement was halted by an unexpected reaction: "The surgery was a success!" Who is this monster?

After receiving a report from the Gochizo, Shoma once again confronts the Agents. He transforms into Gavv and clashes with the two Agents. Hanto, who was watching the scene, is rescued and desperately pleads with those who fear Gavv's appearance, "He's not a monster!" He desperately appeals to the people who are afraid of Gavv's appearance, but...

episodes.title: The Transformation is a Dark Chocolate
episodes.overview:
Shoma starts a new life at Sachika's "Happipare". Meanwhile, Suga has succeeded in developing an item that can transform a person into a Kamen Rider, and asks Hanto to try it out.

A new Granute appears. Shoma transforms into Gavv and fights to his advantage, but the Granute counterattacks and escapes. Hanto stood in front of the Granute and transforms into Kamen Rider Valen with an item developed by Suga...!

episodes.title: What Does It Taste Like Under the Mask?
episodes.overview:
Gavv confronts Valen, the new Kamen Rider who defeated the Granute. Unaware of each other's true identities, the two begin to probe each other.

Later, Sachika and Shoma are asked to do housework at a relative's mansion, where they meet a young artist who lives there.

Meanwhile, Hanto visits a gallery to investigate an unsolved disappearance...

episodes.title: Dual Chocolate
episodes.overview:
When Shoma asks Sachika why she is covered in paint, Sachika simply says that she made a mistake. Sachika, who does everything so dexterously, only replies that it was her own mistake. Shoma senses that there is a deeper reason, and bites his lip because he is helpless to help Sachika.

A new art dealer comes to Masako's mansion to see the studio of Suetsugu, an aspiring painter. Suetsugu also gets a scout! Hanto is suspicious that the art dealer might be a Granute. He has to be sure.... Then Shoma comes up with a plan...!

episodes.title: Trick or Dance!
episodes.overview:
Shoma gets candy from children dressed in Halloween costumes. He is thrilled to taste the first candy that does not melt immediately, and new Gochizo are born one after another.

Meanwhile, Hanto approaches Kirari and her friends, who gossip about monsters. He goes to Kirari's dance school to look for clues. Then he sees a suspicious man following Kirari's friend Rika...!

episodes.title: An Extra Large Serving! Candy Artillery!
episodes.overview:
Hanto comes to "Hapipare" to ask for help in finding a missing cake store. Shoma hears about it and secretly sends the Gochizo to search for it.

The Gochizo's report reveals that the owner of the suspicious cake store is at the kindergarten. Shoma and Hanto sneak into the kindergarten and find that the owner is actually a Granute! Hanto escapes Shoma, transforms into Valen, and angrily attacks the Granute.

Gavv joins him, and the two join forces to confront the Granute...!

episodes.title: Beware of Sweet Talk!
episodes.overview:
Hanto has become a "suspect" in a romance scam. Called by Shoma and Sachika, Hanto goes to the coffee shop where he is supposed to meet a woman in order to catch the real culprit.

Shoma, in pursuit of the Granute, tries to transform into Gavv, but then Lango appears. Shoma is alarmed by their unexpected reunion, but what are Lango's intentions...!?

Meanwhile, Hanto also discovers the Granute. He transforms into Valen and fights, but he has a hard time and is finally hit by a powerful blow...!?

episodes.title: A Bond Preserved by Donuts
episodes.overview:
Hanto, who was rescued by Gavv, presses Gavv to reveal his true identity, saying it's not fair. Gavv is perplexed, but he has no choice but to release his transformation...!

Sachika discovers a man on social media who she believes may have deceived Emi.

Shoma goes to meet the man with the information and runs into a Granute. "I'm going to beat you today!" Shoma says as he transforms together with Hanto!

episodes.title: A Homemade Cake of Promises
episodes.overview:
Shoma is excited to see Sachika's prototype Buche de Noel before Christmas. He also challenges himself to bake a cake for Sachika.

After finishing the cake, Shoma receives a call about the appearance of a Granute. Shoma rushes to the scene and transforms into Gavv, but is lured away by Shita and Jeebh. Shita and Jeebh, enraged, attack Gavv...!

episodes.title: A Miraculous Awakening! Caking
episodes.overview:
Shoma manages to escape from the onslaught of Siita and Jiip, but is saved by Hanto and escapes the crisis, though covered in wounds.

However, Siita and Jiip, still furious, launch a subversive campaign and succeed in summoning Shoma.

"We'll settle this here!"

Shoma transforms into Gavv and clashes again with Siita and Jiip, who are now in monster form!

episodes.title: Granute Escape!
episodes.overview:
Shoma is approached by Kani, the street musician Granute, begging that he wants to leave Stomach Inc. Shoma is gradually moved by Kani's remorse over the fact that he was wrong to attack people for the sake of the black market Dark Snacks...

However, Hanto dismisses Shoma, saying, "There's no point in talking to him." He is adamant that he will eradicate all Granute.

Kani, the "traitor," is attacked by the agents. Shoma transforms into Gavv to protect Kani...!

episodes.title: Christmas Present
episodes.overview:
Encouraged by Sachika to "apologize if you feel bad," Shoma heads off to rescue Hanto.

Meanwhile, the Man in the Hat is smoothly collecting Human Presses as Lage 9. He is recognized by Lango and others, and obtains some dark snacks...

Shoma approaches Hanto, who has been taken prisoner and made to look like he has been defeated by Rojoe, but for some reason Hanto expresses his dissatisfaction, saying, "That's unnecessary..."

Rojoe appears before them. Shoma and Hanto transform into Riders! Valen uses the Bushel Gochizo he received from Gavv once again to change into a new form!

episodes.title: Wrapped in Caramel Tentacles is a Happy Flavor
episodes.overview:
Shoma, searching for a missing high school student, discovers that other "kind and gentle" people have been disappearing one after another. Are such people the only ones being targeted by the Granute? If so, Sachika is in danger! Shoma rushes to Sachika's side, but...

Shoma and Hanto finally find the Granute and transform into Riders. Then a man in a hat appears. In front of Gavv and Valen, the man changes into Lage Nine and puts on a belt...!?

episodes.title: Super Strong! Pudding Bodyguard
episodes.overview:
Shoma and Hanto are troubled by the appearance of Kamen Rider Vram. While discussing countermeasures, Shoma is pressed by Hanto, who says, "There's something you're not telling me..."!

Shoma and Hanto confront Granute Chooul, but then Lage Nine appears. Shoma and Hanto transform into Gavv and Valen to save those who were turned into human presses! They challenge Vram and Chooul to a battle.

However, Chooul escapes with the human press in his hands. Valen has Gavv track down Chooul and challenges Vram by himself!

episodes.title: A Subtle Bittersweet Taste of Pudding
episodes.overview:
Shoma escapes the attack of Kamen Rider Vram and succeeds in rescuing Hanto, who has been knocked down, and begins a search for Takeshi, who has been turned into a Human Press and has not returned.

Shoma finds Lage Nine and transforms into Gavv to take back the Human Press. Lage Nine also transforms into Vram and uses his overwhelming power to drive Gavv back. But in the midst of the battle, Gavv wonders if Vram's goal is actually not Dark Snacks but Stomach Inc....!?

episodes.title: Break Into the Dark Treats Factory!
episodes.overview:
Shoma is reunited with Lage Nine, who harbors a grudge against the Stomach family for taking his brother's life. Shoma again tries to persuade Lage Nine to fight with him, and Lage Nine relents and sneaks into the Stomach factory to retrieve the Human Press.

Shoma and Lage Nine succeed in recovering Takeshi's Human Press, but an angry Glotta appears. Shoma and Lage Nine transform into Riders and confront Glotta in her Granute form!

Gavv and Vram struggle against Glotta's terrifying power. Hanto rushes in and is stunned by the unexpected development before him.

"Why is Shoma helping Vram?"

episodes.title: Way Too Bitter Gavv
episodes.overview:
When Hanto learns that Shoma is a member of the Stomach family, he is furious. However, he recalls Shoma's past actions and decides to listen to what Shoma has to say.

Shoma attacks a coffee shop. As expected, Shoma is still...! Hanto tells Sachika about the incident and warns her that Shoma is a Granute.

Hanto finally discovers Shoma attacking a candy store! Shoma transforms in front of Hanto, who is furious...!?

episodes.title: The Truth is Bittersweet
episodes.overview:
Shoma, who is attacking people, is a "Granute to be defeated" and Hanto challenges him to a fight, but he is somewhat unable to come to terms with the situation. Likewise, Sachika, who was told the truth about Shoma by Hanto, is trying to come up with her own answer.

Meanwhile, Shoma learns that a man who looks like him in black is causing a commotion, and he secretly begins to investigate. But then Hanto appears! Hanto is again in battle mode, but with anger on his face....

episodes.title: Broken Sweets
episodes.overview:
Shoma joins forces with the reconciled Hanto to defeat Bitter Gavv. Shoma tells Hanto about the terrible memories that came back to him right after the battle...

Hanto reports to Suga that he has defeated Bitter Gavv, and receives a new Gochizo from Suga. Will it boost Valen's power or...?

Dark Shoma appears before Shoma and Rakia. Why in the world did he appear when he was already defeated? Shoma and Rakia transform into Riders and confront Bitter Gavv, who says, "You can't beat me, you can't catch me!"

episodes.title: A Spoonful of Comeback Ice Cream
episodes.overview:
Hanto begins to search for a Granute based on information from Kataro, but the Granute captures him.

While Hanto is looking for an opportunity to turn the tables, a Gochizo from Suga starts to move...

Bitter Gavv has started rampaging through the city again. Shoma transforms into Gavv to fight, but is overwhelmed by Bitter Gavv and untransforms. Sachika, unable to bear the sight of Shoma, offers him ice cream in an attempt to restore his strength. Shoma ejects a Gochizo from the ice cream and transforms into a new Gavv!

episodes.title: False Happiness and the Taste of Honey
episodes.overview:
Rakia starts working part-time at Hapipare on the recommendation of Shoma and Sachika. He is assigned to accompany a young boy who is going to meet a popular virtual streamer for the first time by introducing him to sweets.

Meanwhile, Hanto is satisfied with the new power given to him by Chocold, a Gochizo developed by Suga, but he suddenly begins to suffer from physical changes.

Suspicion surfaced that the virtual streamer's true identity was a Granute. However, the boy shrugged off Rakia's advice and went to the streamer. Having no choice but to follow him, Rakia discovers the Granute, who tries to attack the boy.

He lets the boy escape and challenges the Granute to a fight, but...!?

episodes.title: Angry Pudding
episodes.overview:
Koji, who wants to take back Kabutodanshi, asks Rakia to accompany him again, but he refuses, saying that humans are no match for him. Koji gets angry and runs off on his own.

Hanto consults with Suga about his physical condition after using the Chocold Gochizo. Hanto, who cannot take Gochizo from Shoma, with whom he had a falling out, dares to continue using Chocold.

Rakia, who sees Koji as his late brother, understands his feelings, thanks to the persuasion of Sachika and others.

He promises Koji that he will bring back Kabutodanshi. Then, Kabutodanshi announces that a fan meeting will be held! Rakia goes to the venue, but...!?

episodes.title: Sour and Sweet to the Point of Burning
episodes.overview:
Shoma and Sachika find Hanto lying on the ground. Shoma leaves Hanto in the care of Dente and goes alone to Suga's laboratory to ask him what he has done to Hanto.

However, Suga takes the opportunity to restrain Shoma and holds him hostage. He takes Shoma hostage and calls Hanto, saying, "I want to show you something." Hanto, who still needs to rest, rushes out to save Shoma.

Suga waits for Hanto and Shoma and then pulls out a new blaster and a Gochizo right in front of them...!

episodes.title: Chocolate Frappe of Bonds!
episodes.overview:
Hanto blames himself for the death of his mentor Shioya. Shoma finds Hanto in a state of exhaustion and tries to help him get back on his feet.

Shoma and Hanto are then confronted by Suga. Suga transforms into Kamen Rider Bake to bring Hanto back. Shoma also transforms into Gavv and confronts him...!

episodes.title: Jiip's Surprise Wedding!
episodes.overview:
Shoma and Rakia participate in a basketball game as helpers. They successfully fulfill their role, but after the game, it is discovered that one of the players has disappeared. When Shoma and the others search the area around the venue, they find a suspicious man...!

Jiip shows up at the Stomach's house accompanied by his wife, Liselle, who is dressed in a glamorous outfit. Lango and his siblings are stunned by Jiip's claim that he married her. Who is this Liselle who greets them with a reverent "Nice to meet you"!?

episodes.title: The Most Terrible Presidential Daughter
episodes.overview:
Jiip appears before Gavv and Vram and introduces them to Liselle, the president's daughter and Jiip's marriage partner. They declare war on Shoma and Rakia and leave with wry smiles on their faces.

Shoma and the others, joined by Hanto, begin a search for the old Granute spectator, who has escaped. When they find him by chance, they transform into Riders and challenge him to another battle, saying, "This time, I won't let you escape!"

episodes.title: A Difficult Marriage
episodes.overview:
By chance, Hanto and Rakia decide to search for a missing person together. They find a Granute, but their wrists are bound together with a special mucus. The Granute escapes and Rakia complains, but Hanto fights back. The two end up cursing at each other.

Meanwhile, Shoma encounters a strange Granute that attacks humans. He transforms into Gavv and fights it, but is gradually cornered. Then Liselle appears...!

episodes.title: Cup on the True Feelings!
episodes.overview:
Rakia is convinced that Granute Ripper is the one who killed his brother Comel, based on the cut marks. Rakia, confronted with this unexpected revelation, loses his composure, ignoring Hanto's warnings...

Shoma is invited by Lizel. Unable to understand Lizel's purpose, he reluctantly agrees to spend time with her...

Then, Shoma's older brother, Nyelv, arrives at Dente's cave. What will Nyelv do to his great-uncle Dente, who is also Shoma's ally...?

episodes.title: One-Hit Kill!! Over Gavv!
episodes.overview:
An injured Hanto shows up at Hapipare. He was attacked by a man with a black Gavv on his stomach, but who could make such a modification...? Shoma deduces that it was Nyelv.

The man with the black Gavv now attacks Rakia and transforms into Bitter Gavv Breacookie Form. Shoma rushes to the aid of the struggling Vram, but then Nyelv appears as well. Nyelv reveals that Bitter Gavv is actually Magen, a tycoon in the business world. What is their objective?

episodes.title: The Great 100 Gochizo Operation!
episodes.overview:
In order to transform into Over Gavv again, the Gochipod must be filled with 100 Gochizo. Shoma leaves Magen, who reappears, in the hands of Hanto and Rakia, and concentrates on eating sweets.

Meanwhile, Glotta clashes with Lizel at Stomach Inc. A confrontation ensues, but Jiip pleads with Glotta, "I need Lizel!"

Shoma is trying his best to eat sweets, but he is unable to produce any Gochizo. Shoma is impatient, but Sachika...!?

episodes.title: Zero Sweetness! Ironclad Lango
episodes.overview:
A series of mass disappearances have occurred again. Shoma, who had been busy with Ritsu's request, is suddenly joined by Hanto and Rakia. Rakia, who was involved in the previous mass disappearance, suspects Lango's presence in this case as well.

After receiving a report from the Gochizo, Shoma discovers Agents attacking people on a plane. He transforms into Gavv, but then Lango appears and delivers a powerful blow to him, knocking him out of his transformation. Hanto and Rakia, who rush to the scene, also transform into Riders and boldly confront Lango, but...!

episodes.title: Turnaround! Awakening! Master Gavv
episodes.overview:
Lango's next target turns out to be a live concert that Ritsu is looking forward to. Shoma asks Hanto and Rakia to protect the audience and declares that he will fight Lango alone.

Shoma confronts Lango at the concert venue, and confronts him with a strong determination: "I will protect this world that has welcomed me so warmly, unlike the Stomach family!" He loads the Gochipod into his Gavv. The next moment, the Gochipod emits a dazzling light...!

episodes.title: I Have Never Forgotten
episodes.overview:
A boy named Hiroto came to Hapipare asking for help in revitalizing his candy shop. Shoma and the others visit the store, which is run by his mother, Rena, and asks Hanto to help them.

Hanto interviews Kenji, a craftsman who was mentored by the previous craftsman, who was also Hiroto's late father. Kenji, who apparently has a dark past, says he is grateful to his predecessor for raising him as a craftsman.

Jiip attacks Shoma. Hanto tries to save Hiroto, who is about to get caught in their fight, but then he sees a surprising sight...!

episodes.title: The Other Side of Hatred
episodes.overview:
Kenji, a Japanese confectioner, is the Granute who kidnapped Hanto's mother. Hanto is trembling with anger, but Kenji, who has reformed, begs him to wait for revenge until he can at least complete a new wagashi for Hiroto.

Meanwhile, Jiip, bent on vengeance for Siita, appears before Shoma.

"I threw everything away, all so I can defeat you!" Jiip, who is so determined to get revenge, takes a Gochizo in his hand and...!

Kenji, who had completed a new wagashi, appears in front of Hanto. Hanto transforms into Valen and delivers a powerful blow...!

episodes.title: I've Been Looking for You
episodes.overview:
Dente begins to complain, "I want to eat more sweets from the human world!" Sachika proposes to make sweets for Dente and serve them to him. Together with Shoma and Rakia, they begin preparations.

Great-uncle Dente is alive in the human world! Glotta learns this surprising fact from Nylev's research data, and rushes to Dente, who is longing for the sweets...!?

Furthermore, Rakia finds out who killed his younger brother, Comel...

episodes.title: The Reminiscent A La Mode
episodes.overview:
Rakia is trying to find Glotta in order to get revenge. Shoma is worried about his bloodcurdling appearance, but he refuses to accept even a word Shoma says to him. Shoma pulls out his phone and says, "There is something I want you to see."

They found Glotta, who collects Human Presses and rages. Shoma and Rakia transform into Riders, but are overwhelmed by Glotta's power. Just when all seemed to be lost, a new Gochizo jumps out from Shoma's Gavv!

episodes.title: Glasses Creeping Closer
episodes.overview:
Hanto is searching for any immediate family of Shoma's mother, Michiru Inoue, and arrives at a certain candy shop. He has heard of this store before, but.... The owner of the store appears before Hanto, who feels a sense of unease...!?

Some people are repeatedly acting strangely in the town. Shoma and the others begin a search based on information that a suspicious man in black has been seen near these people. They finally discover the man. Chased by Shoma and Rakia, the man's true identity is revealed by Hanto...!

episodes.title: At the End of Broken Feelings
episodes.overview:
Shoma and Rakia manage to subdue and restrain the rampaging Hanto. Relieved for the moment, they set out to deal with Nyelv and his puppet, Suga.

Nyelv and Suga have begun a new course of action. In an attempt to stop their terrible plan, Shoma and the others transform with anger and head toward Bitter Gavv and Nyelv, who is now in Granute form. However, Hanto appears in front of Gavv and Vram...!?

episodes.title: What Does the Human World Taste Like?
episodes.overview:
President Bocca has assumed human form and comes to visit the human world with Lizel. Rakia notices Bocca's destructive activities and confronts him with his bare hands, but is knocked down by Bocca's Butlers guarding him.

Shoma and Hanto, upon receiving the report, transform into Gavv and Valen in front of Bocca. They challenge Bocca to a fight, but Bocca is ready to see what they can do...!?

episodes.title: A Dazzling Moment That Will Never Come Back
episodes.overview:
Shoma is reunited with Hajime, a boy who helped him when he first arrived in the human world. Shoma, who was "suspicious" when he first met Hajime, explains to him about his past days fighting as Kamen Rider Gavv and about the Gochizo.

Meanwhile, Hanto encounters Nyelv, who appears in the human world. He transforms into Valen and attacks Nyelv...!

episodes.title: I Won't Let Anyone Take It Away From Me
episodes.overview:
Shoma returns to Hapipare after finishing work, when Nyelv suddenly appears. Nyelv, who is calm and collected even in front of Shoma, makes a surprising proposal. What is it?

Shoma is alone in his thoughts as he is forced to make a choice by Nyelv. In front of his eyes, Lizel again causes a commotion. Shoma is forced to make a big decision with the anger that wells up inside him...!?

episodes.title: Shoma's Determination
episodes.overview:
Shoma accepts Nyelv's proposal and infiltrates the Granute world. In order to defeat President Bocca, he follows a plan laid out by Nyelv and heads for the president's office alone...

Meanwhile, in the human world, Hanto, Rakia, and Sachika are scrambling to bring Shoma back...!

episodes.title: Happy Dystopia
episodes.overview:
President Bocca has launched the "Human World Ranching Project." Shoma and the others see people moving in mysterious ways in the city, and they detect this terrible plan.

Shoma discovers the site where Lizel and others are proceeding with the Human Press conversion. Shoma tries to stop them, but then Nyelv, covered in scars, appears. Nyelv becomes a Granute and attacks Shoma!

episodes.title: Burning Amazingummy
episodes.overview:
Shoma and the others start to take action to save people and defeat President Bocca. Shoma is reunited with Lango...

The only way to protect the people is to defeat Bocca. Shoma, Hanto, and Rakia confront Bocca and transform into Riders, saying "This time we will defeat you!" They challenge Bocca to a fight, but...!?

episodes.title: I Believe in Snacks
episodes.overview:
Lango, who betrayed Shoma and the others, has once again launched a plan to ranch the human world. Shoma, Hanto, and Rakia begin to take action to stop the plan.

While Shoma tries to save the people who have been manipulated, Hanto and the others head back to the Granute world to retrieve the Human Presses...!

episodes.title: Aim for It! A Delicious Future!
episodes.overview:
"There's happiness I want to obtain, too."

Shoma transforms into Gavv in front of Lango! He challenges Lango, who is trying to eliminate Shoma for the sake of the Stomach family, to one last fight!

Gavv manages to fend off Lango's attacks, but a powerful blow breaks the transformation. Shoma confronts him with his bare hands, but is overwhelmed and finally cornered...!?

episodes.title: Case 1: Start
episodes.overview:
Baku Yorozu is an invincible agent who uses his lucid dreaming ability to brilliantly rescue Nemu, a national celebrity, and complete difficult missions in his dreams.

One night, Baku is suddenly attacked by a monster, the Nightmare. In his lucid dream, Baku fights against invincible foes, but for some reason, he is unable to defeat the Nightmare and runs away. Baku, cornered, encounters a mysterious person, who entrusts him with the Zeztz Driver and Capsems, and he transforms into Kamen Rider Zeztz!

episodes.title: Case 2: Explode
episodes.overview:
In a dream, Baku somehow becomes a fugitive criminal. When he encounters the Bomb Nightmare, he transforms into Zeztz, but the Nightmare escapes.

One night, Baku is suddenly summoned by Zero, who gives him an order to "infiltrate other people's dreams and prevent the Nightmare's nightmares before they happen." This means that he has to stop that bomber... Baku's mission to protect his "dream master" begins!

episodes.title: Case 3: Erode
episodes.overview:
"To stop the nightmare, you must find the Mind's Door in the nightmare world." After receiving an order from Zero, Baku falls asleep and infiltrates Fujimi's nightmare to find the door to his mind.

However, the Bomb Nightmare causes an explosion in front of Baku's eyes. If this continues, Fujimi's nightmare will become reality!? Baku transforms into Zeztz to save Fujimi and the world!

episodes.title: Case 4: Rob
episodes.overview:
Baku dreams that he is guarding a VIP, the father of the bride, at a wedding rehearsal. Then a man appears and tries to steal from the bride, Miyuki. Baku's protection saves the day, but is he the dreamer of the Nightmare?

On the day of the wedding, Baku, who is guarding the wedding in his dream, is confronted by a Nightmare who is after Miyuki. Baku transforms into Zeztz, and with the new powers he has gained from Zero, he challenges the Nightmare to a dogfight...!?

episodes.title: Case 5: Crash
episodes.overview:
Why is the bride Miyuki the dreamer? Baku, who continues to gather information in the real world, comes in contact with Miyuki standing in front of a large tree in the park. He learns that Miyuki has a memory of the tree that could change her life.

In the dream world, Baku finds Miyuki's Mind's Door and sees an unexpected scene behind the door. The Crow Nightmare appears again and attacks Miyuki and everyone else!

episodes.title: Case 6: Imprison
episodes.overview:
Baku is assigned a new mission: escape from prison. Baku tries to escape with Nem, Masumi Bijogi and Reiko, who are trapped in a prison nightmare, but their way is blocked by various traps. And what secret is hidden in the relationship between Nem and Bijogi?

Nox appears in front of Baku and eerily says, "This is an inescapable prison of death." Will Baku be able to carry out his impregnable mission?

episodes.title: Case7: Punish
episodes.overview:
In a dream imprisoned within a prison, the dream master, Bijogi, took Nem and vanished.

Puzzled by this bizarre behavior, Fujimi and Nasuka reveal a certain "cruel truth" to Baku.

After learning everything, Baku returns to the dream world and takes on the mission anew to save Bijogi and Nem. But once again, Nox stands in Baku's way...!

episodes.title: Case8: Serve
episodes.overview:
Baku infiltrates the traditional restaurant "Royal Shirogane" in a dream to carry out a mission to destroy a biological weapon. Right before the wary Baku's eyes, Chef Shiomi, who had tasted the owner-chef Sannoh's dish, collapsed.

Upon waking, Baku visits Sannoh's restaurant, where another unexplained food poisoning incident occurs. Could it be a biological weapon again? What is the true nature of the nightmare...!?

episodes.title: Case9: Poison
episodes.overview:
What is the nightmare Chef Sannoh desires? Baku finds a clue in the words of Shiomi and others in the real world, discovering Sannoh's third Mind's Door in a dream. Peering inside...!

While Fujimi and the others scramble to stop the summit meeting, Baku transforms into Zeztz and collides with the Poison Nightmare. But then, Nox reappears once more...!?

episodes.title: Case10: Vanish
episodes.overview:
Baku, tasked with the mission "Get back the national secret", infiltrates the home of art collector Atsumi in a dream. A theft occurs involving a famous painting from Atsumi's collection, and Baku suspects state secrets are hidden within that painting.

However, as Baku pursues the culprit, Nox appears and warns him, "Knowing too much will destroy you." The next instant, Baku is struck by a blow from Nox's weapon...!?

episodes.title: Case11: Rot
episodes.overview:
The masterpiece stolen in the dream was corroded by the Nightmare. The national secret hidden within the painting would remain unrecovered if this continued... Baku was disheartened, but Zero rebukes him with an unusually stern tone.

Baku once again transforms into Zeztz within the dream. As he grabbed the Wonder Capsem to protect Atsumi from the Mold Nightmare...!?

episodes.title: Case12: Impact
episodes.overview:
In his dream, Baku becomes an employee at the Space Center. His new mission: protect Earth from an approaching giant meteorite. Time until impact: 48 hours. Upon waking, Baku informs Fujimi and Nagumo of humanity's impending doom and springs into action.

Returning to the dream world, Baku attempts to avert the asteroid collision alongside Nem. But there, Nox stands in their way. Before their eyes, Nox straps on a belt, loads a Capsem, and...!

episodes.title: Case13: Extinguish
episodes.overview:
After battling Nox Knight and acutely feeling his own powerlessness, Baku, having lost his confidence as an agent, is branded unfit by Zero.

Still, a casual conversation with Seiya prompts him to reexamine himself. In a dream, he discovers Seiya's Mind's Door. Armed with a new Capsem, he confronts Nox!

episodes.title: Case14: Thunder
episodes.overview:
Baku's new mission is to eliminate his enemy, Nox. Wandering through a black hole in his dream, Baku begins to retrace the nightmare he first saw as a child.

Young Baku attends a cram school. Following his movements, the cram school instructor Nox appears! Shocked by this past encounter with Nox, Baku confronts him, desperate to recover his erased memories!

episodes.title: Case15: Lighten
episodes.overview:
What kind of organization is CODE? When Baku questions Zero, he learns that Nox was once a CODE agent.

Nem reports to Baku that she sees through Nox's nightmares. Realizing everything, Baku confronts Nox once more and transforms into Zeztz using a new Capsem...!

episodes.title: Case16: Escape
episodes.overview:
Baku's new mission is to rescue Nem, who was abducted by a Nightmare. Zero denounces Baku as a "traitor to the organization" for letting Nox escape.

Though Baku has lost trust, he scrambles to complete the mission. Meanwhile, ignoring Baku's plight, Nox confronts Zero, equips a new Driver, and loads a Capsem!

episodes.title: Case17: Pursue
episodes.overview:
Though he lost Zero, Baku continues his mission to rescue Nem. Nurse Haru then reveals a surprising truth about Nem's disappearance to Baku.

Having found the dreamer's Mind's Door, Baku begins pursuing the Wolf Nightmare. However, Nox blocks his path and transforms into Kamen Rider Nox. Baku also transforms into Zeztz, and the two Riders finally clash!

episodes.title: Case18: Shoot
episodes.overview:
In his dream, Baku, now a high school student, must protect his classmates—Nasuka and Kureha—from the Nightmare orchestrating a death game.

As students fall, Kureha takes up a gun and challenges the Nightmare to battle. Seeing Baku intervene, Kureha murmurs, "...Seven." Why does Kureha know that name...!?

episodes.title: Case19: Decide
episodes.overview:
Baku meets the present Kureha, now a journalist, and learns the secrets of the organization CODE. Disturbed, Baku questions his role as an agent in the fight.

Nem confesses to Baku that the Nightmares might be born from her own subconscious. Comforting the grief-stricken Nem, Baku resolutely confronts the Death Game Nightmare as it attacks once more!

episodes.title: Case20: Presage
episodes.overview:
In his dream, Baku, now Village Person A, embarks on an RPG-like adventure with Sota, Tomoko, and the heroine Nem to defeat monsters. When Baku encounters a Nightmare, he transforms into Zeztz, but feels uneasy about the Nightmare's strange behavior...

Meanwhile, Nox confronts Six, who has appeared to eliminate the traitor. He transforms into a Rider and challenges her to battle, but...!?

episodes.title: Case21: Burst
episodes.overview:
Are countless children dreaming the same dream? Baku, who began investigating, discovers a common thread among the children who shared the same dream.

Entering the dream world once more, Baku witnesses the terrifying conclusion of the nightmare unfolding beyond the Mind's Door. The children are in danger! Baku transforms into Zeztz and challenges the Baby Nightmare to a battle, but...!?

episodes.title: Case22: Revenge
episodes.overview:
The new mission is to defeat the Disaster Nightmare that has appeared in the real world and take Odaka's life. Feeling distrust toward the ruthless CODE, Baku questions his role as an agent.

Meanwhile, Five and Six confront the Disaster Nightmare and Nox. Witnessing their fierce battle, Baku suddenly senses something amiss!?

episodes.title: Case23: Destroy
episodes.overview:
Baku, having undone Zeztz Catastrom's transformation after successfully defeating Nox, falls into a deep sleep and enters the realm of the subconscious. There, he learns of the intense feelings Nem carried, and Baku himself resolves to take decisive action.

Finally awakening from his slumber, Baku coldly declares to Minami and the others before beginning his mission.

"I am Code Number: Seven. I'll carry out my mission..."

What has transformed Baku into this cold-hearted man? And where is he headed?

episodes.title: Case24: Break
episodes.overview:
The cold-blooded agent, Code Number: Seven, Baku, shakes off the attempts by Minami and the others to stop him and sets out to carry out his mission: "Find Nem."

Baku races to meet Nem, who has awakened from her dream. Amidst this, The Lady manipulates a Nightmare to attack CODE headquarters. Then, Three appears, transformed into Lord Three...!!

episodes.title: Case25: Get Started
episodes.overview:
Baku awakes in a hospital bed and realizes all his experiences had been a dream. But if it was a dream, why are the Zeztz Driver and Capsems here...?

Confused, Baku falls asleep and reunites with Nem in his dream. Were all his experiences just a nightmare, or...!?

episodes.title: Case26: Gather
episodes.overview:
In his dream, Baku recounts his terrifying experiences to Fujimi, Nasuka, and Minami.

Nox was also secretly listening to Baku's story when Five and Six, acting on CODE's orders, suddenly appear! The four clash, but then a new disturbance occurs!?

episodes.title: Case27: Play
episodes.overview:
Under a fierce assault from a mysterious Rider who appeared out of nowhere, Baku is jolted awake from his dream. Who is this person capable of changing the future? Baku sets himself the mission to "uncover the enemy’s true identity."

Meanwhile, at CODE, Zero and Three grow increasingly alarmed by the appearance of "Sieg." Who exactly is "Sieg"…!?

episodes.title: Case28: Rage
episodes.overview:
Tormented by Sieg, Baku approaches Nox in an attempt to uncover Sieg’s true identity.

Meanwhile, at CODE, Three is considering deploying “Code: Somnia,” CODE’s ultimate weapon. Amidst this, Baku once again faces off against Sieg and declares, “I’ll be the one to shatter this nightmare,” challenging him to battle!

episodes.title: Case29: Trick
episodes.overview:
Baku meets Minami, who has become an agent, in a dream. Baku helps Minami with her mission to find a lost cat, but they are attacked by a Nightmare, and he wakes up.

A "Black Case" has occurred in which Minami has grown a cat's tail. When Baku falls asleep again, he challenges the Nightmare to battle in order to save Minami, but...!

episodes.title: Case30: Order
episodes.overview:
Minami is a CODE agent... Upon learning the truth, Baku is disappointed and furious, realizing that Minami had merely been "pretending to be family."

In his dream, Minami is transformed into the Cat Nightmare once again. Baku transforms into Zeztz Catastrom and, despite knowing her true identity, attacks the Cat Nightmare...!?

episodes.title: Case31: Afflict
episodes.overview:
"You will be eliminated by CODE..." After receiving this ruthless verdict from Zero, Baku infiltrates Zero's dream. Attacked by a mysterious black Zeztz, Baku is forced to confront a terrifying truth!

Meanwhile, Sieg, plotting to use Nem, lures her into the Nightmare Prison. Terrified by countless Nightmares, Nem is cornered by Sieg...!?

episodes.title: Case32: Overcome
episodes.overview:
Zero, his biological father, had been using his son, Baku, for Zeztz's sake. Unable to accept his own cruel fate, Baku is tormented by his inability to understand Zero’s true intentions.

Will Baku be able to overcome this nightmare…!?

episodes.title: Case33: Realize
episodes.overview:
Sieg turned Nem’s nightmare into a prophetic dream, causing the Nightmare to appear in the real world.

Witnessing people being attacked by the Nightmare, Baku puts on his broken Zeztz Driver. He loads the Capsem and tries to transform into Zeztz, but…!?

episodes.title: Case34: Infiltrate
episodes.overview: Having been revived, Baku delves into the depths of Sieg’s psyche—who is obsessed with Nem’s nightmares—and witnesses Sieg’s past firsthand. Having identified the Nightmare dwelling within Sieg, Baku confronts him once again, and the decisive battle between Zeztz and Dawn begins!

episodes.title: Case35: Connect
episodes.overview: When Baku awoke from an ominous dream, the real world had been completely transformed. Determined to uncover the truth, Baku returns to the dream world, only to find that Nem was being targeted by Six. As Baku scrambles to protect Nem, Three appears and demonstrates a terrifying power...!?

episodes.title: Case36: Unite
episodes.overview:
After being saved by Nox, Baku is pressed to reveal the location of CODE's base, which he saw in a prophetic dream. It seems Nox intends to storm CODE's headquarters...

After much internal struggle, Baku also resolves to destroy the activation device of Code: Somnia. Nox clashes with Three, while Baku faces off against Five and take back the world from CODE!

episodes.title: Case37: Manipulate
episodes.overview:
As work on the Zeztz Driver progresses, Baku is attacked by Nox, who has been tampered with by Three. Baku fights back with the Capsem in hand, but he is gradually cornered by the relentless attacks of Nox, who has transformed into a ruthless warrior.

Meanwhile, in the real world, Three notices something amiss and, in an attempt to prevent the Driver’s completion, forcibly wakes Zero from his dream…!

episodes.title: Case38: Reform
episodes.overview:
"I will destroy CODE even if it costs me my own life..." Driven by that single-minded determination, Baku pursues Nox, who has vanished, and delves into Nox’s subconscious.

Right before Baku’s eyes, Nox—having obtained a new power from the Capsem—transforms into Kamen Rider Nox. Shouting, "Vanish into the darkness!", he clashes with Lord Three, who stands in his way!

episodes.title: Case39: Judge
episodes.overview:
A "Black Case" has occurred, likely caused by Code: Somnia's missing Capsem. Following orders from Zero, Baku rushes to recover the Capsem.

Sieg, whose fused Nightmare has awakened within him, has returned. Could Sieg be the one who stole the Capsem!? Baku transforms into Zeztz and collides with him in a massive crash!

episodes.title: Case40: Generate
episodes.overview:
A series of "Black Cases" has occurred in which people who have committed crimes in the real world have gone missing. It appears to be the work of the Punish Gore Nightmare, who metes out divine punishment to sinners.

Even if they are sinners, this is going too far! Nox joins Baku in his attempt to stop the Nightmare's rampage. Facing their most formidable enemy, the two transform into Zeztz and Rider Nox!

episodes.title: Case41: Arise
episodes.overview:
A Nightmare has launched an attack on CODE. After Zero informs Baku of the impending collapse of the world, Baku rushes to the CODE facility.

There, Baku is confronted by Odaka, who aims to destroy CODE. “Zero is essential!” Baku transforms into Zeztz and clashes with Nox Midnight Shadow!

episodes.title: Case42: Devour
episodes.overview:
Devastated by the loss of Zero, Baku is overwhelmed by a sense of loss. “What should we do now that he’s gone…?” How will Odaka respond to Baku’s question!?

Though Baku couldn’t shake his doubts, faced with a reality spiraling into chaos, he awakens with a new mission. Transforming into Zeztz in his dreams, he takes on the Catastrophe Gore Nightmare!

episodes.title: Case43: Split
episodes.overview:
A new Black Case involving the Punish Gore Nightmare has emerged. Baku tries to stop Punish from running amok, but finds himself in a tough fight.

Unable to bear watching Zeztz struggle, Nem negotiates with Sieg to deal with Punish. She then confronts Punish herself, but just then, Sieg appears...!

episodes.title: Case44: Efface
episodes.overview:
The Oblivion Gore Nightmare activates the Power of Oblivion. Nem's memories are erased, and the objects and people around her begin to vanish one after another.

"I don't want this to happen!" Nem desperately tries to resist, pleading with Sieg and Nox. And Baku, who tries to save Nem...!?

episodes.title: Case45: Hallucinate
episodes.overview:
Having awakened with no memory of her past, Nem had become a popular celebrity, spending her busy days under the watchful eye of her kind mother, The Lady.

However, an incident threatens this peaceful life: the Oblivion Gore Nightmare appears and attempts to merge with Nem. As Nem’s consciousness grows hazy, she is drawn toward Oblivion…!?

episodes.title: Case46: Resurrect
episodes.overview:
The Lady, determined to bring Nem back, uses the power of the Phantom Gore Nightmare to create a new world of illusions, driving Baku into a desperate situation.

Nox’s dark powers should be able to dispel Phantom’s illusions. Having regained his memories thanks to Baku and Nem, Nox transforms into Nox Midnight Shadow and clashes with Phantom!

episodes.title: Case47: Save
episodes.overview:
Although he dragged the Phantom Gore Nightmare into the darkness, Odaka remains in a deep sleep. Is he refusing to wake up of his own accord?

Meanwhile, the Oblivion Gore Nightmare once again unleashes the power of oblivion. “It’s because I was born that these nightmares are happening…” To save Nem, who is suffering from this, Baku transforms into Zeztz! He challenges Oblivion to battle, but…!?

episodes.title: Case48: Rest
episodes.overview:
Sieg teams up with Nox to take the place of Baku, who is suffering from physical ailments, and they face off against the Oblivion Gore Nightmare.

Baku, having recovered, also joins Nox and the others. He transforms into Zeztz and challenges Oblivion to battle, but around that time, Nem...!?

episodes.title: Case49: Remember
episodes.overview:
"Bring Nem back."

Driven by strong resolve, Baku heads toward the Mind's Door, but if Nem returns, the Oblivion Gore Nightmare will also be revived. The world will be destroyed once again.

Still, Baku refuses to give up. In a completely white, empty space where no one else is present, he pleads desperately, but…!?

episodes.title: Last Case: Imagine
episodes.overview:
Baku transforms into a Rider alongside Nox and Sieg. They face the Oblivion Gore Nightmare in their final battle.

Even with the combined power of Zeztz, Nox, and Dawn, they cannot defeat Oblivion. Just as their spirits are about to break, Zeztz picks up a new Capsem, and then...!

episodes.title: The Mouse Meister and the Young Lady
episodes.overview: Long ago, the Twelve Animal Signs formed the Zyunishi Doumei (The Twelve Animal Signs Alliance) to protect humanity from mysterious lifeforms known as FUKASHIGI. Preparing for an inevitable battle against FUKASHIGI, the members of the Zyunishi Doumei entered a 100-year slumber. In the present day, Sora Otosumi serves as the personal Meister of the Mizuki family. To protect the family's daughter, Yuna Mizuki, he transforms into Kamen Rider MY-TH and joins the fight against FUKASHIGI. But when Sora comes into conflict with the Twelve Animal Signs over FUKASHIGI, a new Kamen Rider “myth” begins!

episodes.title: The Running Tortoise and Modern Hare
episodes.overview: As Tatsuomi, who had infiltrated the Mizuki household as a tutor, continued his investigation, a new Fukashigi emerged. Sora transforms into My-Th, but just then, Datt appears. Datt transforms into Kamen Rider Datt and, ignoring the astonished My-Th, launches an attack on the Fukashigi. Datt uses her exceptional jumping ability to corner the Fukashigi, but My-Th intervenes, turning it into a three-way battle...!?

episodes.title: Meow, the Black Cat Rider of Justice
episodes.overview:
Yuna meets Shiori, a girl whose father has gone missing in the city, and deduces that it’s the work of a Fukashigi. Sora also begins his own investigation.

Tatsuomi, who had been keeping an eye on Sora, witnesses Sora transform into My-Th right in front of the Fukashigi. Seizing the moment, he pulls out his own Driver and transforms into Kamen Rider...!

episodes.title: The Wolf Has a Hidden Agenda
episodes.overview:
In order to bring Shiori’s father back, Sora and Yuna are working tirelessly to combat the Fukashigi. After discovering a clue, Sora asks Tatsuomi for help.

The Fukashigi reappears. Sora transforms into My-Th, but once again, Rid interrupts. My-Th shifts into Wolf Frame and, keeping an eye on Rid, corners the Fukashigi—but...!?

episodes.title: Either a Dog or a Snake
episodes.overview:
"If we don't have that, Yuna's in big trouble!"

Tatsuomi is suspicious of Sora, who is unusually open about his emotions. Just then, Yuna sends them new Fukashigi information.

Sora transforms into My-Th and challenges the Fukashigi, but Jyao, who is after My-Th’s transformation device, intervenes...!

episodes.title: Become an Eagle!
episodes.overview:
After analyzing the Fukashigi that had fled, Sora left Yuna, who was complaining of feeling unwell, behind and set off in pursuit of it alongside Tatsuomi.

When Sora transforms into My-Th in front of the Fukashigi, Jyao appears once again. As Jyao relentlessly targets My-Th, Vanken intervenes, shouting, “You’ve got the wrong person!” but...!
